Department of Commerce International Trade Administration
Enforcement and Compliance, International Trade Administration, Department of Commerce.
The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines that polytetramethylene ether glycol (PTMEG) from the People's Republic of China (China) is being, or is likely to be, sold in the United States at less than fair value (LTFV). The period of investigation (POI) is October 1, 2025, through March 31, 2026. Interested parties are invited to comment on this preliminary determination.
Applicable November 10, 2026.
Daniel Saba or Kate Fracke, AD/CVD Operations, Office III, Enforcement and Compliance, International Trade Administration, U.S. Department of Commerce, 1401 Constitution Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20230; telephone: (202) 482-5849 or (202) 482-3299, respectively.
This preliminary determination is made in accordance with section 733(b) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended (the Act). Commerce published the notice of initiation of this investigation on May 5, 2026.[1] On August 28, 2026, Commerce postponed the preliminary determination of this investigation and the revised deadline is now November 4, 2026.[2]
For a complete description of the events that followed the initiation of this investigation, see the Preliminary Decision Memorandum.[3] A list of topics included in the Preliminary Decision Memorandum is included as Appendix II to this notice. The Preliminary Decision Memorandum is a public document and is on file electronically via Enforcement and Compliance's Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Centralized Electronic Service System (ACCESS), which is available to registered users at https://access.trade.gov. In addition, a complete version of the Preliminary Decision Memorandum can be accessed directly at https://access.trade.gov/​frnotices.
The product covered by this investigation is PTMEG from China. For a complete description of the scope of this investigation, see Appendix I.
In accordance with the Preamble to Commerce's regulations,[4] the Initiation Notice set aside a period of time for parties to raise issues regarding product coverage ( i.e., scope).[5] Certain interested parties commented on the scope of the investigation as it appeared in the Initiation Notice. For a summary of the product coverage comments and rebuttal responses submitted to the record for this investigation, and accompanying discussion and analysis of all comments timely received, see the Preliminary Scope Decision Memorandum.[6] Commerce is preliminarily not modifying the scope language as it appeared in the Initiation Notice. See the scope in Appendix I to this notice.
Commerce is conducting this investigation in accordance with section 731 of the Act. Pursuant to sections 776(a) and (b) of the Act, Commerce preliminarily has relied upon facts otherwise available, with adverse inferences, for the China-wide entity. For a full description of the methodology underlying Commerce's preliminary determination, see the Preliminary Decision Memorandum.
In the Initiation Notice,[7] Commerce stated that it would calculate producer/exporter combination rates for the respondents that are eligible for a separate rate in this investigation. Policy Bulletin 05.1 describes this practice.[8] In this case, because no respondent qualified for a separate rate, producer/exporter combination rates were not calculated.
Commerce preliminarily determines that the following estimated weighted-average dumping margin exists:
Producer Exporter Estimated weighted-average dumping margin (percent) China-Wide Entity * 213.44 * Rate is based on total facts available with adverse inferences.
In accordance with section 733(d)(2) of the Act, Commerce will direct U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) to suspend liquidation of entries of subject merchandise as described in Appendix I, entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption on or after the date of publication of this notice in the Federal Register . Further, pursuant to section 733(d)(1)(B) of the Act and 19 CFR 351.205(d), Commerce will instruct CBP to require a cash deposit equal to the estimated weighted-average dumping margin, as follows: (1) for all Chinese producers/exporters of subject merchandise, which are treated as part of the China-wide entity because they ( printed page 72521) have not established eligibility for a separate rate, the cash deposit rate will be equal to the estimated weighted-average dumping margin established for the China-wide entity; and (2) for all third-county exporters of merchandise under consideration, the cash deposit rate is the cash deposit rate applicable to the China-wide entity that supplied that third-country exporter.
These suspension of liquidation instructions will remain in effect until further notice.
Normally, Commerce discloses to interested parties the calculations performed in connection with a preliminary determination within five days of its public announcement or, if there is no public announcement, within five days of the date of publication of this notice in accordance with 19 CFR 351.224(b). However, because Commerce preliminarily applied total adverse facts available (AFA) to the China-wide entity in this investigation, in accordance with section 776 of the Act, and the applied AFA rate is based solely on the Petition, there are no calculations to disclose.
Because no company has established separate rate eligibility, verification will not be conducted.
Non-scope related case briefs or other written comments may be submitted to the Assistant Secretary for Enforcement and Compliance no later than 14 days after the date of publication of the preliminary determination in the Federal Register . Rebuttal briefs, limited to issues raised in the case briefs, may be filed not later than five days after the date for filing case briefs.[9] Interested parties who submit case briefs or rebuttal briefs in this proceeding must submit: (1) a table of contents listing each issue; and (2) a table of authorities.[10]
As provided under 19 CFR 351.309(c)(2)(iii) and (d)(2)(iii), we request that interested parties provide at the beginning of their briefs a public, executive summary for each issue raised in their briefs.[11] Further, we request that interested parties limit their executive summary of each issue to no more than 450 words, not including citations. We intend to use the executive summaries as the basis of the comment summaries included in the issues and decision memorandum that will accompany the final determination in this investigation. We request that interested parties include footnotes for relevant citations in the executive summary of each issue. Note that Commerce has amended certain of its requirements pertaining to the service of documents in 19 CFR 351.303(f).[12]
Pursuant to 19 CFR 351.310(c), interested parties who wish to request a hearing, limited to issues raised in the case and rebuttal briefs, must submit a written request to the Assistant Secretary for Enforcement and Compliance, U.S. Department of Commerce, within 30 days after the date of publication of this notice. Requests should contain: (1) the party's name, address, and telephone number; (2) the number of participants and whether any participant is a foreign national; and (3) a list of the issues to be discussed. If a request for a hearing is made, Commerce intends to hold the hearing at a time and date to be determined. Parties should confirm by telephone the date, time, and location of the hearing two days before the scheduled date.
Section 735(a)(1) of the Act and 19 CFR 351.210(b)(1) provide that Commerce will issue the final determination within 75 days after the date of its preliminary determination. Accordingly, Commerce will make its final determination no later than 75 days after the signature date of this preliminary determination.
U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC) Notification
In accordance with section 733(f) of the Act, Commerce will notify the ITC of its preliminary determination of sales at LTFV. If the final determination is affirmative, the ITC will determine before the later of 120 days after the date of this preliminary determination or 45 days after the final determination whether imports of the subject merchandise are materially injuring, or threaten material injury to, the U.S. industry.
This determination is issued and published in accordance with sections 733(f) and 777(i)(1) of the Act, and 19 CFR 351.205(c).
Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary for Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Operations.
The merchandise covered by the investigation is polytetramethylene ether glycol (PTMEG), which is a polymer consisting of linear diols ( i.e., organic chemical compound that has two hydroxyl (-OH) functional groups) with a molecular backbone of repeating tetramethylene units (-CH2CH2CH2CH2-) interconnected through ether bonds ( i.e., a single oxygen atom bonded to two carbon atoms), with a chemical formula HO{(CH2)4} nOH. PTMEG is also referred to as Polytetrahydrofuran, PTHF, Polytetramethylene ether glycol, PTMG, and Polybutylene glycol. PTMEG is typically blended with butylated hydroxytoluene (BHT) or another stabilizer such as higher molecular weight hindered phenols or phosphoric acid. In addition to a stabilizer, PTMEG is sometimes blended with a modifier or additive, such as phosphoric acid or sulfuric acid. The scope includes all blends consisting of PTMEG and stabilizers, modifiers, and/or additives, where the stabilizers, modifiers, and/or additives collectively account for no more than two percent of the total weight of the PTMEG blend. PTMEG is normally associated with Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS) registry number 25190-06-1.
The scope includes all forms of PTMEG, regardless of physical form, purity, molecular weight, number of hydroxyls, number of acids, color, density, softening point, glass transition point, flash point, water content, viscosity, and packaging. PTMEG that has been blended with other products is included within this scope when such blends include constituent parts that have been intermingled but that have not been chemically reacted with each other to produce a different product. For such blends, only the PTMEG component of the mixture, inclusive of any stabilizers, modifiers, and/or additives collectively accounting for no more than two percent of the combined weight of the PTMEG component and the stabilizers, modifiers, and/or additives, is covered by the scope of the investigation.
The scope includes merchandise matching the above description that has been processed in a third country, including by commingling, diluting, introducing, or removing stabilizers, modifiers, or additives, or performing any other processing that would not otherwise remove the merchandise from the scope of the investigation if performed in the subject country. The scope also includes PTMEG that is commingled or blended with PTMEG from sources not subject to the investigation. Only the subject component of such commingled products is covered by the scope of the investigation. The subject merchandise is classifiable in the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS) under subheading 3907.29.0000. Subject merchandise may also be imported under ( printed page 72522) HTSUS subheadings 2932.11.0000 and 3404.91.5150. Although the HTSUS subheading and CAS registry number are provided for convenience and customs purposes, the written description of the scope is dispositive.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy: a timeline | TechCrunch
Image Credits:Justin Sullivan / Getty Images
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: a timeline
9:04 AM PST · November 10, 2026
Nvidia co-founder CEO Jensen Huang has never been as flashy or controversy-prone as AI leaders like OpenAI’s Sam Altman or SpaceXAI’s Elon Musk. Now, the 63-year-old industry kingpin has admitted that he cheated on his wife of 40 years in an affair that could have ramifications beyond Huang’s personal life and potentially impact national security.
United States officials believe that Huang’s likely romantic interest, Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, is a Chinese spy who has been feeding information back to Beijing. (Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen, is of no relation to Jensen Huang.)
Megaspeed, a Singapore-based AI infrastructure company, had reportedly purchased $4.8 billion in Nvidia chips over the last two years. The U.S. and Singapore have both previously investigated Megaspeed over suspicions that the firm was illegally sharing chips with China.
The U.S. and China are embroiled in a fierce technological arms race to build the most advanced AI infrastructure, which could shape each country’s economic future, military prowess, and capacity for innovation. Nvidia is valuable in this competition as one of the world’s largest makers of AI chips, which are essential for accelerating AI development. But as an American company, Nvidia faces government restrictions on the sale of its most powerful chips to Chinese entities.
As the controversy unfolds, we are organizing the most relevant events into a reverse-chronological timeline to keep you up to date.
November 9, 2026: Huang pulls out of various speaking engagements
The Nvidia CEO pulled out of upcoming speaking engagements at the ElevenLabs Summit and Anthropic CEO Forum.
November 9-10, 2026: Details emerge about the business relationships between Nvidia and the alleged spy
Alice Huang and her family reportedly built a network of companies in China and Singapore to acquire Nvidia chips, including founding a Chinese company called Shanghai Century Litong. Founded in 2023, it became an Nvidia-preferred cloud partner, giving it priority access to chips, The Information reported. The Information also reported that Shanghai Century Litong facilitated buying $7.5 billion worth of Nvidia’s chips, including banned chips.
Nvidia’s head lawyer, Tim Teter, intervened in a 2025 U.S. government probe surrounding the suspected smuggling of AI chips by Megaspeed International, Bloomberg reported. Teter contacted Commerce Under Secretary Jeffrey Kessler asking questions about whether the Trump administration played a role in detaining Alice Huang.
In early 2025, Alice Huang and a business partner sought China-based investors for an Asian data center, promising they had no problem in securing GPUs, the Financial Times reported.
November 8, 2026: Trump shows support for Nvidia CEO, calls him a “fine person”
On Sunday night, President Trump weighed in on Huang’s controversy and showed support for the Nvidia CEO.
“I have not spoken to him about it. I just know he’s a fine person, but you never know what’s going on,” Trump said.
When asked if Huang should remain chief of Nvidia, Trump said, “I think so. Oh yeah, sure.”
November 8, 2026: Huang admits to affair in public message to Nvidia employees; Nvidia board of directors begins investigation
Jensen Huang wrote in a letter to Nvidia employees — which was also published as a press release — that he cheated on his wife.
“I owe my family and all of you an apology,” Huang told his company. “I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.”
Huang did not mention Alice Huang by name in the message, but linked his infidelity to “the national security concerns raised in news reports.”
“Nvidia’s Board of Directors has initiated an independent investigation. I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. I love our country and our company. I am committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America’s national security. I am proud and grateful to be an American,” Huang wrote.
Nvidia shares slid over 5% the following day.
November 5, 2026: Three Republican committee chairmen ask Huang for closed-door briefing
Three Republican congressmen — Chairman John Moolenaar of the House Select Committee on China, Chairman Brian Mast of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, and Chairman Rick Crawford of the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence — sent a request to Huang for a closed-door joint briefing with their three committees.
“Recent reports raise significant national security concerns regarding the [People’s Republic of China]’s access to sensitive U.S. technology and information,” the chairmen wrote. “The issue of PRC infiltration and access to cutting-edge U.S. technology is core to the investigative work of our three committees this Congress. It is vital that Congress determines the extent to which U.S. national security has been placed at risk.”
October 29, 2026: Jensen Huang publicly revealed to have developed ‘close relationship’ with suspected Chinese spy
U.S. officials had been investigating Alice Huang and Megaspeed for more than a year when the New York Times broke the story in late October that the two executives also had a close relationship.
An Nvidia spokesperson denied that this relationship was something out of the ordinary.
“Jensen’s interactions with Ms. Huang are not unusual or unexpected. Meetings with customers are part of a CEO’s job; Jensen talks with thousands of customer executives every year,” Nvidia spokesperson John Rizzo said. He added that “if the U.S. government believes that any person is a threat to American industry, it would let us know.”
Spring 2026: A secret memo circulates in the Trump administration about Nvidia CEO’s alleged relationship with Chinese spy
U.S. officials circulated a secret memo among policymakers that warned that Megaspeed’s Alice Huang, who had a relationship with Jensen Huang, was a spy for China’s Ministry of State Security. This memo was not public knowledge until it was later reported by the New York Times.
Secretary of State Marco Rubio supervised the drafting of the memo.
Late 2025: President Trump briefed on U.S. surveillance of Alice Huang and her relationship to Nvidia CEO but does not take action
Around the same time, per the New York Times’ report, U.S. President Donald Trump was briefed about intelligence findings that possible Chinese spy Alice Huang had formed a close relationship with Jensen Huang. Trump did not act on this information.
The Nvidia CEO, an ally of Trump, has repeatedly advocated for the U.S. government to let Nvidia expand its business in China.
October 2025: U.S. and Singapore each investigate Megaspeed over possible Chinese export violations
Megaspeed was confirmed to be under investigation by both the U.S. and Singaporean governments in October 2025. As a customer of Nvidia, Megaspeed was suspected of helping Chinese companies get around American embargoes on chip exports.
Megaspeed, a neocloud that used Nvidia chips, had been renting computing power to Chinese internet giant Alibaba and other Chinese companies, the Times reported. A Commerce Department official who had visited Megaspeed’s data center in Malaysia in 2024 had found a hoard of Nvidia equipment that was still packed in boxes and the concern was that this equipment was being directly shipped somewhere else, like China, rather than installed and sold as a cloud service.
Jensen Huang had been spotted socializing with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang as early as 2024 in Taiwan, where the Nvidia CEO was born.
These investigations into Megaspeed highlighted concerns about the degree to which Nvidia is able to track its chip exports. At the time, an Nvidia spokesperson told press that the company did not have “any reason to believe products had been diverted.”
“NVIDIA visited multiple Megaspeed sites yet again earlier this week and confirmed what we previously observed — Megaspeed is running a small commercial cloud, like many other companies throughout the world, as allowed by U.S. export control rules,” the Nvidia spokesperson said at the time.

summary: 资料照片：在山东省青岛附近海域，中国人民解放军海军“辽宁舰”航空母舰参加了庆祝海军成立70周年的海上阅兵仪式。(2019年4月23日) 中国近期在西太平洋和南中国海地区集结了100多艘舰船，但目前尚未宣布进行大规模演习。美国智库分析，解放军“很可能正在进行一场模拟封锁台湾的大规模军事演习”，意在为实施实际的封锁行动做准备，并削弱台湾对其自身防卫能力的信心。 11月3日，台湾国安会秘书长吴钊燮通过社交媒体、公开中共海军与海警在台海及第一岛链周边的常态化和跨区军事部署。吴钊燮通过
content:
资料照片：在山东省青岛附近海域，中国人民解放军海军“辽宁舰”航空母舰参加了庆祝海军成立70周年的海上阅兵仪式。(2019年4月23日)
中国近期在西太平洋和南中国海地区集结了100多艘舰船，但目前尚未宣布进行大规模演习。美国智库分析，解放军“很可能正在进行一场模拟封锁台湾的大规模军事演习”，意在为实施实际的封锁行动做准备，并削弱台湾对其自身防卫能力的信心。
11月3日，台湾国安会秘书长吴钊燮通过社交媒体、公开中共海军与海警在台海及第一岛链周边的常态化和跨区军事部署。吴钊燮通过图文警示，截至目前，中共海军与中国海警已在西太平洋部署了超过100艘舰艇。
美国智库美国战争研究所(Institute for the Study of War)和美国企业研究所(AEI)随后跟进，两家智库在11月6日发布的报告指出，吴钊燮公布的数据显示，解放军海军与海警船主要集结在台湾与其主要盟友之间，呈现出模拟封锁行动的态势。
报告指出，其中第一支集结力量由来自解放军三个不同战区的四个特遣编队组成，活动于台湾与关岛之间，其中包括“辽宁号”航母打击群；第二支集结力量则包括至少六艘海警船及若干解放军海军舰艇，对台湾形成包围之势。
报告同时指出，11月2日的卫星图像显示，解放军海军最先进的“福建号”航母已离开位于海南三亚的基地，向正东方向航行，其航向可能指向台湾南部海域。
报告从这些部署的规模研判认为，解放军“很可能正在进行一场旨在模拟封锁台湾的大规模军事演习”。报告指出，此次行动所涉及的舰船数量及其部署的地理范围，均超过了中国人民解放军近期在台湾周边开展的“正义使命-2025”(Justice Mission 2025)演习。
战争研究所和美国企业研究所的联合研究项目“台湾防御联盟”(Coalition Defense of Taiwan)做出的评估认为，解放军近期在台湾周边及整个西太平洋地区的行动，很可能具有双重目的：既是在为实施实际的封锁行动做准备，同时也旨在营造某种信息效应，从而试图削弱台湾对其自身防卫能力的信心，并动摇其对盟友及伙伴提供支持能力的信任。
吴钊燮表示：“台湾始终保持高度警惕。我们绝不挑衅，但也绝不会向任何压力屈服。”
华盛顿智库大西洋理事会(Atlantic Council)全球中国中心(Global China Hub)副主任廖彦棻(Kitsch Liao)告诉美国之音(VOA)，他认为从解放军海军传统的年度训练周期看，本次解放军的部署本身多属例行，但是真正不同的有两点。
廖彦棻指出：“一是海警船随台湾所称的东部、北部、南部战区编队一同进入西太平洋，日本防卫省首度对外公布海警船伴随海军舰艇通过其周边海峡；二是山东舰大修、福建舰训练、辽宁舰部署，中国三艘航舰正形成类似美国‘维修—训练—部署’的轮替。”
廖彦棻表示，解放军海军此次行动传达出北京展示多战区海军编队在第一岛链外同时行动、海警与海军跨岛链联合行动，以及航舰经菲律宾南部海峡进入西太平洋的替代航线等方面的能力。
台湾淡江大学“国际事务与战略研究所”学者林颖佑在接受美国之音采访时表示，他认为中共海军此次集结并不是要去演练包围台湾，外界更应该观察的是中共海军的船舰在出海之后可能会有一些集结，他们在演练集结的动作和总体部署。
林颖佑告诉美国之音：“中共100多艘船舰出来，它们在演练的是一个化整为零的方式，去演练不同战区的船舰，在突破岛链之后去进行一个集结。”
战争研究所在11月6日发布的报告中指出，虽然中国尚未宣布进行任何大型军事演习。但中国或许有意将这些环绕台湾及部署在西太平洋的兵力活动呈现为“常态化”而非“特殊”行动。
此外，报告警告说，中国也可能希望展示其从和平状态迅速转入作战行动的能力，从而缩短对手察觉解放军为封锁或入侵台湾做准备的时间。
大西洋理事会的廖彦棻认为，除此之外，外界还应该警惕中国海警与战区的指挥体系。
廖彦棻指出，中国海警自2018年起转隶武警，直接受中央军委领导；这几年来海军的多次军事行动已经显示，海警与解放军已是联合任务编组。
廖彦棻告诉美国之音：“换言之，北京以海军训练的名义为掩护，实际上是三个战区在第一岛链外同时进行作战性质的部署，并把海警纳入其中，这意味着过去局限在台湾周边的海警、海军联合编组，已延伸到西太平洋，演练以‘执法’配合海军外层兵力孤立台湾。”
台湾军事与战略研究学者林颖佑表示，解放军此次行动再次提醒台湾要关注中共这种试图突破岛链的模式，再深入考虑是否去结合其它区域内国家的情况、展开跟这些国家的合作。
大西洋理事会的廖彦棻赞同这个观点。他告诉美国之音，美国印太司令部以及台湾、菲律宾等区域盟友，应把监侦重心向东延伸至菲律宾海、菲律宾南部海峡及日本西南诸岛，并在美、日、菲、台之间共享海域态势。
廖彦棻还强调，美国海岸警卫队可牵头与日、菲海巡单位联合巡逻；另外，美方也需审视年底航舰离开西太平洋所造成的航母空窗期。

title: 立陶宛据报要求台湾代表处更名，台湾：不予评论，目前无更名打算
summary: 资料照片：驻立陶宛台湾代表处摆放的台湾与立陶宛旗帜。(2022年1月20日) 台湾外交部星期二(11月10日)对有媒体报道称，立陶宛外交部曾在9月要台湾驻立陶宛代表处更名一事不予评论。台湾外交部次长陈明祺说，目前没有更名计划。不过有立陶宛议会外委会成员称，该国外交部官员要求台湾代表处更名的行为或涉违法，要求召开特别会议展开调查。 立陶宛网络媒体Delfi星期一报导，立陶宛外交部副部长维德曼塔斯·韦尔比茨卡斯(Vidmantas Verbickas)曾在9月24日递交一份非正式
content:
资料照片：驻立陶宛台湾代表处摆放的台湾与立陶宛旗帜。(2022年1月20日)
台湾外交部星期二(11月10日)对有媒体报道称，立陶宛外交部曾在9月要台湾驻立陶宛代表处更名一事不予评论。台湾外交部次长陈明祺说，目前没有更名计划。不过有立陶宛议会外委会成员称，该国外交部官员要求台湾代表处更名的行为或涉违法，要求召开特别会议展开调查。
立陶宛网络媒体Delfi星期一报导，立陶宛外交部副部长维德曼塔斯·韦尔比茨卡斯(Vidmantas Verbickas)曾在9月24日递交一份非正式文件给台湾驻立陶宛代表王雪虹，要求驻立陶宛台湾代表处在一个星期内更名。
报道说，该份文件称，驻立陶宛台湾代表处现行名称阻碍该国与台湾关系发展，要求台湾代表处在10月1日前更名；作为交换，立陶宛将提供台湾签署双边投资前景协议的机会，并启动避免双重课税及贸易协议谈判。此外，该文件也设想了在外交部内设立台湾事务特使一职的可能性。
Delfi另一篇报道说，在有关立陶宛外交部敦促台湾更改代表处名称一事被报道后，立陶宛议会外交事务委员会副主席、保守派议员齐吉曼塔斯·帕维奥尼斯(Zygimantas Pavilionis)要求召开委员会特别会议，以审查外交部长凯斯图蒂斯·布德里斯(Kestutis Budrys)的作为。
“今天，我将请求所有外交事务委员会成员召开一个特别会议来讨论部长的行动——我认为这个行动是违法的，”帕维奥尼斯星期一在其脸书上贴文中写道。
台湾外交部次长陈明祺星期一到立法院备询前接受媒体联访时针对立陶宛媒体关于台湾代表处更名一事的报道表示，他对外界传闻没有任何评论，“尤其是基于假消息的一些推论”，有伤台立双方的互动及双边关系。
“当初这个名称也是双方基于要深化双边关系之后，才做的这样一个决定，”陈明祺说，“我方目前没有任何打算要更动我国驻立陶宛代表处的名称。”
与此同时，立陶宛国家广播电视网(LRT)星期一报道，中国外交官预计11月11至12日访问立陶宛，与外交部官员和一些“寻求与北京恢复外交关系的议会成员会面”，议员伊格纳斯·韦盖莱(Ignas Vegele)上星期五宣布了此一计划中的访问。
报道提到今年6月才成为立陶宛总理的明道加斯·辛克维丘斯(Mindaugas Sinkevicius)曾表明，他希望年底前能在与中国的谈判中取得突破，“恢复大使级外交代表关系已被纳入其政府的施政项目中。”
根据报道，立陶宛外交部长凯斯图蒂斯·布德里斯星期一对媒体关于外交部要求台湾代表处改名一事的报道回应说：“我不会评论这个信息。首先，它被错误报道。我们与不同互动伙伴有各种讨论，我当然不会去谈细节。”
他说：“我可以证实的是，我们与台湾方面谈到双边关系的各种层面。”
报道说，立陶宛总理明道加斯·辛克维丘斯的发言人盖达斯·萨利加(Gedas Saylyga)星期一也告诉媒体，“正如政府纲领的规划，外交部的目标是将与中国的外交关系恢复到与其他欧盟国家相同的水平。总理想看到的是最后的结果，而不是对过程发表评论。”
“行动计划的选择是外交部长的责任。立陶宛旨在与台湾保持互利的经济与务实的合作，”萨利加补充道。
中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆6月曾对中国与立陶宛的关系表示，当前中立关系的困难和症结在于立方违反一个中国原则，背弃了立方在两国建交公报中的政治承诺。“中方同立方沟通的大门始终敞开”，希望立方尽早采取行动，“果断纠正错误”，回到一个中国原则的正确轨道上来，为中立关系正常化创造条件。
台湾政府2021年在维尔纽斯设立“驻立陶宛台湾代表处”，这是台湾在欧洲第一个以“台湾”，而非“台北”为名所设的代表处，立国为此面对有正式外交关系的北京当局强大压力，中国以召回大使作为抗议，将关系单方面降至“代办”级别，并对立陶宛施加经济报复。
台湾外交部发言人萧光伟星期二在台北的例行记者会上，针对媒体关于立陶宛以非正式文件要台湾代表处改名一事的提问表示，外交部对报道所称的文件及相关臆测不予评论。
他说，驻立陶宛台湾代表处的名称“是台立两国政府基于共享的普世价值，坚信民主、维护自由，以及共同深化双边关系的意愿，经审慎协商达成的共识。”
萧光伟指出，立陶宛总统吉塔纳斯·瑙塞达(Gitanas Nausėda)曾在今年10月27日表示，立陶宛推动与中国关系正常化“不应与台湾代表处名称直接挂钩”，此外，立陶宛总理明道加斯·辛克维丘斯也曾表示，有机会在不更改代表处名称的情况下改善与中国的关系。
萧光伟强调，自台湾与立陶宛互设代表处以来，台湾政府持续与该国历任政府推动经贸投资、科技产业、教育文化与人道援助等领域的实质合作，双方并共同投入资源持续推动援助乌克兰及重建合作计划，以具体行动支持乌克兰，实践民主前线国家面对威权国家扩张、捍卫民主自由价值的共同承诺。
台湾外交部呼吁民主伙伴坚守共同理念与原则，相互支持，携手因应威权国家的胁迫与挑战，台湾愿意与立陶宛在诚信、尊重、互助及互惠的基础上持续深化双边关系。

content:
香港政府向立法会通报非专营巴士行业发展情况 |中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 11 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港政府向立法会通报非专营巴士行业发展情况
香港政府于2026年11月11日向立法会表示，根据劳工计划，已有738名外地司机加入非专营巴士行业，并批准了535个配额续期。当局加大了对非法跨境租车的处罚力度，并正在努力增加停车位
香港 - 政府于 2026 年 11 月 11 日向立法会提供有关非专营巴士行业可持续发展、解决司机短缺、非法跨境租车和停车位短缺问题的详细最新情况。
截至2026年8月，香港共有7,559间持牌非专营巴士，在公共交通系统中发挥补充作用，提供旅游、酒店、学校及跨境服务。
在司机短缺方面，政府表示，其“运输业输入劳工计划 – 公共小巴/巴士界别”在2023年和2024年批准了800名巴士司机配额。截至2026年9月，已有738名输入司机完成培训和考试，驾驶本地巴士或跨境直达巴士。由于2025年底的配额到期，运输署已处理续约申请，截至2026年9月已批准535个配额续约。政府表示，正监察劳工市场并与持份者保持对话，同时亦实施本地招聘措施，包括放宽商用车辆牌照规定，以及将司机培训课程纳入持续进修基金。
关于非法跨境租车，政府表示，自2026年8月3日起加强处罚，根据《道路交通条例》（第374章），初犯的司机将面临至少12个月至最多3年的吊销驾照，最高可被罚款10,000港元和监禁6个月。车辆的驾照也可能被暂停六个月。运输署可撤销非法使用跨境车辆的封闭道路许可证。警方于2026年10月27日至11月9日进行定向执法，拘捕9名司机，并检获9辆香港注册跨境私家车。有关跨境车辆的信息已与内地当局共享。
在停车方面，截至 2026 年 8 月，不包括港铁安排，共有 4,766 个 NFB 停车位，每个停车位的车辆比例约为 1:0.65，政府将这一改善归因于短期、中期和长期措施。这些措施包括要求短期租赁停车场的最低商业车辆停车位数量、增加路边和过夜停车位、在政府和社区项目中提供公共停车位、鼓励学校为学生服务巴士开放停车位，以及根据香港规划标准和指引增加资助住房开发项目中的商业停车位。政府表示，已启动新一轮停车供需研究，特别是商用车停车供需研究，旨在于2027年提出措施，实现“商用车夜间停放”的目标。

Hong Kong government updates LegCo on non-franchised bus industry development | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 11 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong government updates LegCo on non-franchised bus industry development
The Hong Kong government told LegCo on 11 November 2026 that 738 imported drivers have joined the non-franchised bus sector under a labour scheme, with 535 quota renewals approved. Authorities have strengthened penalties for illegal cross-border car hires and are working to increase parking spaces f
HONG KONG – The government provided a detailed update to the Legislative Council on 11 November 2026 regarding the sustainable development of the non-franchised bus (NFB) industry, addressing driver shortages, illegal cross-border car hires, and parking shortages.
As of August 2026, there were 7,559 licensed NFBs in Hong Kong, playing a supplementary role in the public transport system by providing tourist, hotel, school and cross-border services.
On driver shortages, the government said its “Transport Industry Labour Import Scheme – Public Light Bus/Coach Sector” approved 800 coach driver quotas in 2023 and 2024. By September 2026, 738 imported drivers had completed training and tests and were driving local coaches or cross-border direct buses. As quotas from late 2025 expired, the Transport Department had processed renewal applications, approving 535 quota renewals by September 2026. The government said it is monitoring the labour market and maintaining dialogue with stakeholders, while also implementing local recruitment measures including relaxing commercial vehicle licence requirements and including driver training courses in the Continuing Education Fund.
Regarding illegal cross-border car hires, the government said penalties were strengthened from 3 August 2026, with drivers facing licence cancellation of at least 12 months and up to three years for a first offence under the Road Traffic Ordinance (Cap. 374), which carries a maximum fine of HK$10,000 and six months' imprisonment. Vehicles can also have their licences suspended for six months. The Transport Department may revoke closed-road permits for cross-border vehicles used illegally. The police conducted targeted enforcement from 27 October to 9 November 2026, arresting nine drivers and seizing nine Hong Kong-registered cross-border private cars. Information on involved cross-border vehicles is shared with mainland authorities.
On parking, as of August 2026 there were 4,766 NFB parking spaces, excluding MTR arrangements, giving a ratio of about 1:0.65 vehicles per space – an improvement the government attributed to short-, medium- and long-term measures. These include requiring minimum commercial vehicle parking numbers in short-term lease car parks, adding roadside and overnight parking bays, providing public parking in government and community projects, encouraging schools to open parking for student-service buses, and increasing commercial parking in subsidised housing developments under the Hong Kong Planning Standards and Guidelines. The government said it has started a new round of parking supply-demand study, particularly for commercial vehicles, aiming to propose measures in 2027 to achieve the goal of “commercial vehicles, parked at night”.

2023 年致命碰撞事件后，香港提出新法保护鲸鱼 |中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 11 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
2023年致命碰撞事件后，香港提出新法保护鲸鱼
继 2023 年发生鲸鱼被快速移动的船只杀死的事件后，香港政府提出了一项保护鲸鱼和海豚的法案。该法案将允许当局设立临时禁区，并赋予《海豚观赏行为准则》法律地位。
香港政府向立法会提出《2026年野生动物保护（修订）条例草案》，旨在加强对鲸目动物的保护。2023年7月，一头外地鲸鱼在香港水域死亡，该鲸鱼被快速移动的船只撞死，引起公众关注加强保护的必要性。
代理环境与生态部长在 2026 年 11 月 11 日对该法案进行二读时表示，2023 年的事件凸显了保护鲸鱼的必要性，鲸鱼经常吸引人群和船只，干扰或阻碍救援工作。该法案建议修订现行《野生动物保护条例》（第170章），授权渔农自然护理署（渔护署）署长采取措施保护鲸目动物和海上使用者。
根据建议的法例，渔护署署长在咨询海事处处长后，可将某些香港水域指定为“临时海上禁区”。这些区域将对人员、船只和活动实施限制或禁止，以防止公众追逐、骚扰或接近鲸目动物。指定该等地区及具体措施的公告将在渔护署网站上发布，并立即生效。
渔护署会与海事处及水警合作，在禁区巡逻及执法。不遵守授权人员的限制或指示将构成犯罪，一经定罪，可处以最高 50,000 港元的罚款（标准规模的第五级）。
该法案还提议赋予现有的《海豚观赏行为准则》法律地位，以更好地保护当地的海豚。如果通过，有关某人故意干扰海豚或违反守则的证据可在法庭上用于支持根据《野生动物保护条例》第 4 条提出的指控，该条例禁止故意干扰受保护的野生动物。
政府于2026年7月咨询立法会环境事务委员会及相关持份者，建议的修订获得广泛支持。代理秘书感谢成员们的意见，并敦促迅速通过该法案。

Wednesday, 11 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong proposes new law to protect whales after 2023 fatal collision
Hong Kong's government has introduced a bill to protect whales and dolphins following a 2023 incident where a whale was killed by a fast-moving vessel. The bill would allow authorities to create temporary restricted zones and give legal status to the Dolphin Watching Code of Conduct.
The Hong Kong government has introduced the Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Bill 2026 in the Legislative Council, aimed at strengthening protections for cetaceans following the death of a non-resident whale in Hong Kong waters in July 2023. The whale was killed after being hit by a fast-moving vessel, drawing public attention to the need for enhanced safeguards.
Speaking during the bill's second reading on 11 November 2026, the Acting Secretary for the Environment and Ecology said the 2023 incident highlighted the necessity of protecting whales, which often attract crowds and boats that can disturb or hinder rescue efforts. The bill proposes amendments to the existing Wildlife Protection Ordinance (Chapter 170) to authorise the Director of the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) to take measures to protect both cetaceans and maritime users.
Under the proposed legislation, the AFCD Director, after consulting the Director of Maritime Services, could designate certain Hong Kong waters as "temporary marine restricted areas." These zones would impose restrictions or prohibitions on persons, vessels and activities to prevent the public from chasing, disturbing or approaching cetaceans. Notices designating such areas and specifying measures would be published on the AFCD's website and take immediate effect.
The AFCD would work with the Marine Department and the Water Police to patrol and enforce the restricted areas. Failure to comply with the restrictions or instructions from authorised officers would be an offence, punishable upon conviction by a fine of up to HK$50,000 (level five on the standard scale).
The bill also proposes granting legal status to the existing Dolphin Watching Code of Conduct to better protect locally resident dolphins. If passed, evidence that a person deliberately disturbed dolphins, or that they violated the code, could be used in court to support charges under Section 4 of the Wildlife Protection Ordinance, which prohibits intentional interference with protected wild animals.
The government consulted the Legislative Council's Panel on Environmental Affairs and relevant stakeholders in July 2026, receiving broad support for the proposed amendments. The Acting Secretary thanked members for their input and urged swift passage of the bill.

content:
香港加强建筑监管，提高钢材缺陷处罚力度中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 11 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港加强建筑监管并加大对钢铁缺陷的处罚力度
在两个项目出现钢材缺陷后，香港政府概述了改善建筑监管的措施。新规定将要求在混凝土浇筑前对钢筋进行照片/视频记录，立法修正案将提高对违规行为的处罚力度。建筑事务监督也正在就此事进行咨询
香港政府最近在两个项目（包括赤鱲角的赤柱一号豪华住宅项目和观塘的安达臣道住宅开发项目）发现钢筋缺陷后，详细制定了一系列措施，以加强对建筑工程的监管。
政府在11月11日给立法会的书面回覆中表示，屋宇署已大致完成对赤柱一号私人屋苑一栋房屋的钢材质量问题的调查，发现部分钢网和钢筋配置与批准图则不符，而有关差异从未向屋宇署报告。该部门将就可能的起诉征求法律官员司的意见。
该部门已下令对同一庄园六个街区的其他 15 栋房屋和 12 个单位进行检查，要求开发商指定独立认可的实验室在部门监督下进行测试。如果发现违规行为，将采取执法行动。
新的监管规则将要求承包商在浇筑混凝土之前，用照片或视频记录所检查的结构部件的钢筋配置。这些记录必须由项目注册结构工程师属下的授权技术人员全面审阅，然后全部提交屋宇署进行抽查。混凝土浇筑后，承包商必须聘请经过认可的实验室对钢材进行取样，结果由工程师审查并提交给该部门。该部门正在就实施细节咨询业界，并计划在2027年1月之前推出强化措施。
在采购和分包方面，政府指出，对于公共工程，“双信封”系统首先评估技术能力，然后评估价格。过去三年，约40%的公共工程合同和超过60%的咨询合同没有授予最低投标人。公共工程合同禁止将整个合同分包，并限制特定范围的两级分包。公共工程已全面采用数字化工程监理系统，自2026年6月起，现场监理人员和承包商一线管理人员在检查时必须佩戴执法记录仪。
政府还宣布计划修订《建筑物条例》，建议将于本月晚些时候提交给发展委员会。修正案将包括大幅提高对严重偏离批准计划的最高罚款、简化纪律程序、通过要求专业从业人员接受续约面试评估和缩短承包商续约期限来收紧注册制度。政府也正在与建筑和工程领域的专业机构讨论方法

Hong Kong to tighten building supervision, hike penalties after steel defects | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 11 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong to tighten building supervision, hike penalties after steel defects
Hong Kong's government has outlined steps to improve building supervision after steel defects at two projects. New rules will require photo/video records of rebar before concrete pouring, and a legislative amendment will raise penalties for violations. The Building Authority is also consulting on th
The Hong Kong government has detailed a series of measures to strengthen oversight of building works following recent discoveries of steel reinforcement defects at two projects, including the One Stanley luxury housing estate in Chek Lap Kok and the Anderson Road residential development in Kwun Tong.
In a written reply to the Legislative Council on 11 November, the government said the Buildings Department has largely completed its investigation into steel quality issues at one house in the One Stanley private estate, finding that some steel mesh and rebar configurations did not match approved plans and that the discrepancies had never been reported to the department. The department will seek advice from the Law Officers Division on possible prosecutions.
The department has ordered checks on 15 other houses and 12 units across six blocks at the same estate, requiring the developer to appoint independent accredited laboratories to conduct tests under departmental supervision. If violations are found, enforcement action will follow.
New supervisory rules will require contractors, before pouring concrete, to record the steel reinforcement configuration of inspected structural components with photographs or video. These records must be fully reviewed by authorised technical personnel under the project's registered structural engineer, then submitted in full to the Buildings Department for random checks. After concrete is poured, contractors must engage accredited laboratories to sample the steel, with results reviewed by the engineer and submitted to the department. The department is consulting the industry on implementation details and aims to introduce the enhanced measures by January 2027.
On procurement and subcontracting, the government noted that for public works, a "double-envelope" system evaluates technical capability first, then price. Over the past three years, about 40 per cent of public works contracts and more than 60 per cent of consultancy contracts were not awarded to the lowest bidder. Public-works contracts prohibit subcontracting the entire contract and cap subcontracting at two tiers for specific scopes. A digital engineering supervision system has been fully adopted for public works, and since June 2026, site supervisory staff and contractor frontline managers must wear body cameras during inspections.
The government also announced plans to amend the Buildings Ordinance, with proposals to be submitted to the Development Committee later this month. The amendments will include significantly raising maximum fines for serious deviations from approved plans, streamlining disciplinary proceedings, and tightening the registration system by requiring professional practitioners to undergo interview assessments for renewal and shortening renewal periods for contractors. The government is also discussing with professional institutes in the building and engineering fields ways to share information to facilitate disciplinary action against misconduct and fraud.

据路透社报道，西北工业大学是中国“国防七子”精英国防大学成员之一，根据其网站上 10 月 21 日的采购记录，上个月以 874,700 元（123,000 美元）的价格购买了两块 H200 芯片。
清单 1 美国芯片制造商 Nvidia 就其首席执行官黄仁勋的婚外情展开调查
列表 2（共 3 个）谁来决定人工智能的移动速度？
list 3 of 3特朗普在与习近平的国宴上赞扬美中友谊
记录显示，该管理学院的芯片是从陕西博算网络科技有限公司购买的，而不是直接从英伟达购买的。
路透社调查之际，英伟达及其首席执行官黄仁勋在华盛顿特区面临越来越严格的审查，因为有报道称他成为中国间谍活动的目标，他游说放宽对中国销售人工智能芯片的限制。
H200 是 Nvidia 训练和运行先进人工智能系统最强大的芯片之一，并且需要获得美国出口许可证的批准，而西北工业大学等列入黑名单的机构通常会被拒绝获得出口许可证。
采购记录显示，西北工业大学今年还通过五份向中国公司租用计算能力的合同，购买了 H200 ‌‌芯片和其他强大的 Nvidia AI 处理器。
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋表示，美国继续向中国销售产品将保持美国的技术领先地位，并使中国客户继续依赖其技术。
然而，一些美国立法者表示，使用英伟达最强大的人工智能芯片可以加速中国用于武器设计、情报分析和军事现代化的人工智能系统的开发。
西北工业学院位于西北城市西安，从事与军用飞机、导弹和卫星相关的研究。
2001 年，华盛顿商务部将该大学列入其贸易黑名单（即“实体名单”），原因是该研究所涉嫌参与导弹扩散活动及其军事研究。华盛顿在 2019 年收紧了限制，在大多数情况下，向大学出口受管制的美国技术的许可证都受到拒绝政策的约束。
西北工业大学的采购表明，与军事有联系的中国机构如何继续通过国内供应商获得美国人工智能计算能力，要么直接购买芯片，要么租用包含芯片的服务器。
路透社对今年 26 家中国采购和企业记录的审查发现，大学和研究机构购买美国限制的 Nvidia 芯片，或通过国内供应商租用使用此类芯片的 Nvidia 支持的计算服务。
其中一些与中国的国防工业或军事研究有着密切的联系。
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府从 1 月份开始根据具体情况允许向中国出口部分 H200。但该政策并没有取消适用于西北工业大学等实体名单组织的单独限制。

【原文 English Original】
Chinese university buys Nvidia AI H200 chips despite US ban, records show | News | Al Jazeera
Share Chinese university buys Nvidia AI H200 chips despite US ban, records show on social media
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang speaks during a doorstep after attending the AI Ecosystem Reception in Tokyo, Japan [File: Manami Yamada/Reuters]
A Chinese university with ties to the army bought Nvidia’s powerful H200 AI chips last month despite being on a US export blacklist.
Northwestern Polytechnical University, a member of China’s “Seven Sons of National Defense” group of elite defence-focused universities, bought two H200 chips last month for 874,700 yuan ($123,000), according to an October 21 procurement record on its website, the Reuters news agency reports.

list 2 of 3Who gets to decide how quickly AI moves?
list 3 of 3Trump praises US-China friendship at state dinner with Xi Jinping
The chips were bought for its management school from Shaanxi Bosuan Network Technology rather than directly from Nvidia, the record showed.
The Reuters investigation comes as Nvidia and its CEO Jensen Huang face mounting scrutiny in Washington, DC, over his lobbying for looser ⁠⁠restrictions on sales of AI chips to China, following reports alleging he was targeted by a Chinese spying operation.
The H200 is among Nvidia’s most capable chips for training and running advanced AI systems and is subject to US export licence approvals, which are normally denied for blacklisted institutions such as Northwestern Polytechnical.
Northwestern Polytechnical also bought access this year to H200 ‌‌chips and other powerful Nvidia AI processors through five contracts for rented computing capacity from Chinese companies, procurement records show.
Nvidia CEO Huang has argued that continued US sales to China would preserve US technological leadership and keep Chinese customers reliant on its technology.
However, some US lawmakers say access to Nvidia’s most powerful AI chips can speed China’s development of AI systems for weapons design, intelligence analysis and military modernisation.
Based in the northwestern city of Xi’an, Northwestern Polytechnical conducts research related to military aircraft, missiles and satellites.
Washington’s Department of Commerce added the university to its trade blacklist, known as the Entity List, in 2001 over the institute’s alleged involvement in missile-proliferation activities, and its military research. Washington tightened the restrictions in 2019, making licences for exporting controlled US technology to the university subject to a policy of denial in most circumstances.
Northwestern Polytechnical’s purchases show how Chinese institutions with military ties continue to obtain US AI computing power through domestic suppliers, either by buying chips outright or renting access to servers containing them.
A Reuters review of 26 Chinese procurement and corporate records from this year found universities and research institutions buying US-restricted Nvidia chips or renting access to Nvidia-powered computing services ⁠⁠that use such chips through domestic suppliers.
Several had close links to China’s defence industry or military research.
US President Donald Trump’s administration began allowing some H200 exports to China on a case-by-case basis in January. But that policy did not lift the separate restrictions applying to Entity List organisations such as Northwestern Polytechnical.
Both Democrats and Republicans in the US Congress have urged stronger controls on China’s access to advanced AI ⁠⁠chips, such as chip-tracking requirements, and greater congressional oversight of exports.
This comes at a time of increased pressure on Nvidia’s Huang. Republican US Senator Kevin Cramer from the Senate Banking Committee called on Huang to step down as CEO after his intimate relationship with Alice Huang, accused of working for Chinese intelligence, plunged the company into crisis.
“The potential for extortion is so tremendous that something as sensitive as Nvidia chips, I ⁠⁠just think he’s got to go,” Cramer told Politico late on Tuesday.
Three Republican congressional committee chairmen have requested a briefing with Huang on November 18 over his reported contacts with the alleged Chinese intelligence operative.
Jensen Huang – who cofounded Nvidia, the world’s second-most valuable company after Apple, more than three decades ago – admitted on Sunday to being unfaithful to his wife, but the company said it has no reason to believe US national security or confidential information has been compromised.
Nvidia’s board announced an independent investigation on Sunday into whether the 63-year-old Taiwan-US dual national had been targeted by a foreign intelligence operation after media reports linking him to Alice Huang, a former executive at a Singapore-based data centre company.

content:
尽管美国限制出口，为何中国科技企业还是能用到英伟达提供的算力？图像来源: Dado Ruvic/REUTERS
（德国之声中文网）英伟达CEO黄仁勋承认自己有婚外情的事件还在不断发酵。据称其出轨对象是中国籍女高管，任职于总部设在新加坡的Megaspeed公司，而美国怀疑这家公司参与将人工智能芯片走私进入中国。
这一丑闻使外界再次关注一个问题：作为全球人工智能强国之一的中国，究竟是如何在美国出口限制之下获得最先进芯片的？
英伟达设计了一种最初用于处理电子游戏三维画面的先进元件，称为图形处理器（GPU）。
这种芯片拥有处理海量数据的能力，因此也被大规模用于训练和运行AI系统。
2022年ChatGPT的推出展示了人工智能的巨大潜力，引发了一场投资淘金热。各国政府和科技巨头竞相推进人工智能技术发展。
随着芯片订单不断涌进，英伟达的市值飙升至4.5万亿美元，目前与苹果（Apple）并列为全球最有价值的两家公司。
出于国家安全考虑，美国禁止向中国出口英伟达最先进的“Blackwell”和“Rubin”系列GPU，因为先进人工智能技术具有军事用途。
这项政策同时也有助于美国顶级人工智能实验室保持全球领先地位。
To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video
黄仁勋一直游说美国政府允许向中国出售英伟达芯片。他警告说，相关限制措施正在推动中国本土替代产品的发展壮大。
今年，美国放宽了此前被禁止出口、性能相对较低的“H200”芯片的限制，并规定美国政府可从销售额中获得25%的分成。
但美国设定的审批条件使相关出口许可难以获批。与此同时，随着中国本土芯片产业的发展，北京方面对采购H200芯片也并不积极。
此前路透社引述两位知情人士的消息称，约60万块英伟达先进人工智能芯片目前存放在香港，等待运往中国内地。尽管中国科技企业存在需求，但北京方面尚未批准这些芯片的大规模进口。
包括Moonshot AI（月之暗面）、Z.ai（智谱AI）以及DeepSeek（深度求索）在内的中国人工智能初创企业，近期相继推出高性能模型，进一步加剧了与美国同行之间的竞争。
市场研究机构Omdia首席分析师苏连杰（Lian Jye Su）向法新社表示：“尽管存在出口管制，中国企业仍在使用最先进的英伟达芯片来训练模型。”
很多中国科技企业都渴望获得英伟达的高性能芯片图像来源: CFOTO/picture alliance
这些芯片可能通过两种方式被中国企业获得：一是走私。科技媒体The Information去年12月报道称，DeepSeek训练其新模型时使用了数千枚先在海外拆解、随后运入中国的芯片。
当时DeepSeek没有回应置评请求。英伟达则向该媒体表示，他们没有看到此类走私行为的证据，并称这一说法“似乎不太可信”。
二是利用云计算的制度漏洞，即在第三国的数据中心租用搭载英伟达芯片的算力，这些国家通常位于东南亚。
投资基金Carthage Capital创始人Stephen Wu解释说：“美国的出口管制限制的是芯片被运往何处，而不是谁在使用它。”
这意味着英伟达的GPU完全可以安装在比如马来西亚柔佛州的数据中心内，且符合出口规定，而深圳的客户则可以远程登录并使用这些芯片的算力。
白宫顾问Michael Kratsios今年夏天表示，人工智能公司Moonshot AI曾通过泰国获得高端英伟达芯片资源。
美国还指责一些中国人工智能实验室利用美国模型训练自己的系统，以模仿其能力。
科技分析媒体Hello China Tech创始人赵博（Poe Zhao）表示：“英伟达芯片依然能让顶级AI研发工作更快、更容易完成，但它已经不再是唯一选择。”
他指出，问题在于成本。使用中国国产芯片训练模型通常需要更多时间，也需要更多工程优化工作。
To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video
华为目前是中国最主要的英伟达竞争对手。尽管中国制造的芯片正在快速进步，但是与这家美国巨头相比仍存在差距。
据报道，DeepSeek下一代重要人工智能模型将采用华为芯片进行训练。
华为今年9月宣布，其下一代人工智能芯片将于2027年第一季度问世，比原计划提前三个季度。
Stephen Wu认为，要提升国产芯片的整体性能，人工智能企业需要部署更多数量的芯片来弥补单芯片性能差距。
“他们付出的代价是更高的电力消耗和更高的总体成本，但他们可以负担得起，因为中国电价较低，而且这些芯片获得了政府补贴。”

一款符合美国出口管制的英伟达新显卡，在中国引发抢购潮，订单之多让英伟达都无法保证交货。中国科技巨头为何如此急切？

title: 特朗普至少两次被告知黄仁勋事件，仍邀其陪同访华
source: 纽约时报中文网 国际纵览
summary: MAGGIE HABERMAN, JONATHAN SWAN, JULIAN E. BARNES, ANA SWANSON, TRIPP MICKLE2026年11月11日 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在5月特朗普总统对北京进行国事访问期间。他最初并未被列入代表团名单，但在最后一刻应特朗普的邀请加入了代表团。 Kenny Holston/The New York Times 据知情人士透露，今年5月，特朗普总统在乘坐“空军一号”前往中国的途中被告知，美国获得了敏感情报，显示英伟达首
content:
MAGGIE HABERMAN, JONATHAN SWAN, JULIAN E. BARNES, ANA SWANSON, TRIPP MICKLE2026年11月11日
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在5月特朗普总统对北京进行国事访问期间。他最初并未被列入代表团名单，但在最后一刻应特朗普的邀请加入了代表团。 Kenny Holston/The New York Times
据知情人士透露，今年5月，特朗普总统在乘坐“空军一号”前往中国的途中被告知，美国获得了敏感情报，显示英伟达首席执行官与一名据信为中国间谍的女性有恋爱关系。
这一消息由国务卿兼国家安全顾问鲁比奥传达，时间就在英伟达掌门人黄仁勋应特朗普邀请加入总统访华行程前不久。这是在七个月内，总统至少第二次被告知有关黄仁勋与该女性有牵连的情报。
这次向特朗普的通报此前并未被报道，它与总统周一的说法相矛盾。特朗普当时称，在访华时他并不知道黄仁勋与该女性的关系。美国官员已认定该女性为中国国家安全部工作。
当在新闻发布会上被问及前去与中国领导人习近平举行峰会时是否知道黄仁勋与该女性的关系时，特朗普说：“不，我当时没听说。”
有关这段关系的披露震动了英伟达，并压低了其股价。此事使外界重新关注美中争夺人工智能主导权竞争的激烈程度——在这场竞争中，英伟达的先进芯片是美国当前保持优势的关键所在。这也再次凸显了黄仁勋对特朗普及政府在人工智能政策和对英伟达相关问题上的影响力。
今年5月，特朗普抵达北京时，黄仁勋与国务卿鲁比奥从“空军一号”上走下来。 Kenny Holston/The New York Times
自美国官员去年首次警告特朗普，与黄仁勋有婚外情的女性被认为为中国情报机构工作以来，特朗普一直淡化或无视这些担忧。据《纽约时报》上个月报道，去年晚秋首次听取该问题简报时，特朗普选择不采取任何行动。
周一，当被追问去年是否收到过有关该问题的简报时，特朗普表示他需要核实一下。特朗普一直将英伟达视为美国技术竞争力的关键，以及过去几年股市上涨的推动力。
“我当然会向情报人员核实，”他说。“他们可能提到过。当然，这对我没有产生多大影响。”
特朗普定于下周再次访问中国。他最初暗示可能再次邀请黄仁勋，但周一，他表示这位英伟达高管不会随行。
但总统继续大力为黄仁勋辩护，称他曾与黄仁勋谈过，并问他是否知道这个名为黄乐（音，其英文名为Alice Huang）的女性是间谍。特朗普说，黄仁勋表示自己并不知情。总统说，他并不打算在下周会见中国领导人习近平时提及此事。
“我只是非常了解黄仁勋，”特朗普周一说。“我只是认为他是一个非常正直的人。”
自有关英伟达高管与黄乐关系被披露以来，特朗普今年5月对中国的上次访问再次受到审视。黄乐曾是一家名为Megaspeed的新加坡公司的高管，该公司购买英伟达先进芯片。美国从2022年底开始限制直接向中国出售先进芯片，但仍允许中国公司在东南亚的数据中心租用这种算力，比如Megaspeed运营的数据中心。
在此行前几周，鲁比奥负责监督起草了一份关于黄仁勋的备忘录，并分发给少数政府高级官员。据一名知情人士说，这份备忘录并非为特朗普准备，也没有在“空军一号”上给他看。
鲁比奥今年5月在北京出席国宴时的照片。得知黄仁勋将随行出访时，他向特朗普总统简要汇报了关于黄仁勋的情报分析结果，但特朗普仍允许黄仁勋随行。 Kenny Holston/The New York Times
作为人工智能领域最关键人物之一的黄仁勋最初并未被列入5月赴华的商界和科技界领袖邀请名单。这一事实在特朗普离开美国前就已引发媒体关注。特朗普几乎未作任何预告，便邀请黄仁勋在“空军一号”于阿拉斯加进行空中加油停靠期间与之会面。鲁比奥是“空军一号”上的十多名政府官员之一。
一位因未获授权公开讨论此事而要求匿名的美国政府官员证实，当鲁比奥得知黄仁勋将在阿拉斯加加入行程时，他“就这一问题向总统作了简报”。
知情人士说，特朗普对国家安全顾问的汇报并未特别在意，仍然坚持接上黄仁勋的计划。
这名官员说，黄仁勋登上“空军一号”后“非常短暂地”见了总统，但“几乎整个行程都待在飞机的另一个区域”。
国务院拒绝置评。白宫新闻办公室被要求置评时，拒绝正式表态。该办公室通过电子邮件发送了一份背景声明，援引了特朗普周一的讲话。该邮件对本文报道提出异议，但没有详细说明。
在《纽约时报》上个月报道美国官员认定黄乐是中国情报人员、且与黄仁勋有恋爱关系后，英伟达高管和黄仁勋都坚称这段关系是与客户的日常接触。周日，黄仁勋承认与黄乐有恋爱关系。不久后，英伟达宣布公司将进行独立调查。
5月，特朗普与中国领导人习近平主席在天坛外合影。 Kenny Holston/The New York Times
早在特朗普2025年重返白宫之前，黄仁勋就长期主张更宽松的芯片销售政策。他的支持者经常指出，他公开表示，美国必须在人工智能竞赛中领先中国。在围绕人工智能全球风险分歧日益加剧之际，特朗普在很大程度上站在黄仁勋和其他科技高管及投资者一边。
今年早些时候，在一次投资者会议上，黄仁勋重申，中国不应获得英伟达的顶级产品，美国应该拥有“第一、最多和最好”。但他还说，“与此同时，所有美国公司都应该在全球竞争。”
目前不清楚鲁比奥去年春天的备忘录是否导致黄仁勋被排除在随后访华行程的初步邀请名单之外。
当时，总统正在考虑向中国开放销售英伟达最先进的Blackwell芯片。黄仁勋和其他一些主要科技领袖支持此举，尽管特朗普的许多顾问对此持反对意见。政府尚未批准向中国出售Blackwell芯片，但美国政府最终允许向获批买家出售较不先进的H200芯片。

content:
资料照片：民众在台北参与台湾非营利民防组织黑熊学院举办的急救训练。(2025年3月22日)
随着中国对台湾的压迫日益加剧，台湾执政的民进党立法委员这个星期在华盛顿呼吁美国及国际民主盟友，协助台湾提升民主及社会韧性，反制中国对台湾的各种威胁。有两名被中国制裁的代表团成员在分享个人经历时表示，面对中国威胁，最重要的是必须有“不能投降”的心态。
由民进党立法院党团总召集人蔡奇昌率领的代表团，这个星期在华盛顿与特朗普政府官员、跨党派国会议员和智库会面，就台海安全、美台经贸关系及地区局势交流看法。
星期五(7月24日)，代表团成员、两位立法院外交与国防委员会成员王定宇和沈伯洋在保守派智库哈德逊研究所，针对台湾如何以全社会动员应对中国威胁的做法，与该研究所高级研究院及中国中心主任余茂春进行对谈。
王定宇说，沈伯洋、他自己和哈德逊研究所有一个共同点，那就是他们都受到中国的制裁，尤其是沈伯洋还被列在中国的通缉名单上，但他认为“被那种专制政权制裁是一个荣耀”，台湾面对中国巨大威胁已经数十年，“即便我们只是要追求民主、自由、人权与平等这些东西。”
他说，对世界来说，台湾是重要的、有价值的，但对台湾人来说，那是他们的家园，必须保卫它。
“要保卫你的家园，你永远不能依赖别人的肩膀，那是我们自己的责任，即便你理解台湾的重要性。看看地图就知道它的战略重要性。无论谁让台湾站在他们那一边，谁就能主宰西太平洋。”
哈德逊研究所在2023年举办全球领导力奖晚会，邀请当时在美国纽约过境的时任台湾总统蔡英文参加，并颁给蔡英文“全球领导力奖”遭到北京当局制裁。
余茂春则是中国外交部在2022年以美方“借口所谓‘西藏人权’问题，对两名中方官员进行非法制裁”，因而遭到中国对他的反制裁措施。
沈伯洋说，他认为自己是因为成立黑熊学院，教导台湾一般民众如何自我防卫而遭到中国制裁，后来还将他列入通缉名单，甚至还公布他住所的卫星图，并宣布如果他到海外旅行将逮捕他。
“但我的回应是：我去买了一张机票是吧？我实际上还旅行到德国、荷兰、法国和韩国,而现在我人就在美国。我认为那就是我们对威权国家、他们的行动做出回应的方式。那也是我们应该与彼此团结的方式。”
沈伯洋说，他只是中国跨境镇压的一个例子，但有更多人都面临这种威胁，包括活动人士、人权捍卫者、记者，甚至一般民众，因为中国几个月前才通过《民族团结进步促进法》，许多人必须在中国这种法律战之下受到保护。
他说，中国制裁他和其他人的目的就是为了要他们噤声，要他们躲起来，但要反制这种制度性压迫最好的办法就是站出来，与政府、智库及非政府组织共同合作，寻找一种制度性方式来反制这种法律战。
他认为要应对中国的威胁，台湾必须从五方面来加强全社会韧性包括有专业的军队；强化基础设施，确保医疗、能源、粮食与水供应无虞，海底电缆受到保护；增强经济及供应链韧性；生存技能，如何止血、疏散和自卫技巧等；但最重要的是必须有“不能投降”的心态，那包括如何区分谣言与事实，因为在战争中网络会充斥着各种信息，民众必须有能力辨别什么才是事实。
北京当局正不断加大对被其视为领土一部分台湾的全面压力，不仅以军舰、军机在台湾周边海、空域活动，执行“联合战备警巡”，其海警和科研船也多次进入台湾限制水域，并开始到台湾东部海域进行所谓的“执法巡查”，要求往来外籍船只提供航行信息，并与台湾海巡发生对峙。这个星期，解放军在台湾海峡部分水域实施实弹射击，引来台湾政府的谴责，指其无预警实弹演习影响航行安全、破坏地区安全稳定。
台北拒绝北京的主权主张，面对中国这种非战争行为的灰色地带侵扰以及可能的封锁威胁，台湾政府也在加强提升整体及社会韧性。下个月，台湾将举行汉光42号年度演习，同时也将展开城镇韧性及防空演习，并在演习中首度新增网络战场景，教育民众对一旦台湾被封锁或遭到攻击时如何应对的知识和准备。
民进党立法院党团星期五在其社交媒体平台脸书上贴文说，代表团星期四在国会山与美国国会两党多位联邦参、众议员会面，除了感谢美国国会对台湾的支持外也就台海安全、民主合作、经贸发展及区域局势等议题进行交流，“展现民进党与美方跨党派友谊持续深化，彰显双方共同守护自由民主价值的坚定决心。”
贴文提到，与代表团会面的国会成员，包括共和党籍的众院议长麦克·强森(Mike Johnson)、众院外委会主席布莱恩·马斯特(Brian Mast)、联邦参议员比尔·哈格蒂(Bill Hagerty)，以及民主党籍的众院荣誉议长南希·佩洛西(Nancy Pelosi)。代表团还代表台湾总统赖清德，前往最近过世的参议员林赛·格雷厄姆(Lindsey Graham)办公室鲜花致意，感谢他生前长期对台湾民主、安全及美台关系的坚定支持。
访团成员除蔡奇昌、王定宇和沈伯洋外，还有党团副干事长陈培瑜及民进党政策会执行长吴思瑶。

content:
台湾代表处工作人员在政府下令关闭后离开巴布亚新几内亚 - 聚焦台湾
台湾代表处工作人员在政府下令关闭后离开巴布亚新几内亚
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
中新网台北11月11日电 台湾外交部周三表示，在接到关闭驻巴布亚新几内亚代表处的命令后，已开始撤回驻巴布亚新几内亚的所有外交和技术使团人员。
外交部在一份声明中表示，几名工作人员将留在巴布亚新几内亚，监督办事处的关闭，但所有其他外交人员和政府对外援助机构台湾国际合作发展基金的工作人员将离开。
外交部表示，将在海外社区事务委员会的支持下，安排驻周边国家的使馆和代表机构为巴布亚新几内亚的约100名台湾公民提供协助和领事服务。
公务车辆、设备等动产按照物业管理规定进行清查、拍卖、转让。
台湾上周五宣布关闭其1990年在巴布亚新几内亚设立的事实上的办事处。
据外交部称，这一决定是在巴布亚新几内亚政府最近再次单方面要求驻莫尔兹比港台北经济办事处人员离开该国之后做出的。
巴布亚新几内亚外交部在周五早些时候发表的一份声明中表示，其秘书埃利亚斯·沃亨古已向台湾驻华代表邱陈钰发出正式通知，要求他离开。
声明称，该部门给了邱和一等秘书李忠润7天的时间离开巴布亚新几内亚，而剩下的外交官潘绍俊将留下来，在一年内完成办公室关闭。
周五晚些时候，外交部发表声明称，将“考虑到国家尊严、外交自主和国家整体利益，在综合评估后”关闭驻外办事处，撤回所有驻扎人员，并对双边关系进行全面审视和调整。
巴布亚新几内亚外交部长贾斯汀·特卡琴科(Justin Tkatchenko)于7月16日首先要求台湾关闭其代表处，理由是台湾坚持“一个中国”政策。
尽管巴布亚新几内亚政府宣布立即关闭该办事处，但台湾坚称该办事处仍然开放和运作。
7 月晚些时候，台湾表示将暂停从巴布亚新几内亚现货购买液化天然气 (LNG)，以响应关闭其代表处的命令。

Taiwan representative office staff depart PNG after gov't-ordered closure
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Taipei, Nov. 11 (CNA) Taiwan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) said Wednesday it has begun withdrawing all diplomatic and technical mission personnel in Papua New Guinea (PNG) after being ordered to close its representative office.
Several staffers will stay in PNG to oversee the office's closure but all other diplomatic personnel and workers with the Taiwan International Cooperation and Development Fund, the government's foreign aid agency, will leave, MOFA said in a statement.
MOFA said it would arrange for embassies and representative offices in neighboring countries to provide assistance and consular services to the approximately 100 Taiwanese nationals in PNG, with support from the Overseas Community Affairs Council.
Official vehicles, equipment and other movable assets will be inventoried, auctioned or transferred in accordance with property management regulations, it added.
Taiwan announced the closure of its de facto office in PNG, established in 1990, last Friday.
According to MOFA, the decision came after the PNG government recently renewed its unilateral demands that personnel of the Taipei Economic Office in Port Moresby leave the country.
In a statement issued early Friday, PNG's Department of Foreign Affairs said its secretary, Elias Wohengu, had handed an official notice to Taiwan's representative to the country, Chiu Chen-yu (邱陳煜), demanding him to leave.
The statement said the department gave Chiu and First Secretary Lee Chung-nun seven days to leave PNG, while the remaining diplomat Pan Shao-jyun would remain to complete the office closure within a year.
Later Friday, MOFA issued a statement saying it would close the office, withdraw all stationed personnel, and conduct a comprehensive review and adjustment of bilateral ties "in consideration of national dignity, diplomatic autonomy, and overall national interests, and following a comprehensive assessment."
PNG Foreign Minister Justin Tkatchenko first demanded that Taiwan close its representative office on July 16, citing his country's adherence to the "one China" policy.
Despite the PNG government announcing the closure as immediate, Taiwan maintained that the office remained open and operational.
Later in July, Taiwan said it was suspending spot purchases of liquefied natural gas (LNG) from PNG in response to the order to close its representative office.

Nvidia’s crisis has corporate governance experts reaching for the popcorn
11:30 PM PST · November 10, 2026
Nvidia’s stock sank 5.47% on Tuesday, following a 4% drop on Monday, a loss of about 9.5% in two days, even though there wasn’t much news out of the company. CEO Jensen Huang has reportedly been trying to conduct business as usual after admitting to an extramarital affair with Alice Huang, whom U.S. intelligence agencies believe was spying for China. The biggest development: the board hired the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to conduct an internal investigation.
What comes next is mostly a guessing game, even for the people who study how boards are supposed to handle crises. Two corporate governance professors, Ann Lipton of the University of Colorado and Todd Henderson of the University of Chicago, say there is no real precedent for a CEO caught up in a suspected honeypot. And while they have views on what the investigation should ask, like everyone else, they’re watching to see how it plays out.
“There have actually been affair cases and sexual harassment cases,” Lipton said, but was quick to add that she doesn’t know of previous cases that also involve potential national security compromises. Henderson, whose research interests include corporations, securities regulation, and law and economics, said much depends on facts few people have yet, including, most importantly, what, if anything, Alice Huang got out of Jensen Huang. (Secrets about Nvidia’s fabs or chip designs would matter to the Justice Department. Ordinary corporate information probably would not.)
Lipton described the investigation led by Nvidia’s independent board members, with their own outside counsel, as perhaps the most “standard” aspect of the whole affair so far. She also observed that an investigation will be “exactly as thorough” as the directors running it want it to be, which is also standard. Henderson made a related point about incentives, saying that Washington law firms that conduct internal investigations “know who pays their bills.” He didn’t suggest that is happening here.
Lipton said she sees three lines of inquiry, including whether the law was broken, whether Huang violated Nvidia’s internal policies, and whether the board was misled, including how forthcoming he was and when he was on notice. It’s notable, as Wired reported Monday, that Huang hired a PR crisis firm known for handling sex scandals a full year ago. Of course, the driver could have been about the affair alone. It’s unclear when Huang learned Alice Huang was a suspected spy. The board said in a Sunday statement about the matter that Nvidia has “has no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised.”
Henderson similarly stressed the importance of what Huang knew and when. He described two scenarios. In one, Huang hires a PR firm because an extramarital affair is embarrassing, without knowing who the woman is. In the other, he knows she is a suspected Chinese spy. “I think that’s very different,” he said. “If I were a board member and the CEO of a company with very sensitive technology was in that situation, I would be furious if they didn’t tell me.” Not telling the board that you have cancer “or that you’ve been sleeping with a Chinese spy,” said Henderson, “seems to me to be a fireable offense.”
Either way, Lipton expects shareholder suits, and she said two kinds are possible. Securities fraud, which she said is “only about lying,” is the most obvious, and as we reported yesterday, Nvidia is already facing a proposed class action lawsuit that alleges Nvidia and Huang misled investors by describing the company’s Megaspeed dealings as routine. “You can have as many affairs with Chinese spies as you like,” Lipton said. “You just can’t lie about it under the federal securities laws.”
A mismanagement claim under Delaware law, where Nvidia is incorporated, is much harder. Employees do “stupid or reckless or damaging things all the time,” she said, and courts don’t let shareholders sue each time. Shareholders bringing such a claim on the company’s behalf, known as a derivative suit, must first show the board is incapable of handling the problem, usually by proving directors are implicated or so beholden to the CEO that they can’t act independently.
Nvidia’s 10-member board has a track record of loyalty and deference to Huang, as outlined by a New York Times piece Tuesday morning. Still, the investigation those “independent” directors have announced with outside counsel makes that very hard. Lipton cited, for example, a shareholder suit over alleged mismanagement at McDonald’s several years ago, after its chief people officer was accused of harassment and its CEO had a relationship with a subordinate. Ultimately, the court found no reason the board couldn’t deal with the misconduct on its own.
Even if none of this ends up threatening Huang’s job, the episode raises other governance questions that don’t look great in retrospect. Nvidia is run with a famously flat structure, with more than 60 direct reports to Huang, and the company doesn’t appear to have a succession plan, which Lipton called “a danger for any company.”
Huang’s children also work at Nvidia. His son Spencer is a director of product management, his daughter Madison is a senior director of product marketing, and his son-in-law, Nico Caprez, works in business development. Some employees believe he is grooming successors, and asked last month by Bloomberg whether Madison is in line for the job, Huang didn’t shoot down the idea, saying instead that it’s not something he’d wish on her.
Lipton called hiring the kids poor corporate hygiene, even though founders have long done it. (Kimbal Musk is on Tesla’s board because he’s Elon Musk’s brother, she noted.) Directors are supposed to act only for stockholders, but founders get more rope as long as the company is thriving.
Henderson similarly calls himself a strong “anti-nepotism person,” sharing that when his father worked at Westinghouse’s nuclear research lab, there was an absolute ban on hiring employees’ children. “Like, fine for them to be working there,” he said of Huang’s children working at Nvidia. But “the idea that one of his kids would succeed him” at a publicly traded company the size of Nvidia “seems crazy,” he added.
What Nvidia may have gotten more right, from a governance standpoint, is what it doesn’t have, which is dual-class shares. Huang reportedly owns about 3.6%, so he doesn’t control the vote. That makes him “easier to dislodge,” Lipton said, even though he is deeply integrated into the company in other ways. Neither professor is rooting for or against Huang, each made clear. The simple truth is that with voting control on top of Huang’s holdings, the board would have even less flexibility. Without it, the board has a few more options.

title: HKFP Lens: Hong Kong LGBTQ+ groups stage ‘Rainbow Strength’ fitness contest after Pride market venue axed
zh_title: HKFP镜头：骄傲市场场地被毁后，香港LGBTQ+团体举办“彩虹力量”健身比赛
summary: 香港的 LGBTQ+ 团体举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的包容性健身活动，此前他们的年度骄傲市场连续第二年面临场地取消的问题，这再次引发了人们对香港城市空间日益缩小的担忧。在彩虹街市突然撤出场地后，香港骄傲委员会于 2026 年 11 月 7 日举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的健身比赛。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。香港骄傲委员会周六宣布，由 16 名不同性别认同和性取向的参与者参加的健身比赛如期举行。
content:
香港的 LGBTQ+ 团体举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的包容性健身活动，此前他们的年度骄傲市场连续第二年面临场地取消的问题，这再次引发了人们对香港城市空间日益缩小的担忧。在彩虹街市突然撤出场地后，香港骄傲委员会于 2026 年 11 月 7 日举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的健身比赛。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。香港同志骄傲委员会周六宣布，由 16 名不同性别认同和性取向的参与者参加的健身比赛按计划进行，标志着今年同志骄傲活动的正式启动。在彩虹街市突然撤出场地后，香港骄傲委员会于 2026 年 11 月 7 日举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的健身比赛。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “彩虹力量”是在原定于本月举行的“彩虹市场”因中央市场突然取消场地预订而取消后举行的。场馆经理华懋集团将此举归因于“预订重叠”，并就这一错误表示歉意，并承诺全额退款。在彩虹街市突然撤出场地后，香港骄傲委员会于 2026 年 11 月 7 日举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的健身比赛。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。
骄傲委员会在一份声明中表示，对健身比赛的成功举办深表感谢，并指出近年来大型 LGBTQ+ 权益活动“遭遇挫折”。 在彩虹街市突然撤出场地后，香港骄傲委员会于 2026 年 11 月 7 日举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的健身比赛。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。委员会表示：“我们相信，大型LGBTQ+维权活动的成功举办，让香港展现出多元化、包容性的国际城市形象，是讲述香港故事的重要组成部分。”在彩虹街市突然撤出场地后，香港骄傲委员会于 2026 年 11 月 7 日举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的健身比赛。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。健美比赛于观塘室内场地举行，分“沙滩短裤”、“运动装”及“比基尼”三个组别。在彩虹街市突然撤出场地后，香港骄傲委员会于 2026 年 11 月 7 日举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的健身比赛。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。组织者表示，对参赛者的评估标准包括体格和舞台表现，评审的方式促进性别多样性和相互尊重。在彩虹街市突然撤出场地后，香港骄傲委员会于 2026 年 11 月 7 日举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的健身比赛。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。
该委员会补充说，参赛者来自香港和海外。 在彩虹街市突然撤出场地后，香港骄傲委员会于 2026 年 11 月 7 日举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的健身比赛。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。代表香港参加亚运会的前香港健美队队员黄安迪率领五人小组担任比赛的裁判。在彩虹街市突然撤出场地后，香港骄傲委员会于 2026 年 11 月 7 日举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的健身比赛。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。委员会还表示，彩虹市场将于本月晚些时候作为独家活动举行

【原文 English Original】
LGBTQ+ groups in Hong Kong have staged an inclusive fitness event dubbed “Rainbow Strength,” after their annual Pride market faced venue cancellations for a second consecutive year – renewing concerns over dwindling civic space in the city. The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The Hong Kong Pride Committee announced on Saturday that the fitness contest – featuring 16 participants across various gender identities and sexual orientations – went ahead as planned, marking the launch of this year’s Pride festivities. The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “Rainbow Strength” took place after the “Rainbow Market,” originally scheduled for this month, was scrapped following the sudden cancellation of its venue booking at Central Market. Venue manager Chinachem Group attributed the move to a “booking overlap” and apologised for the mistake, pledging a full refund. The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. In a statement, the Pride Committee said it was deeply grateful that the fitness contest was successfully held, noting major LGBTQ+ rights events “have run into setbacks” in recent years. The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “We believe that the successful staging of large-scale LGBTQ+ rights events allows Hong Kong to present itself as a diverse and inclusive international city, and is an important part of telling Hong Kong’s story,” the committee said. The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The fitness competition, held at an indoor location in Kwun Tong, consisted of three divisions: “Beach Shorts,” “Sportswear,” and “Bikini.” The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Organisers said contestants were evaluated on criteria including physique and stage presence, with the judging conducted in a way that promoted gender diversity and mutual respect. The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Contestants hailed from Hong Kong and overseas, the committee added. The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Andy Wong, a former member of the Hong Kong bodybuilding team who represented the city at the Asian Games, led a five-member panel to adjudicate the competition. The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The committee also said that the Rainbow Market would be held later this month as an exclusive event for its members following the venue cancellation, with details to be announced on social media platforms. The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The committee comprises four local LGBTQ+ groups: Les Corner Empowerment Association, Rainbow of Hong Kong, the Association for Transgender Rights, and Made in Gender. The groups organised the city’s first Pride Parade in 2008, with the last parade held in 2018. See also: Timeline: Hong Kong civil society’s mysteriously axed venue bookings The committee was denied approval for a march in 2019 over safety concerns and held a static rally instead . The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The following year, the parade went online due to Covid-19 restrictions. The organisers began adapting their annual Pride Parade into an indoor market event in 2021, owing to what they described as “changes in the social environment.” The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Last year, organisers booked the Kwun Tong Promenade for the Rainbow Market, but the booking was abruptly axed. The event was instead held at another indoor venue . In September last year, Hong Kong’s legislature voted down a bill to establish legal recognition for same-sex partnerships , dealing a major blow to the city’s LGBTQ+ rights movement.

title: FACT CHECK: Unrelated audio used in video of crowd mocking VP Sara in Hong Kong
zh_title: 事实核查：香港人群嘲笑副总统萨拉的视频中使用了不相关的音频
summary: 声称：一段视频显示，在副总统萨拉·杜特尔特访问香港期间，海外菲律宾工人（OFW）高喊着一首歌词为“Sara Sara Magnanakaw”（萨拉，萨拉是小偷）的歌曲。评级：错误 我们为何对此进行事实核查：这一说法出现在 11 月 8 日由多个页面和帐户在多个 Facebook 帖子中共享的视频中，其中包括： 来自“Pro Filipinas”页面的帖子，截至撰写时约有 25,400 条反应、7,400 条评论、4,200 次分享和 700,000 次浏览 来自帐户“Nhenz Ros”的帖子，约有 10,500 条反应， 3,100 条评论，1,700 条分享，269 条
content:
声称：一段视频显示，在副总统萨拉·杜特尔特访问香港期间，海外菲律宾工人（OFW）高喊着一首歌词为“Sara Sara Magnanakaw”（萨拉，萨拉是小偷）的歌曲。评级：错误 我们为何对此进行事实核查：这一说法出现在 11 月 8 日由多个页面和帐户在多个 Facebook 帖子中共享的视频中，其中包括： 来自“Pro Filipinas”页面的帖子，截至撰写时约有 25,400 条反应、7,400 条评论、4,200 次分享和 700,000 次浏览 来自帐户“Nhenz Ros”的帖子，约有 10,500 条反应，截至 11 月 8 日，“Yayam Dizon”账户、“Anna Belle”账户、“Kakawad Joey”页面和“Venus Domingo Dugam”页面有 3,100 条评论、1,700 次分享和 269,000 次浏览。事实：显示一群人似乎称杜特尔特为小偷的视频使用了来自不同且不相关来源的音频：7 月 6 日在 Abante News Online 的 YouTube 频道和 Facebook 页面上发布的标题为“Sara，Sara magnanakaw”的视频。阿班特新闻在线视频显示，抗议者在参议院大楼前以相同的语气高喊完全相同的歌词。 7月6日是杜特尔特弹劾审判的第一天。 （阅读：法庭内：萨拉·杜特尔特弹劾审判的第一周）杜特尔特在香港与海外菲劳会面的其他视频并没有显示人群唱这首歌。
根据副总统办公室发布的一份声明，杜特尔特于 11 月 6 日至 8 日前往香港“出席活动并参加各种活动，包括菲律宾社区组织的活动”。 弹劾审判最新消息：副总统的弹劾审判在中断近一个月后于 11 月 9 日星期一恢复。目前轮到由律师 Sheila Sison 领导的辩方出示证据和证人。 （阅读：萨拉·杜特尔特审判：辩方开始出示证据）10 月 13 日，即休庭前的最后一次审判日，检方撤销了针对杜特尔特的四项弹劾条款中的三项——涉嫌滥用机密资金、贿赂和严重威胁的条款——只留下不明财富案以加快诉讼程序。 11月5日，参议院弹劾法庭确认承认检方针对杜特尔特的证据，驳回了辩方关于检方文件证据的可采性和相关性的反对意见。
（实时更新：对副总统萨拉·杜特尔特的弹劾审判）之前的相关事实核查：Rappler 对大量包含音频的视频进行了事实核查，后来确定这些视频叠加在不相关的视频上，例如以下事实核查： 事实核查：视频中的“杜特尔特”口号被操纵，而不是在荷兰拍摄（2025 年 3 月 13 日）事实核查：杜特尔特的口号在视频中捏造Alyansa 石板集会（2025 年 2 月 20 日） 事实核查：教皇方济各访问东帝汶的视频中编造了“杜特尔特！”的口号（2024 年 9 月 16 日） MANIPULADONG BIDYO：Kinanta ang isang UniTeam 圣歌 sa BTS 音乐会（2022 年 3 月 23 日） 错误：宿雾人尖叫“操你” Bongbong Marcos 在访问期间（2021 年 10 月 26 日）Rappler 还对有关杜特尔特正在进行的弹劾审判的几项虚假指控进行了事实核查。– Percival Bueser/Rappler.com Percival Bueser 是 Rappler 事实核查导师计划的毕业生。该事实核查由 Rappler 研究团队的一名成员和一名高级编辑进行了审查。了解有关 Rappler 事实核查指导的更多信息

【原文 English Original】
Claim: A video shows overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) chanting a song with the lyrics “ Sara Sara Magnanakaw ” (Sara, Sara is a thief) during Vice President Sara Duterte’s visit to Hong Kong . Rating: FALSE Why we fact-checked this: The claim appears in a video shared in multiple Facebook posts on November 8 by various pages and accounts, including the following: A post from the page “Pro Filipinas,” with around 25,400 reactions, 7,400 comments, 4,200 shares, and 700,000 views as of writing A post from the account “Nhenz Ros,” with around 10,500 reactions, 3,100 comments, 1,700 shares, and 269,000 views as of writing Posts on November 8 from the account “Yayam Dizon,” the account “Anna Belle,” the page “Kagawad Joey,” and the page “Venus Domingo Dugam.” The facts: The video showing a crowd seemingly calling Duterte a thief used audio from a different, unrelated source: a video titled “ Sara, Sara magnanakaw ” posted on July 6 on the YouTube channel and Facebook page of Abante News Online.  The Abante News Online video showed protesters chanting the exact same lyrics and in the same tone in front of the Senate building. July 6 was the first day of Duterte’s impeachment trial. (READ: Inside the courtroom: Week 1 of Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial ) Other videos from Duterte’s meeting with OFWs in Hong Kong do not show the crowd singing the song. Duterte traveled to Hong Kong from November 6 to 8 “to attend engagements and participate in various activities, including an event organized by the Filipino community,” according to a statement released by the Office of the Vice President. Impeachment trial updates: The impeachment trial of the Vice President resumed on Monday, November 9, following a nearly monthlong break. It is currently the turn of the defense, led by counsel Sheila Sison, to present its evidence and witnesses. (READ: Sara Duterte trial: Defense begins presentation of evidence ) On October 13, the last trial date before the break, the prosecution dropped three of the four Articles of Impeachment against Duterte — the articles on alleged confidential fund misuse, bribery, and grave threats — leaving only the unexplained wealth case to expedite the proceedings.  On November 5, the Senate impeachment court confirmed admitting the prosecution’s evidence against Duterte, overruling the defense’s objections regarding the admissibility and relevance of the prosecution’s documentary evidence. (LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte ) Previous related fact-checks: Rappler has fact-checked numerous videos containing audio later determined to be superimposed on unrelated video, such as in the following fact-checks: FACT CHECK: ‘Duterte’ chants in video are manipulated, not taken in Netherlands (March 13, 2025) FACT CHECK: Duterte chants fabricated in video of Alyansa slate rally (February 20, 2025) FACT CHECK: ‘Duterte!’ chants fabricated in video of Pope Francis’ East Timor visit (September 16, 2024) MANIPULADONG BIDYO: Kinanta ang isang UniTeam chant sa BTS concert (March 23, 2022) FALSE: Cebuanos scream ‘Fuck you’ at Bongbong Marcos during his visit (October 26, 2021) Rappler has also fact-checked several false claims regarding Duterte’s ongoing impeachment trial . – Percival Bueser/Rappler.com Percival Bueser is a graduate of Rappler’s fact-checking mentorship program. This fact check was reviewed by a member of Rappler’s research team and a senior editor. Learn more about Rappler’s fact-checking mentorship program here . title: 美国海军退伍军人秦伟平正式宣布参选Katy ISD学区董事：从军旅服役到教育公共治理，提出SMART五大教育纲领
summary: 纵览中国｜美国德克萨斯州Katy市｜2026年11月11日 美国海军退伍军人、美国邮政服务（USPS）职业雇员、公共管理硕士（MPA）候选人秦伟平（Weiping “George” Qin）于2026年11月11日美国退伍军人节正式宣布参选美国德克萨斯州Katy独立学区（Katy Independent School District，简称Katy ISD）董事会第六选区（Position 6），计划参加2027年5月1日举行的学区董事会选举。 秦伟平通过其官方X（原Twit
content: 纵览中国｜美国德克萨斯州Katy市｜2026年11月11日 美国海军退伍军人、美国邮政服务（USPS）职业雇员、公共管理硕士（MPA）候选人秦伟平（Weiping “George” Qin）于2026年11月11日美国退伍军人节正式宣布参选美国德克萨斯州Katy独立学区（Katy Independent School District，简称Katy ISD）董事会第六选区（Position 6），计划参加2027年5月1日举行的学区董事会选举。 秦伟平通过其官方X（原Twitter）、Facebook及Substack等平台发布中英文正式竞选公告，并同步公布竞选团队新闻通稿及五大教育政策方向。他提出以 SMART Education Agenda（SMART教育纲领） 为核心的竞选框架，涵盖学生学业成就、学生支持、教师招聘与留任、财政管理，以及学区透明度和社区信任等议题。 秦伟平选择在退伍军人节宣布参选，将个人的海军服役经历与继续服务社会、参与地方教育公共事务的意愿联系起来。其竞选口号为： “Served Our Country. Defending Our Classrooms.” 中文表述为： “军旅报国，教育为民。” 此次公告标志着秦伟平此前持续进行的竞选筹备工作进入正式公开阶段，也使其个人经历、教育理念和地方公共治理主张开始集中呈现于公众面前。 一、退伍军人节宣布参选：公共服务从军旅延伸到社区 秦伟平在竞选公告中表示，公共服务不会随着军旅生涯的结束而终止，而是可以继续体现在对家庭、社区和下一代的责任与承诺之中。 据竞选团队提供的个人资料，秦伟平曾在美国海军服役，服役期间获得海军与海军陆战队成就奖章（Navy and Marine Corps Achievement Medal）以及军队杰出志愿服务奖章（Military Outstanding Volunteer Service Medal），以表彰其服役表现和志愿服务贡献。 在美国海军服役期间，他曾在舰艇供应部门工作，参与海军舰艇后勤保障任务，并取得航空作战专业资格（Enlisted Aviation Warfare Specialist，EAWS）和水面作战专业资格（Enlisted Surface Warfare Specialist，ESWS）。 这些经历构成了其个人介绍中关于军事训练、团队协作和公共服务的重要部分。 结束军旅服役后，秦伟平继续加入美国邮政服务系统（United States Postal Service，USPS），从事公共服务工作。 据竞选团队提供的资料，他曾在Katy邮局担任城市邮递员助理（City Carrier Assistant，CCA），负责邮件投递和当地社区服务。目前，他是USPS正式职业雇员，在Fulshear邮局担任邮政业务职员（Clerk）。 从海军后勤保障到邮政系统的日常运营，两段工作经历虽然属于不同领域，但都与公共服务和服务对象的实际需求密切相关。 秦伟平在竞选声明中表示，希望将海军服役期间形成的纪律意识、团队合作精神和责任担当，以及在联邦公共服务岗位上积累的工作经验，带入地方教育公共事务。 二、三个Katy ISD学生的父亲：从家长身份关注公共教育 除了军事和公共服务经历，秦伟平的另一个身份是Katy社区居民，也是三名正在Katy ISD就读学生的父亲。 对于当地家庭而言，学校教育质量、教师队伍稳定性、校园安全、特殊教育资源和学区财政安排，都是与日常生活密切相关的公共事务。 作为学生家长，秦伟平表示，他不仅关注自己孩子的教育环境，也希望学区能够关注整个社区不同家庭、不同学习需求以及不同学生群体的实际情况。 他的竞选公告强调，学区应该倾听家长意见，尊重教师和学校工作人员，合理使用纳税人的资金，并通过透明度和公共问责机制建立社区信任。 从其公开提出的政策方向来看，秦伟平希望将家长的实际体验与学区治理层面的讨论联系起来，使学生发展、教师支持和公共财政管理成为相互关联的议题。 三、从学生会主席到设立奖学金：教育经历与校园领导实践 秦伟平的教育背景和校园领导经历，也是此次竞选团队新闻通稿重点介绍的内容。 据竞选团队提供的履历资料，秦伟平曾就读于马里兰州哈福德社区大学（Harford Community College），并于2019年当选该校学生会（Student Government Association，SGA）主席。 2021年，他在该校设立了“秦伟平自由奖学金”（Weiping Qin Freedom Scholarship）。据竞选团队介绍，该奖学金旨在支持学生领袖以及具有军队服役经历的学生。 2023年，他获得哈福德社区大学颁发的杰出校友奖（Distinguished Alumni Award）。竞选团队将这一荣誉归因于其个人成就以及对学校和社区的贡献。 在高等教育方面，据其提供的个人履历，秦伟平先后获得哈福德社区大学工商管理副学士学位及会计证书，随后取得马里兰大学全球校区（University of Maryland Global Campus，UMGC）管理研究理学学士学位和工商管理硕士（MBA）学位。 目前，他正在金门大学（Golden Gate University，GGU）攻读公共管理硕士（Master of Public Administration，MPA）学位。 从学生会领导经历、奖学金设立，到继续学习工商管理和公共管理，秦伟平的教育背景涉及学生组织、商业管理和公共部门治理等多个领域。 对于一名地方学区董事候选人而言，这些经历也构成其公开介绍个人教育理念和公共管理兴趣的背景。至于如何将这些学习与实践经验转化为具体的学区政策，仍有待其在后续竞选活动中进一步阐述。 四、了解Katy ISD：近9.5万名学生、1.36万名教职员工的教育系统 要理解秦伟平此次竞选的公共事务背景，有必要先了解Katy ISD的规模，以及其董事会在当地教育体系中所承担的职责。 Katy ISD是美国德克萨斯州休斯敦西部地区的重要公立学区之一。根据德克萨斯州教育厅（Texas Education Agency，TEA）公布的2025—2026学年学区资料，截至2026年11月公布的最新统计，该学区共有 95,136名在校学生、78所学校 ，全职教职员工约13,601人，其中全职教师约6,934人。 这一规模意味着，Katy ISD不仅是一个服务近十万名学生的公共教育系统，也是当地规模较大的公共服务机构之一。其教育政策、财政预算和学校资源配置，直接关系到大量学生、家长、教师及社区居民。 从学生构成来看，TEA数据显示，2025—2026学年Katy ISD学生中，约43.3%属于经济条件相对困难群体，19.2%接受特殊教育服务，24.0%属于英语学习者（Emergent Bilingual Students）。 这些比例反映出学区内部学生需求具有多样性。不同学生在语言学习、特殊教育、学业支持和家庭资源方面可能面临不同情况，也使得教育资源分配和学生支持政策成为学区治理的重要议题。 TEA公布的同一学年资料还显示，Katy ISD的师生比例约为13.7名学生对应一名教师，教师平均年薪约为73,094美元。该学区在2025—2026学年的州级学区问责评级为B，得分88分（满分100分）。 从地理范围来看，根据Katy ISD官方网站介绍，学区覆盖面积约为181平方英里，服务范围涉及Harris、Fort Bend和Waller三个县。需要注意的是，Katy ISD的学区边界并不等同于Katy市的行政边界，其服务范围延伸至Katy市及周边多个社区。 因此，讨论Katy ISD的学生规模和公共服务范围时，应当以学区实际统计为依据，而不能简单将Katy市的人口数字等同于学区人口。 五、年度预算约14.8亿美元：教育资源与纳税人责任 Katy ISD的财政规模同样值得关注。 根据学区2026年8月24日公布的2026—2027财政年度预算信息，董事会批准了约 11.7亿美元的一般运营基金预算（General Operating Fund） 。加上食品服务及债务偿还等其他基金，学区年度总预算约为 14.8亿美元 。 学区公布的信息显示，约83%的预算支出用于学生教学、课堂运营和学生支持。这些资金涉及教师及学校工作人员薪酬、教学活动、学生服务和学校日常运行等重要领域。 与此同时，学区公布的2026—2027年度预算预计存在约2,570万美元的运营赤字。学区方面表示，过去三个已经审计的财政年度，虽然最初均采用赤字预算，但最终通过节约开支、控制实际支出及提高运营效率等措施，实现了年度预算平衡，并增加了基金余额。学区管理层预计2025—2026财政年度也有望延续这一趋势。 在税收方面，学区公布的2026—2027年度拟议综合税率为每100美元应税财产估值1.1171美元，与上一年度保持一致。该税率包括一般运营税率和债务偿还税率。 这些数字说明，学区董事会所涉及的并非单纯的教育理念讨论，还包括规模庞大的公共财政管理工作。 如何在保障教学质量、支持教师队伍、满足特殊教育需求、维护校园设施和控制纳税人负担之间取得平衡，是学区治理长期面对的议题。 这也与秦伟平此次提出的SMART教育纲领中的“R——Responsible Financial Management（负责任的财政管理）”以及“T——Transparency & Community Trust（透明度与社区信任）”两项政策方向直接相关。 六、Katy ISD董事会：七名民选成员共同承担学区治理职责 Katy ISD董事会（Board of Trustees）是学区的政策制定和公共监督机构，由七名董事组成。 根据Katy ISD官方网站，董事通过选举产生，每人任期三年，采取轮换选举方式。董事会成员不领取董事职务薪酬，候选人虽然以不同选区或席位参加选举，但当选后代表整个学区履行职责。 根据德克萨斯州教育厅对公立学区董事会职责的说明，以及Katy ISD公布的董事会制度，董事会主要负责： 制定学区政策和长期发展目标； 聘用、监督并评估学区总监（Superintendent）； 审议和批准年度预算及地方税率； 对学区财务、教育质量和整体管理进行监督； 通过正式董事会会议审议公共教育事务。 需要特别说明的是，学区董事并不直接负责每所学校的日常教学和行政管理。学校日常运营主要由学区总监及其管理团队负责，董事会则通过政策制定、预算批准、目标设定和管理监督履行职责。 此外，董事会作为一个集体机构作出正式决策，单独一名董事不能自行代表整个董事会作出决定。 这一制度安排意味着，学区董事并不是学校的日常行政管理人员，而是代表公众参与公共教育治理的民选代表。 对于即将参加Position 6选举的秦伟平而言，未来如果当选，其职责将不仅涉及自己所在选区的家庭，也将涉及整个Katy ISD学区的公共教育事务。 因此，学生学业表现、教师招聘与留任、特殊教育资源、学区预算、债务管理、学校设施规划以及家长参与机制，都属于与董事会职责密切相关的政策议题。 七、SMART教育纲领：五个方向回应学区治理议题 此次竞选公告最重要的政策内容，是秦伟平正式提出的SMART Education Agenda。 SMART由五个英文关键词的首字母组成，也是其竞选团队用来概括五大教育优先事项的整体框架。 S — Student Success & Academic Excellence 学生成就与学术卓越 秦伟平提出，应当巩固学生在阅读、数学及其他核心学科方面的基础，扩大STEM（科学、技术、工程与数学）教育机会，并提升学生在大学升学和职业发展方面的准备能力。 这一方向强调，学校教育不仅要关注学生是否完成课程，更应关注实际学习成果，以及学生在不同教育阶段所获得的发展机会。 M — Meaningful Support for Every Student 为每一位学生提供实质支持 这一部分特别关注具有不同学习需求的学生。 竞选团队提出的政策方向包括审视特殊教育服务与资源配置，加强对失读症（Dyslexia）和自闭症学生的支持，关注资优生（Gifted and Talented, G/T）项目，并进一步改善英语学习者（English Language Learners，ELL）的教育服务。 这一主张涉及学区资源分配、特殊教育服务和不同学生群体的教育机会。如何评估现有服务的覆盖程度、资源需求和实际成效，将是这一政策方向未来需要进一步讨论的内容。 A — Attract & Retain Great Educators 吸引并留住优秀教师 教师招聘和留任是秦伟平提出的第三项重点。 其竞选纲领提出，应审视教师招聘和留任机制，支持具有竞争力的教师薪酬，同时关注教师工作量、行政负担以及学校工作环境。 这一方向将教师队伍稳定性与学生教育质量联系起来，强调教师不仅需要专业能力，也需要获得适当的工作支持和职业尊重。 R — Responsible Financial Management 负责任的财政管理 在财政管理方面，秦伟平提出加强预算监督和财政信息透明度，审查学区债务及利息支出，并结合学生入学人数预测，合理评估学校建筑、设施和长期教育资源需求。 学区财政管理涉及教育服务质量、公共资金使用和纳税人利益。秦伟平提出的方向，重点在于预算监督、长期规划和资源配置之间的协调。 未来，这一纲领还需要进一步说明具体的预算审查方法、评估指标，以及如何在财政约束与教育需求之间取得平衡。 T — Transparency & Community Trust 透明度与社区信任 第五项政策重点是改善学区与社区之间的沟通。 秦伟平提出，应提高学区公共信息的透明度和可读性，鼓励家长及社区居民参与学区事务，加强公共问责，并推动开放、理性和相互尊重的公共讨论。 这一方向强调，学区治理不仅涉及董事会内部决策，也涉及家长、教师、学校工作人员和社区居民能否及时获得信息、表达意见并了解决策依据。 总体而言，SMART五大纲领将学生学业、教育公平、教师队伍、公共财政和社区参与纳入同一个政策框架，体现了秦伟平此次竞选所关注的主要治理领域。 八、2027年5月选举：Position 6与Position 7将列入选票 根据Katy ISD官方网站公布的信息，学区将于 2027年5月1日举行普通选举 ，董事会第六选区（Position 6）和第七选区（Position 7）将列入选票，选出的董事任期为三年。 官方公布的候选人申请时间为2027年1月13日至2027年2月12日下午5时。候选人需要按照学区公布的程序和德克萨斯州相关法律提交正式申请，并满足相应的参选资格要求。 因此，秦伟平此次宣布参选，属于正式公开宣布竞选意向和开展竞选活动的阶段，并不等同于已经完成正式候选人申请或取得选票资格。 Katy ISD官方网站的董事会资料页面目前列有七个董事席位，其中Position 6显示为空缺。该席位也将列入2027年5月选举。 随着选举临近，候选人将有机会进一步向社区介绍自己的教育理念、治理思路和具体政策方案。对于选民而言，了解不同候选人对学生发展、教师支持、财政管理和社区参与的具体主张，将是参与地方教育治理的重要一环。 九、从公共服务到地方教育：竞选主张仍有待社区检验 秦伟平在退伍军人节发布的声明中，将自己参选的原因概括为希望继续服务社区，为下一代创造更好的教育环境。 他在竞选团队发布的新闻通稿中表示： “对我而言，退伍军人节不仅是一个纪念的日子，更是一种精神的延续。军旅服役虽然有结束的一天，但服务社会的使命不应就此停止。我们可以继续以实际行动奉献社区，为下一代创造更加美好的未来。” 他还表示，作为美国海军退伍军人，自己曾有机会为国家服役；退役后继续通过美国邮政为公众服务；如今作为三名Katy ISD学生的父亲，希望通过参与学校发展、支持教师和保障学生成长机会，继续为社区作出贡献。 从其此次公布的竞选资料来看，秦伟平试图将三方面经历联系起来：军队服役所强调的纪律和责任、联邦公共服务岗位所涉及的日常运营，以及家庭作为学校教育直接参与者的实际体验。 但从竞选纲领走向学区治理，还需要将原则转化为具体政策。例如，如何衡量学生学业进步？如何确定特殊教育资源需求？怎样评估教师留任政策？如何在学校设施投资与财政可持续性之间取得平衡？又如何让家长和社区居民更有效地参与决策？ 这些问题不仅是候选人需要进一步回答的政策议题，也是选民在未来竞选过程中可以持续关注和比较的内容。 随着2027年5月选举临近，候选人将有更多机会向社区介绍各自的教育理念、治理思路和具体政策方案。秦伟平此次公布的SMART教育纲领，为其竞选确立了五个主要方向；这些主张能否形成更加明确、可执行和可评估的政策，将成为后续竞选讨论的重要部分。 秦伟平竞选信息 姓名： Weiping “George” Qin（秦伟平） 竞选职位： Katy ISD Board of Trustees, Position 6 选举日期： 2027年5月1日 竞选口号： Served Our Country. Defending Our Classrooms. 中文口号： 军旅报国，教育为民。 竞选纲领： SMART Education Agenda 官方竞选网站： https://weipingqintx.com/ 竞选联系邮箱： weipingqincampaign@gmail.com 秦伟平于2026年11月11日通过官方社交媒体发布中英文正式竞选公告，并邀请Katy ISD家长、教师、学校工作人员和社区居民关注其竞选活动，了解教育纲领并参与有关当地公共教育未来的讨论。 资料来源与说明： 本文根据秦伟平2026年11月11日公开发布的中英文正式竞选公告、竞选团队提供的媒体新闻通稿，以及以下公开资料整理： 德克萨斯州教育厅（TEA）Katy ISD 2025—2026学年学区资料。 Katy ISD 2026—2027财政年度预算公告。 Katy ISD董事会官方网站及董事会制度说明。 Katy ISD 2027年5月1日普通选举公告。 其中，个人服役经历、奖项、学历、奖学金及竞选主张依据竞选团队提供的材料表述；学区规模、财政预算、董事会制度及选举日期依据官方公开资料核对。 —— 纵览中国报道

鄭麗文提醒選舉倒數要有分寸 趙少康喊無愧：我拿捏得很好 | 縣市長議員選戰 | 要聞 | 聯合新聞網
