選舉倒數，國民黨內為站台爭議陷入茶壺風暴，黨主席鄭麗文今表示「所有黨員都應該知所進退、有所分寸」。中廣前董事長趙少康表示，「我覺得我分寸拿捏得很好，」他很努力希望藍白力量集中，避免2024因分裂造成的傷害；他也說，現在要打的是一場「無限戰爭」，把吃奶的力氣都用出來，問心無愧。
對於鄭麗文的說法，趙少康今受訪指出，她講得沒錯，鄭麗文也說，每個地方情況不同，光以台北市為例，民眾黨黃珊珊上次選舉拿了30幾萬票，這些票跑到什麼地方，那邊就會贏，所以蔣萬安為什麼這麼努力，跟白營小雞合體、為竹北錄影送祝福，就是希望化解藍白在竹北的裂痕，不要變成傷痕。
趙少康說，蔣萬安這麼努力，徐巧芯等立委也很努力，包括他也是，希望藍白力量能夠集中，不僅在2026，2028也能集中，所以所謂「知所進退，拿捏分寸」，「我覺得我們分寸拿捏得很好。」藍白最近有點倒吃甘蔗的感覺，希望這次能真正合作，把選票集中起來。
除了鄭麗文點名新竹縣、彰化縣、宜蘭縣選情危險，趙少康說，他認為雙北也很緊張，現在要打的是一場無限戰爭，尤其一對一縣市長選舉，要把吃奶的力氣都用出來，全力去拚，不管贏或輸，問心無愧，絕對不能有絲毫「留一點實力吧」的想法，拚最後一口氣殺到最後，爭取最後的勝利。
趙少康說，他跟台北市長蔣萬安也是這樣講，現在國民黨候選人都把自己當成現在是敗選，努力去拚，絕對不留任何猶豫、保留，向選贏邁進。
對於鄭麗文呼籲，不要還沒選完就找戰犯，趙少康說「也沒錯啦，」還不知道結果，如果現在就講說「如果選輸我負責」，好像一副未選先認為自己輸了。至於鄭麗文會怎麼做，看她自己，還不知道開票，現在逼她也沒有用，現在講都太早，選完結果贏是怎麼贏，輸是怎麼輸，那時候再來論定。
選舉倒數，國民黨內為站台爭議陷入茶壺風暴，黨主席鄭麗文今表示「所有黨員都應該知所進退、有所分寸」。中廣前董事長趙少康表示，「我覺得我分寸拿捏得很好，」他很努力希望藍白力量集中，避免2024因分裂造成的傷害；他也說，現在要打的是一場「無限戰爭」，把吃奶的力氣都用出來，問心無愧。

content:
路透社报道，采购记录显示，一所与中国人民解放军关系密切、被美国列入出口管制黑名单的高校，上个月仍购入了英伟达高性能H200人工智能（AI）晶片。图为英伟达的品牌标志。 （路透社档案照片）
路透社星期三（11月11日）报道，采购记录显示，一所与中国人民解放军关系密切、被美国列入出口管制黑名单的高校，上个月仍购入了英伟达高性能H200人工智能（AI）晶片，凸显美国限制中国获取先进技术的措施仍存在漏洞。
据路透社报道，西北工业大学官网10月21日公布的采购记录显示，该校上个月斥资87万4700元人民币（约16万8086新元），购入两枚英伟达H200晶片。
西北工业大学是中国俗称“国防七子”的七所高校之一。这七所高校直属中国工业和信息化部，被认为与军方关系密切。
采购记录显示，这批晶片是为西北工业大学管理学院采购的，供应商为陕西博算网络科技有限公司，而非直接向英伟达购买。
H200是英伟达性能最强的晶片之一，可用于训练和运行先进AI系统。出口这类晶片须获得美国政府许可，但西北工业大学等被列入黑名单的机构，其许可申请通常会遭到拒绝。
采购记录还显示，西北工业大学今年也通过与中国企业签订的五份算力租赁合同，取得使用H200晶片及其他高性能英伟达AI处理器的机会。
西北工业大学位于中国西北部城市西安，从事军用飞机、导弹和卫星相关研究。
美国商务部2001年以西北工业大学涉嫌参与导弹扩散活动及军事研究为由，将该校列入贸易黑名单，即“实体清单”。美国2019年进一步收紧限制措施，规定向该校出口受管制美国技术的许可申请，原则上应予拒绝。
路透社报道认为，西北工业大学的采购情况显示，与军方有关联的中国机构仍可通过国内供应商获取美国AI算力，包括直接购买晶片，或租用搭载这些晶片的服务器。
路透社审查了今年的26份中国采购及企业记录，发现一些大学和研究机构通过国内供应商，购买受到美国出口限制的英伟达晶片，或租用采用这类晶片的英伟达算力服务。其中部分机构与中国国防工业或军事研究有密切联系。
美国政府今年1月起，开始以逐案审批的方式允许部分H200晶片出口中国，但这项政策并未解除针对西北工业大学等美国“实体清单”所列机构的另行限制。
今年1月出台的出口许可规定还要求采取防范措施，防止被列入黑名单的机构及军事最终用户远程使用根据这项政策出口的晶片，相关规定涵盖H200处理器及性能较低的型号。
彭博社6月曾报道，采购记录显示，至少有七所支持中国军方和国防工业的中国高校，在寻求获得英伟达H200晶片。

台北市體育局11日上午舉辦「水源新天地暨公館運動館開箱活動」，台北市長蔣萬安出席致詞。針對12日起將請假投入選戰，蔣萬安會前受訪表示，接下來會依相關規定辦理，市府團隊堅守崗位，市政推進不會受影響。中央社記者葉蓁芸攝 115年11月11日
（中央社記者葉蓁芸台北11日電）九合一大選倒數，台北市長蔣萬安明天起將請假投入選戰。他今天表示，接下來會依相關規定辦理，持續走入地方與市民交流、爭取認同，市府團隊堅守崗位，市政推進不會受影響。
九合一大選進入最後階段，蔣萬安一早到青年公園、國光市場拜票，妻子石舫亘則前往成德市場尋求支持；蔣萬安隨後出席台北市體育局「水源新天地暨公館運動館開箱活動」，並接受媒體聯訪。
蔣萬安10月在議會接受質詢時曾提到，將依照相關規定，於11月12日請假投入選戰。他今天對此進一步說明，接下來會依相關規定辦理，持續走入地方與市民溝通、交流，爭取認同與支持，市府團隊也會堅守崗位，相關市政推進不會受影響。
媒體詢問，報導指稱蔣萬安13日將赴立法院，與立法院長韓國瑜、所有國民黨立委召開記者會，呼籲民眾11月14日參與「安心大遊行」。蔣萬安表示，「我就借用韓院長的一句話『一支穿雲箭，千軍萬馬來相見』」，歡迎市民14日一起站上街頭，參加安心大遊行。
媒體也關切，第一次台北市長選舉公辦電視政見發表會將於14日下午登場，與「安心大遊行」時間撞期，且將二度與民進黨台北市長參選人沈伯洋同台，有無準備。蔣萬安說，這次政見會時間較長，會向市民說明這4年的政績、接下來4年規劃的具體願景，以及台北市未來的發展。
至於出席遊行的嘉賓名單，蔣萬安說，相關邀請名單都持續進行中，確定後會向外界說明。
媒體詢問，網紅「館長」陳之漢日前直播提到，15日將與蔣萬安一起逛臨江街夜市。蔣萬安說，台灣是民主多元包容的社會，不是一言堂，他會全力爭取各方支持。
針對國民黨主席鄭麗文昨天接受鏡電視專訪時提到，蔣萬安接下來選情會「倒吃甘蔗」。蔣萬安說，他會依照既有步調，持續努力爭取民眾支持與認同。
另外，歌手羅大佑昨天接受主持人唐湘龍節目「飛碟早餐」專訪，針對行政院長卓榮泰不副署、不執行，羅大佑認為行政院長、總統代表全國人民卻「狼狽為奸」。
蔣萬安認為，羅大佑的發言「振聾發聵」，羅大佑時常關心社會議題，反映時代聲音，這是文化人展現風骨應有的表現，尊重他的立場與意見，執政黨應傾聽民意。（編輯：蕭博文）1151111

title: 从美国海军退伍军人到学区公共事务参与者：秦伟平积极参与Katy ISD社区教育，筹备2027年学区董事选举
summary: 美国德克萨斯州 Katy 消息（2026年11月10日） 美国海军退伍军人、联邦政府雇员秦伟平（Weiping Qin，又名 George Qin）近日持续参与美国德克萨斯州 Katy ISD (Katy Independent School District）当地学校及社区公共事务。11月9日，他先后参加孩子所在学校的家长教师协会（PTA）会议，以及 Katy ISD 学区董事会特别会议，与家长、社区成员和学区董事进行交流，进一步了解当地教育事务。 秦伟平目前正筹备参加20
content: 美国德克萨斯州 Katy 消息（2026年11月10日） 美国海军退伍军人、联邦政府雇员秦伟平（Weiping Qin，又名 George Qin）近日持续参与美国德克萨斯州 Katy ISD (Katy Independent School District）当地学校及社区公共事务。11月9日，他先后参加孩子所在学校的家长教师协会（PTA）会议，以及 Katy ISD 学区董事会特别会议，与家长、社区成员和学区董事进行交流，进一步了解当地教育事务。 秦伟平目前正筹备参加2027年5月举行的 Katy ISD 学区董事会选举，拟竞选 Board of Trustees, Position 6（学区董事会第6席位）。随着竞选准备工作的逐步推进，他开始更加积极地参与当地学校活动，并通过个人 X（原 Twitter）、Facebook 和 Substack 等平台分享对美国地方公共教育及社区治理的观察。 此次学校和学区活动，展现了他从一名学生家长参与学校事务，到进一步关注地方公共教育治理的个人经历。 一、参与学校PTA会议：计划组织中国文化活动 11月9日中午，秦伟平参加了孩子所在学校的 PTA 会议，与其他家长和学校社区成员讨论2027年2月 International Night（国际文化之夜）的活动安排。 秦伟平表示，他计划积极报名担任活动义工，协助协调、组织和宣传中国文化相关活动，让更多美国学生和家庭有机会了解中国传统文化。 他特别回忆了去年国际文化之夜上华裔孩子们表演的传统扇子舞。精彩的表演给现场观众留下了深刻印象，也让不同文化背景的家庭有机会通过艺术和传统文化相互了解。 秦伟平认为，国际文化之夜不仅是一次文化展示，更是学校促进多元文化交流、增进不同族裔家庭之间理解与尊重的重要平台。 Katy 社区拥有来自不同国家和文化背景的家庭。随着国际移民家庭不断融入当地社会，学校也成为不同文化相互交流的重要场所。 作为一名亚裔美国人和三个孩子的父亲，秦伟平希望通过实际参与学校活动，让更多家庭了解中国文化，同时也让华裔家长和孩子更加积极地融入美国当地社区。 他认为，学校不仅承担知识教育的责任，也应当成为培养孩子包容意识、文化理解能力和社区归属感的重要场所。 二、出席Katy ISD董事会特别会议，与现任及新当选董事交流 当天晚上，秦伟平又参加了 Katy ISD 学区董事会特别会议，并有机会与现任学区董事交流。 他特别提到，董事会主席 Lance Redmon，以及新当选董事 Cicely Taylor 主动上前与他打招呼。 令秦伟平感到意外和温暖的是，Cicely Taylor 直接称呼他为 George，并主动分享了自己的竞选经历，同时鼓励他积极参与学区董事选举。 秦伟平表示，这份友善和鼓励让他深受鼓舞，也让他感受到当地公共事务参与者之间开放、积极的交流氛围。 由于当晚还需要接送参加游泳培训课程的孩子，秦伟平未能在会议结束时与所有董事逐一交流。他希望未来能够有更多机会与学区董事、教育工作者和社区领袖建立联系，进一步了解学区面临的实际问题。 他表示，如果未来能够进入学区董事会，与其他董事共同为学生、家长、教师和社区服务，将是一份值得珍惜的公共服务责任。 需要指出的是，相关交流属于正常的社区接触和个人鼓励，并不意味着上述董事已经对其竞选作出正式背书。 三、从关注教师和特殊教育，到关注新移民学生的教育需求 事实上，秦伟平对 Katy ISD 教育事务的关注并非始于此次活动。 根据其此前在个人 X 账号发布的内容，他曾参加 Katy ISD Fall Conference，并与两位特殊教育教师交流，询问她们在日常工作中遇到的最大困难。 教师提到的师资短缺、人员流失，以及满足不同学生学习需求所面临的挑战，让秦伟平产生了进一步思考。 他在相关公开发文中提到，特殊教育涉及大量有阅读障碍、自闭症及其他学习和发展需求的学生。每一个学生背后，都有一个需要学校支持的家庭，以及一群承担教育责任的教师。 他认为，支持学生，就必须重视一线教师的工作条件和专业需求。学区在资源配置和预算管理方面，应当充分考虑教师队伍建设及特殊教育服务的实际需要。 此外，秦伟平也曾在 X 平台关注新移民学生的语言教育问题。 他指出，Katy ISD 有大量来自不同国家的移民家庭，许多学生在家中使用的第一语言并非英语。西班牙语、中文、越南语和阿拉伯语等语言，在当地多元文化社区中具有一定代表性。 他对学区 ESL（英语作为第二语言）项目给予肯定，同时也关注英语能力有限的新移民家长如何了解学校政策、与教师沟通，以及如何帮助孩子适应新的学习环境。 在另一则公开发文中，他特别表达了对部分新移民家庭教育信息获取困难的担忧，认为语言障碍不应该成为家长参与孩子教育的障碍。 这些观点表明，他关注的教育问题不仅包括学校整体教育质量，也包括特殊教育学生、新移民家庭以及不同文化背景学生能否获得适当的教育支持。 此前，纵览中国也曾根据秦伟平的公开发文，报道他对 Katy ISD 特殊教育、教师短缺和新移民学生教育问题的关注。 四、美国海军服役经历与联邦公共服务背景 秦伟平的个人经历具有一定的多元性。 他曾在美国海军服役，退役后继续从事美国联邦政府公共服务工作。同时，他拥有工商管理硕士（MBA）学位，目前正在攻读公共管理硕士（MPA）。 他认为，军旅经历使自己更加重视纪律、责任、团队合作和执行能力；联邦政府工作经历则让他对公共机构的行政管理、制度运行和公共服务有了更深入的认识。 作为三个 Katy ISD 学生的父亲，他也有机会从家长角度直接了解当地学校的日常运作，以及家庭对教育质量、校园安全和教师队伍的期待。 此前，他在公开讨论 Katy ISD 教育问题时，曾表示希望将自己在财务管理、预算监督、项目管理和资源配置方面的专业知识运用到未来的学区治理工作中。 他认为，学区董事会不仅需要关注教育政策，也需要认真履行公共财政监督责任，确保纳税人的教育资金能够有效用于学生成长和学校发展。 其竞选宣传中使用的英文口号为： “Served Our Country. Defending Our Classrooms.” 中文可译为： “曾为国家服役，如今守护我们的课堂。” 这一口号将他的军旅经历与对公共教育的关注联系起来，也构成了其个人竞选形象的重要组成部分。 五、正式推进竞选筹备，目标2027年5月学区董事选举 秦伟平目前正在为2027年5月 Katy ISD 学区董事会选举做准备，拟竞选 Position 6。 根据其此前提交的德克萨斯州竞选财务主管任命文件（Form CTA），他已经启动相关竞选申报程序，并按照现阶段要求提交了有关文件。 此后，他还提交了《公平竞选行为守则》（Code of Fair Campaign Practices）相关文件。 这些步骤标志着其竞选筹备从早期的个人意向和社区交流，逐步进入正式的行政申报和组织准备阶段。不过，相关文件提交并不等同于最终取得选票资格，后续仍须遵守适用的选举程序和申报要求。 在社交媒体方面，秦伟平持续通过个人 X 和 Facebook 发布与 Katy ISD 教育、社区活动和公共服务有关的内容，并开始使用 Substack 撰写较为完整的个人文章，介绍自己的经历、观察和教育理念。 他近期提出，希望进一步走访 Katy ISD 不同社区，与家长、教师和居民直接交流，了解他们对学区教育的期待与实际困难。 对于这场地方学区选举，他也认识到，学区董事会的公共职责涉及不同族裔、不同经济背景和不同文化传统的家庭，候选人需要倾听整个社区，而不能仅仅依靠某一个族裔群体的支持。 六、从家庭参与到公共治理：地方教育事务中的亚裔声音 美国学区董事会选举属于地方公共治理的重要组成部分。与联邦和州级选举不同，学区董事会的工作与居民家庭的日常生活联系十分密切。 学区预算、教师招聘与留任、特殊教育、校园安全、课程安排以及教育资源配置等事项，都可能直接影响当地学生和家庭。 对于人口结构多元、移民家庭较多的 Katy 社区而言，如何让不同背景的家长充分参与学校事务，如何在教育资源分配中兼顾不同学生的实际需求，也是地方教育治理需要面对的问题。 秦伟平的参选筹备，反映出一名亚裔美国居民希望从家庭和社区参与出发，进一步进入美国地方公共事务领域的尝试。 从参加 PTA 会议、准备参与中国文化活动，到出席学区董事会会议、与现任及新当选董事交流，再到通过社交媒体公开讨论特殊教育、新移民学生和教师队伍建设，他正在逐步建立与当地教育社区的联系。 秦伟平表示，自己作为三个 Katy ISD 孩子的父亲，深知优质公共教育离不开家长、教师、学校管理者和整个社区的共同努力。 如果能够在2027年5月的选举中当选，他希望把自己的专业经验、军旅背景和多元文化视角带入学区董事会，认真倾听不同群体的声音，为学生、家长和教师提供更加务实的服务。 他在最新发布的个人文章中写道： “教育不僅僅發生在課堂上，更體現在家庭的參與、不同文化之間的交流，以及我們為每一個孩子創造更好成長環境的共同努力之中。” 对于秦伟平而言，从曾经为国家服役，到今天作为一名父亲积极参与学校和社区事务，是其人生公共服务经历的延续。 2027年5月的 Katy ISD 学区董事会选举，将成为检验其社区动员能力、公共政策理念和选民支持度的一次重要机会。 他能否将目前的社区参与和个人影响力转化为更广泛的选民支持，仍有待未来竞选进程进一步观察。 相关人物： 秦伟平（Weiping Qin / George Qin） 竞选职位： Katy ISD Board of Trustees, Position 6 选举时间： 2027年5月 个人社交媒体： X（@WeipingQin）、Facebook、Substack 相关竞选信息： https://secure.anedot.com/weiping-qin-campaign/donate 关键词： 秦伟平、Katy ISD、美国地方教育、学区董事会、亚裔美国人、美国海军退伍军人、特殊教育、新移民教育、2027年选举 —— 纵览中国相关人物与美国地方公共事务观察

# 美中俄峰会筹备发生分歧 北京要求照稿发言

美中俄能否在深圳APEC峰会期间举行三方会谈尚有疑问，据华尔街日报报道，北京与华盛顿在议程安排上出现分歧，中方要求严格按照预定程序进行，三位元首依次宣读声明，特朗普则希望自由讨论，而不是各自照稿发言。

发表时间： 10/11/2026 - 22:49 更改时间： 10/11/2026 - 23:23

 5 分钟 浏览时间

 2026年11月8日，美国总统特朗普在美国佛罗里达州西棕榈滩的唐纳德·J·特朗普总统国际机场登机前往马里兰州安德鲁斯联合基地的“空军一号”前向媒体发表讲话。特朗普认为，他将在中国举行的亚太经合组织峰会上会见习近平和普京。 REUTERS - Eric Lee

 作者： [安德烈](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E4%BD%9C%E8%80%85/%E5%AE%89%E5%BE%B7%E7%83%88/ "安德烈")

广告

继续浏览后续

亚太经合组织峰会将于11月18日至19日在中国深圳举行，美中俄三方最初都对举行三方峰会抱持开放姿态，但根据华尔街日报报道，目前围绕会议规则和讨论内容出现分歧，其中最重要的争议是核武器控制。核弹规模远远不及美俄、并且正在大力扩充核武库的中国并不希望讨论特朗普热衷的无核化问题。

另据纽约时报报道，乌克兰问题也让中国的决定变得复杂。中国对为普京提供与华盛顿就乌克兰问题达成交易的平台持谨慎态度。日前访问北京的德国总统施泰因迈尔对德国媒体表示，他与习近平会晤时，后者明确表示，美国、俄罗斯和中国不会在深圳讨论乌克兰的命运。施泰因迈尔表示，“你可以看出他脸上的不悦。他甚至问，这些传言是从哪里来的”。

曾任白宫国家安全官员、现任职于布鲁金斯学会的何瑞恩对该报分析：北京希望从这场历史性会晤中获得好处，却又担心要承担确保会晤成功的责任。

华尔街日报报道说，熟悉中国政府决策过程的知情人士表示，习近平想要一场历史性三方会晤带来的形象效应，包括照片、声明和宣传价值，却不愿承担对话走向难以预料的风险。

曾在拜登总统任期担任副国务卿、现任亚洲集团董事长的坎贝尔对该报表示，他认为这场会晤对习近平而言风险很大，而且充满难以预料的变数。中国政府更愿意分别处理与美国和俄罗斯的关系。

报道说，让各方依次宣读事先准备好的讲话，这是中国外交中的惯常做法。习近平与外国领导人的会晤通常每一分钟都经过精心安排，谈话要点事先审核，几乎没有即兴发挥的空间。尤其习目前正为明年举行的中共21大重大领导层调整做准备，姿态更为谨慎。

香港市区重建局收到土瓜湾项目标书，价值高达 4.8 亿港元 |中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 11 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港市区重建局收到土瓜湾项目标书，价值高达 HK$4.8b
市区重建局接获土瓜湾重建项目标书，市场估计估值为39亿至48亿港元。分析师预计，由于当地强劲的房地产销售和该地区的交通网络，人们将对此产生浓厚的兴趣。
市区重建局的香港土瓜湾道/榕光街项目于11月11日中午接标，市场估值介乎约39亿至48亿港元，相当于每平方英尺建筑面积补地价约7,400至9,000港元。
中原测量师行董事林伟伦估计该项目的土地价值为45.08亿港元，即每平方英尺建筑面积约8,500港元。他指出，该地块受益于完善的交通网络和其他配套设施，近期附近项目的竞标势头强劲，价格优惠。林补充说，该地区的新房一直受到买家的欢迎，而且销售情况良好，因此他预计开发商之间的竞争将非常激烈。
项目涵盖土瓜湾道、马头围道、鸿福街、启明街及毓星街。该地盘面积近59,000平方英尺，总许可建筑面积超过530,000平方英尺。
这是该局首个“小区重建新社区”计划的最后一个重建项目，名为“维多利亚湾中心”。该地块邻近港铁土瓜湾站，计划包括兴建两座行人天桥。

Hong Kong Urban Renewal Authority receives bids for To Kwa Wan project valued at up to HK$4.8b | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 11 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong Urban Renewal Authority receives bids for To Kwa Wan project valued at up to HK$4.8b
The Urban Renewal Authority received bids for a To Kwa Wan redevelopment project, with market estimates valuing it at HK$3.9 billion to HK$4.8 billion. Analysts expect keen interest due to strong local property sales and the site's transport links.
The Urban Renewal Authority's To Kwa Wan Road/Yung Kwong Street project in Hong Kong received bids by midday on 11 November, with market valuations ranging from about HK$3.9 billion to HK$4.8 billion, translating to a land premium of about HK$7,400 to HK$9,000 per square foot of gross floor area.
Alan Lam, director of surveying firm Centaline Surveyors, estimated the project's land value at HK$4.508 billion, or about HK$8,500 per square foot of gross floor area. He noted that the site benefits from comprehensive transport links and other supporting facilities, and that recent bidding for nearby projects had been strong with favourable pricing. New homes in the area have been popular with buyers and are selling well, Lam added, leading him to expect keen competition among developers.
The project covers To Kwa Wan Road, Ma Tau Wai Road, Hung Fook Street, Kai Ming Street and Yuk Sing Street. The site area is nearly 59,000 square feet, with a total permitted gross floor area of more than 530,000 square feet.
It is the final redevelopment project in the authority's first "small-district redevelopment new community" scheme, named "Victoria Cove Central". The site is near the MTR To Kwa Wan station, and plans include the construction of two pedestrian footbridges.

title: Austal Cuts First Steel on Landing Craft Heavy for Australian Army
zh_title: 奥斯塔为澳大利亚陆军首次切割重型登陆艇钢材
summary: 澳大利亚政府于 2026 年 11 月 11 日宣布，为澳大利亚陆军采购的两艘两栖登陆艇中的第二艘目前正在建造中。重型登陆艇 (LCH) 的第一批钢材于 10 月下旬完成生产，一个月前中型登陆艇 (LCM) 项目也取得了类似的里程碑。造船商 Austal 绘制的计算机插图中的 Damen LST 100 重型登陆艇 (LCH)。澳大利亚国防镜头。澳大利亚国防部长 2026 年 11 月 11 日媒体发布 澳大利亚陆军转型为一支优化部队
content:
澳大利亚政府于 2026 年 11 月 11 日宣布，为澳大利亚陆军采购的两艘两栖登陆艇中的第二艘目前正在建造中。重型登陆艇 (LCH) 的第一批钢材于 10 月下旬完成生产，一个月前中型登陆艇 (LCM) 项目也取得了类似的里程碑。造船商 Austal 绘制的计算机插图中的 Damen LST 100 重型登陆艇 (LCH)。澳大利亚国防镜头。澳大利亚国防部长发布的媒体报道（链接）2026 年 11 月 11 日澳大利亚陆军向两栖作战和远程打击优化的部队转型正在推进，西澳大利亚州登陆艇的建造现已进入新阶段。陆军重型登陆艇的建造工作正在按计划进行，第一批舰艇已于上月底进行了钢材切割。阿尔巴尼亚政府已授予价值超过 50 亿美元的合同，为陆军提供 18 艘中型登陆艇和 8 艘重型登陆艇，该项目已经促进了就业和当地经济活动。该项目将为西澳创造1,100个直接就业岗位和2,000多个间接就业岗位，并直接支持政府对该州持续造船的承诺。
这些舰艇能够运输多兵种陆地系统，包括高机动火炮火箭系统、艾布拉姆斯主战坦克以及侦察和步兵战车，将增强澳大利亚国防军将潜在对手置于危险之中并确保战略地形安全的能力。这一重大进展表明了阿尔巴尼亚政府致力于建设陆军未来濒海舰队，同时推进国防战略和综合投资计划的优先事项，加强澳大利亚的主权国防工业基础，并创造熟练就业。为了进一步增强澳大利亚的主权造船能力，阿尔巴尼亚政府的国家重建基金公司 (NRFC) 上个月宣布向澳大利亚奥斯塔防务造船有限公司提供 2.45 亿美元贷款，以支持澳大利亚海军陆战队内重型登陆艇设施的建造和装修。该项目是阿尔巴尼亚政府创纪录的国防投资的一部分，是自第二次世界大战以来陆军滨海能力最大规模的资本重组。 “陆军登陆艇舰队建造的进展标志着从设计到交付的过渡，也是澳大利亚国防军关键能力建设的重要一步。随着建设活动的增加，我们正在为当地人创造数千个就业机会，为企业提供投资和发展劳动力所需的信心。
这两个登陆艇项目对于阿尔巴尼亚政府在西澳的持续造船计划至关重要，该计划将为子孙后代提供就业保障，并使澳大利亚人更加安全。”国防工业部长 Pat Conroy MP – 声明结束 – 2026 年 9 月下旬在奥斯塔第一艘 LCM 船的 1 号区块首次焊接。图片来自奥斯塔通过澳大利亚国防部拍摄的镜头。 《海军新闻》评论：继 2026 年 9 月 29 日中型登陆艇 (LCM) 实现类似里程碑之后，重型登陆艇 (LCH) 两栖登陆舰于 10 月下旬宣布进行首次钢材切割。正如《海军新闻》在之前的报道中概述的那样，这两项工作现在都在进行中

The Australian government announced on 11 November 2026 that construction is now underway on the second of two amphibious landing craft-procurements for the Australian Army. First steel for the Landing Craft Heavy (LCH) was cut in late October, followin a similar milestone for the Landing Craft Medium (LCM)-program one month earlier. The Damen LST 100-based Landing Craft Heavy (LCH) in a computer illustration by shipbuilder Austal. Footage Australian Defence. Media release of the Australian Minister for Defence (Link) 11 November 2026 The transformation of the Australian Army into a force optimised for amphibious operations and long-range strike is advancing, with construction in Western Australia of landing craft vessels now progressing to a new phase. Construction of the Army’s Landing Craft Heavy is now underway and on schedule with steel cut on the first vessels late last month. The Albanese Government has awarded over $5 billion in contracts to deliver 18 Landing Craft Medium and eight Landing Craft Heavy for Army, a project that has already boosted employment and local economic activity. The project will create 1,100 direct jobs and more than 2,000 indirect jobs in Western Australia and directly support the Government’s commitment to continuous shipbuilding in the state. Capable of transporting combined-arms land systems, including High Mobility Artillery Rocket Systems, Abrams main battle tanks, and reconnaissance and infantry fighting vehicles, the vessels will strengthen the Australian Defence Force’s ability to hold potential adversaries at risk and secure strategic terrain. This significant progress demonstrates the Albanese Government’s commitment to delivering Army’s future littoral fleet, while advancing the priorities of the National Defence Strategy and Integrated Investment Program, strengthening Australia’s sovereign defence industrial base, and creating skilled employment. In a further boost to Australia’s sovereign shipbuilding capability, the Albanese Government’s National Reconstruction Fund Corporation (NRFC) last month announced a $245 million loan to Austal Defence Shipbuilding Australia Pty Ltd to support the construction and fit out of Landing Craft Heavy facilities within the Australian Marine Complex. The project – part of the Albanese Government’s record investment in Defence – represents the largest recapitalisation of Army’s littoral capability since the Second World War. “Progress in constructing Army’s landing craft fleet marks the transition from design into delivery and an important step in building a critical capability for the Australian Defence Force. As construction activity ramps up, we are creating thousands of jobs for locals, providing businesses the confidence they need to invest and grow their workforce. These two landing craft projects are critical to the Albanese Government’s continuous shipbuilding plan for WA, which is providing job security for generations to come, and making Australians safer.” Minister for Defence Industry Pat Conroy MP – end of statement – First weld on block 1 of the first LCM vessel at Austal in late September, 2026. Image from footage by Austal via Australian DoD. Naval News comments: The announcement for first steel cut on the Landing Craft – Heavy (LCH) amphibious landing ships in late October follows a similar milestone met for the Landing Craft – Medium (LCM)-effort on 29 September 2026. As Naval News has outlined in previous coverage , both efforts are now effectively occurring in parallel due to earlier delays on moving LCM from design to construction. Austal is capable of constructing the LCM-vessels with a displacement of approximately 500 tons within its existing facilities at Henderson and on Hope Valley Road. For the construction of the far larger LCH based on Damen’s LST 100 displacing nearly 4,000 tons however the government-designated strategic shipbuilder will need to utilise facilities within the wider Henderson Defence Precinct, notably the Common User Facility (CUF). The yard intends to move LCH-production to a yet to be established “permanent” production facility at a later date, according to a previous contract-announcement by the Australian government. Australia has ordered 18 LCM and eight LCH for expanded amphibious capability operated by the Australian Defence Force. Chinese v American Views on WAR with Taiwan
Posted Aug 14, 2026 by Martin Armstrong |
The Center for Strategic and International Studies conducted an extraordinary survey of 64 leading experts on China, Taiwan, and cross-Strait relations, including 28 former senior U.S. government officials, 23 former government policy and intelligence analysts, and 13 academics and think-tank experts. What their answers reveal is not that China is preparing to invade Taiwan tomorrow, as the neocons would like everyone to believe, but that Beijing remains willing to wait so long as nobody crosses the line of formal Taiwanese independence. Some 84% said Beijing is willing to wait for unification but will not accept the status quo permanently, while only 10% believed China seeks unification at the earliest opportunity. Not one of the 64 experts believed Beijing would ever accept an independent Taiwan.
This is precisely why Taiwan has become so dangerous. The West keeps portraying the conflict as if Xi Jinping wakes up every morning staring at a calendar trying to decide when to launch an amphibious invasion. Yet 83% of these experts said China did not plan to use significant kinetic force against Taiwan by 2027, and 80% said China’s enormous 2022 military exercises did not indicate Beijing had accelerated its timetable. Only 6% of respondents outside the former senior government group saw 2027 as a hard deadline, while not one former senior U.S. official did. The obsession with 2027 has nevertheless become extremely useful for the military establishment because every supposed deadline becomes another justification for weapons, deployments, bases, and spending.
The survey found that 44% believed Beijing has a hard deadline of 2049, the centennial of the People’s Republic, while 42% believed China could wait indefinitely provided unification remains possible. This is an important distinction because China thinks in terms of generations while Western politicians think in terms of the next election. Beijing does not need to invade Taiwan if economic, political, and military pressure can gradually change the situation in its favor. Only 20% of those surveyed believed China even possessed a coherent roadmap for peaceful unification, which tells us this is not some perfectly scripted invasion plan sitting in Xi’s desk drawer.
Where the numbers become alarming is not an unprovoked invasion but what happens when politicians begin crossing China’s red lines. More than three-quarters of the experts, 77%, believed China would invade within six months if Taiwan formally declared independence. Among former senior U.S. officials, that number was 79%. Even some of those who did not expect an immediate invasion believed Beijing would respond with a blockade or enormous military exercises. This is why politicians encouraging Taiwan toward formal independence are playing with the lives of 23 million people. They can deliver all the speeches they want about democracy from Washington, London, or Brussels, but they will not be the civilians sitting underneath the missiles if their political experiment goes wrong.
Not one expert believed an explicit American commitment to defend Taiwan would cause China to invade immediately, but 64% believed Beijing would respond strongly enough to provoke a U.S.-China or China-Taiwan crisis, while another 31% expected a more limited negative response. Only two of the 64 experts believed formally committing America to Taiwan’s defense would actually deter China from using force because Beijing already assumes that the United States will intervene anyway.
A direct invasion is not even the most likely path toward conflict. Only 8% of the experts described an amphibious invasion within ten years as likely, while 63% called it possible and 27% unlikely. Force short of invasion received much higher probabilities, with 52% saying deliberate escalation such as a blockade was likely or very likely. An accidental military incident was considered even more dangerous, with 34% saying a collision or accident around the Taiwan Strait was likely and another 22% calling it very likely. When warships and aircraft from opposing nuclear powers continually operate around the same small body of water, war does not require some grand master plan. It requires one mistake followed by politicians who refuse to back down.
A later CSIS survey of American and Taiwanese experts reinforces that point. Roughly 90% of U.S. experts and 62% of Taiwanese experts believed China already possessed the capability to impose a law-enforcement-led quarantine that substantially reduces trade into Taiwan. Around 80% of American experts and 60% of Taiwanese experts believed Beijing could execute a PLA blockade, while Taiwanese experts were considerably more skeptical that China could successfully carry out an invasion. If Beijing wanted to coerce Taiwan during the following five years, experts considered a quarantine the most likely option. If China decided it wanted immediate unification, however, approximately 80% regarded a highly kinetic joint blockade as likely or very likely.
This is where the economic consequences become enormous because Taiwan does not need to be invaded for the world economy to be thrown into chaos. A quarantine or blockade would immediately threaten shipping, insurance, semiconductor supply chains, electronics, automobiles, communications equipment, and virtually every modern industry dependent upon advanced chips. The later CSIS survey found most American and Taiwanese experts did not believe Taiwan could withstand a Chinese blockade for longer than three months without substantial U.S. intervention. Washington would then face the decision nobody wants to discuss honestly: accept China’s blockade or attempt to break it militarily and risk direct war between two nuclear powers.
Taiwan is also the world’s semiconductor pressure point. The island’s importance to advanced chip manufacturing means a serious blockade would not remain a regional event. Factories thousands of miles away could discover that a conflict they thought had nothing to do with them suddenly prevents them from obtaining critical components. Markets would begin repricing the risk immediately, shipping premiums would explode, companies would scramble for inventory, and governments would discover once again how fragile global supply chains have become. This is why capital will react long before politicians formally declare that a war has begun.
What I find particularly revealing in the later CSIS survey is the difference between American confidence and Taiwanese confidence in Washington. An astonishing 96% of American experts were completely or moderately confident that the United States would intervene militarily if China invaded Taiwan during the following five years. Taiwanese experts were less confident in American intervention and considerably less confident that U.S. allies would join the fight. It is always easier for people thousands of miles away to be certain about somebody else’s war.
This is precisely why Taiwan remains one of the critical geopolitical pressure points as we move toward 2029. The danger is not simply that China arbitrarily decides to invade. The greater danger is escalation, miscalculation, political promises that cannot be withdrawn, and Western policymakers convincing themselves that every additional provocation somehow produces deterrence. China has made its position on formal independence perfectly clear, and even the experts inside the Western foreign-policy establishment overwhelmingly acknowledge that Beijing would react with force if that line were crossed.
If Taiwan declares formal independence, 77% of the experts surveyed believed China would invade within six months. That is not a statistic policymakers should treat as another war-game scenario. It is a warning about what happens when politicians deliberately remove the ambiguity that has helped keep the peace.

美国在台协会台北总办事处。照片取自AIT Facebook
中新社台北11月11日电 美国和台湾周二签署谅解备忘录，启动台湾奖学金计划(TFP)，允许美国联邦政府雇员在台湾接受长达一年的语言培训和区域研究，旨在加强双边战略关系。
美国在台协会在一份新闻稿中称，该协议由美国在台协会（AIT）华盛顿常务董事英格丽·拉尔森（Ingrid Larson）和台湾驻美国代表俞大㵢在弗吉尼亚州阿灵顿签署。
拉尔森在签署仪式上表示：“TFP反映了两党对美台关系的大力支持以及对以民间关系为核心的共同承诺。”
据AIT称，TFP将允许符合条件的美国联邦政府雇员接受长达一年的强化普通话培训，并在台湾进行区域研究。
AIT补充说，完成培训后，研究员预计将在台湾立法机构、政府部委和机构或公共部门以外的组织工作长达一年。
美国在台协会表示，该计划旨在扩大和加强美台伙伴关系，并提高美国官员在台湾和两岸问题上的专业知识。
它还寻求在台湾培养一批具有语言技能、文化知识和持久专业关系的联邦专业人士。
该计划是根据当时美国的《台湾奖学金法》授权的。作为 2023 财年詹姆斯·M·英霍夫国防授权法案的一部分，乔·拜登总统于 2022 年 12 月 23 日签署成为法律。
美国在台协会没有解释该计划延迟近三年实施的原因。

U.S., Taiwan sign MOU to implement Taiwan Fellowship Program

American Institute in Taiwan Taipei Main Office. Photo taken from AIT's Facebook
Taipei, Nov. 11 (CNA) The United States and Taiwan signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) Tuesday to launch the Taiwan Fellowship Program (TFP) allowing U.S. federal government employees to receive up to one year of language training and regional studies in Taiwan, with the aim of strengthening bilateral strategic ties.
The agreement was signed by Ingrid Larson, Washington managing director of the American Institute in Taiwan (AIT), and Alexander Yui (俞大㵢), Taiwan's representative to the United States, in Arlington, Virginia, the AIT said in a press release.
"TFP reflects strong bipartisan support for the U.S.-Taiwan relationship and a shared commitment to the people-to-people ties at its core," Larson was quoted as saying during the signing ceremony.
According to AIT, the TFP will allow eligible U.S. federal government employees to receive up to one year of intensive Mandarin training and pursue regional studies in Taiwan.
Upon completing their training, fellows are expected to work for up to one year in Taiwan's legislative offices, government ministries and agencies, or organizations outside the public sector, the AIT added.
According to the AIT, the program aims to expand and strengthen the U.S.-Taiwan partnership and enhance U.S. officials' expertise on Taiwan and cross-strait issues.
It also seeks to develop a group of federal professionals with language skills, cultural knowledge, and lasting professional relationships in Taiwan.
The program was authorized under the Taiwan Fellowship Act, which then-U.S. President Joe Biden signed into law on Dec. 23, 2022, as part of the James M. Inhofe National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2023.
The AIT did not explain the nearly three-year delay in implementing the program.

香港教育、科技及人才委员会报告融合进展 |中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 11 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港教育、科技及人才委员会报告融合进展
2024年12月成立的教育科技人才委员会，推进人才引进、国际教育中心建设、完善人才制度等工作。它协调了跨部门的努力，使大学课程与国家人工智能和行业需求保持一致，并
由政务司司长担任主席、劳工及福利局局长、教育局局长、创新及科技局局长组成的教育、科技及人才委员会汇报了自2024年12月成立以来的进展情况。该委员会重点关注三个战略方向：吸引顶尖创新科技人才、建设国际教育中心以及完善人才计划和服务。
在教育方面，政府正在巩固香港作为国际教育中心的地位。新田、洪水桥和打鼓岭的北领地大学城是该市第一个五年规划的核心部分，具有五要素布局和教育、科技和人才融合战略。到2027年，政府计划采取措施扩大专上教育，包括增加大学教育资助委员会资助的研究型研究生学额、逐步增加香港博士研究生奖学金的数量，以及为知识共享和科学教育创新提供额外资助。
在科技方面，政府正在推进三个创新园区和五个研究院的建设，以产业吸引人才。位于落马洲河套地区的港深创新科技合作区于去年底开业，已有超过120家学术和研究机构入驻，区内设有人才公寓和配套设施。根据第一个五年计划，环线将与新田科技园合作，两家园区公司将帮助开发北领地大学城。创新及科技基金于2025年9月推出30亿港元的前沿科技研究支持计划，并于同年晚些时候进一步优化科技人才入境计划。
在人才引进方面，委员会监督了多项计划的改进，包括在优秀人才引进计划下主动邀请顶尖人才和领军人才的机制。自2025年6月下旬起，新通道允许8个严重短缺的技术工种的技术工人进入香港。截至2026年9月底，已有超过32万名来自全球不同领域的人士通过各类人才入境计划来港工作和发展。
在大学课程与国家和地方需求对接方面，教育局帮助大学根据政府政策、市场需求和行业趋势审查和开设课程。建立策略性人才发展政策框架和高等教育人才发展平台，促进政策局、大学和业界之间的沟通。由大学教育资助委员会资助的大学推出了27个与STEAM或八个中心相关的学士学位课程，其中许多将科技与人文、金融和医疗保健相结合

Hong Kong education, tech and talent committee reports progress on integration | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 11 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong education, tech and talent committee reports progress on integration
The Education, Technology and Talent Committee, established in December 2024, has advanced work on attracting talent, building an international education hub and improving talent schemes. It has coordinated cross-bureau efforts to align university curricula with national AI and industry needs, and s
The Education, Technology and Talent Committee, chaired by the Chief Secretary and comprising the secretaries for Labour and Welfare, Education, and Innovation, Science and Technology, has reported progress since its establishment in December 2024. The committee focuses on three strategic directions: attracting top innovation and technology talent, building an international education hub, and refining talent schemes and services.
In education, the government is consolidating Hong Kong's status as an international education hub. The Northern Territory university towns in San Tin, Hung Shui Kiu and Ta Kwu Ling are a core part of the city's first five-year plan, with a layout of five elements and a strategy to integrate education, technology and talent. By 2027, the government plans measures to expand post-secondary education, including increasing research postgraduate places funded by the University Grants Committee, gradually raising the number of Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme awards, and providing extra funding for knowledge-sharing and science-education innovation.
In technology, the government is advancing the construction of three innovation parks and five research institutes to attract talent through industry. The Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Cooperation Zone in the Lok Ma Chau Loop opened late last year, with more than 120 academic and research institutions moving in. The zone includes talent apartments and amenities. Under the first five-year plan, the loop will work with the San Tin tech park, and both park companies will help develop the Northern Territory university towns. The Innovation and Technology Fund launched a HK$3 billion Frontier Technology Research Support Scheme in September 2025 and further optimised the Technology Talent Admission Scheme later that year.
In talent recruitment, the committee has overseen improvements to several schemes, including a proactive invitation mechanism for top-tier and leading talent under the Quality Migrant Admission Scheme. Since late June 2025, a new channel has allowed skilled workers in eight technical trades facing severe shortages to enter Hong Kong. As of the end of September 2026, more than 320,000 people from various fields worldwide had come to work and develop in Hong Kong under various talent admission schemes.
On aligning university programmes with national and local needs, the Education Bureau has helped universities review and launch courses in line with government policy, market demand and industry trends. A strategic talent development policy framework and a higher-education talent development platform have been set up to facilitate communication among policy bureaux, universities and industry. Universities funded by the University Grants Committee have introduced 27 bachelor's degree programmes related to STEAM or the eight centres, many blending technology with humanities, finance and healthcare to strengthen artificial-intelligence skills and interdisciplinary problem-solving. The government is preparing for the 2028-29 to 2030-31 planning cycle, closely linking talent cultivation with technology and industrial development.
The Innovation, Science and Technology Bureau is expanding the Innovation and Technology Internship Scheme, aiming to provide about 10,000 places over two years with a subsidy of at least HK$11,000 each. This year's policy address also added a youth research category under the Innovation and Technology Support Scheme. The Research Talent Hub scheme supports enterprises and research institutions in hiring researchers, with a target to increase the number of engagements from around 10,500 in 2022 to 18,500 by 2027.

香港拆除山坡墓区10座未经许可的坟墓中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 11 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港拆除山坡墓地10座违例坟墓
香港食物环境卫生署和地政总署从两个允许的墓地中拆除了10个无人认领的未经许可的坟墓或骨屋，这是更广泛打击新界非法山坡埋葬行为的一部分。
食物环境卫生署及地政总署于2026年11月11日宣布，香港政府已针对山坡地区的违例埋葬行为进行联合执法及捡拾行动。
今年9月22日至23日，有关部门就两个许可埋葬区内的10个未经批准的坟墓、骨屋或骨屋张贴公告，责令相关责任者停止占用政府土地，并分别于10月26日和27日之前联络当局，或将骨灰迁往沙岭坟场。截止期限过后，无人提出索赔，政府便开始联合执行和拆除。
2016年以来，政府在个别许可埋葬区开展管理试点，因地制宜。其中包括竖立界碑、勘察现有坟墓、设定地块大小限制以及在可用空间内指定新的墓地。该计划现覆盖新界全部九个行政区的 15 个许可区域。
根据试点数据，政府从2021年7月开始分阶段对墓地内的非法埋葬行为进行执法。除了最新的行动外，当局还计划在明年清明节前在其他未经许可的坟墓或骨屋张贴告示，旨在在截止日期后迅速清除无人认领的遗骸。
政府发言人强调，根据《土地（杂项条文）条例》（第28章），任何人未经许可占用政府土地且没有遵守腾出通知，即属犯罪。被占土地上的财产或建筑物可能会被拆除和移走，占用者可能会面临起诉。根据《公众卫生及市政条例》（第132章），未经书面授权埋葬人类遗骸属违法，违法者在遗骸挖掘过程中可能会受到刑事检控。

Hong Kong removes 10 unauthorised graves in hillside burial zones | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 11 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong removes 10 unauthorised graves in hillside burial zones
Hong Kong's Food and Environmental Hygiene Department and Lands Department have removed 10 unclaimed unauthorised graves or bone huts from two permitted burial areas, part of a broader crackdown on illegal hillside burials across the New Territories.
The Hong Kong government has carried out a joint enforcement and exhumation operation against unauthorised burials in hillside areas, the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department and the Lands Department announced on 11 November 2026.
On 22 and 23 September this year, the departments posted notices on 10 unapproved graves, bone huts or bone houses in two permitted burial zones, ordering those responsible to stop occupying government land and contact the authorities by 26 and 27 October respectively, or have the remains relocated to Sha Ling Cemetery. After the deadlines passed with no claimants, the government proceeded with the joint enforcement and removal.
Since 2016, the government has run a pilot management scheme in individual permitted burial zones, implementing measures tailored to local conditions. These include erecting boundary markers, surveying existing graves, setting plot size limits, and designating new burial zones within available space. The scheme now covers 15 permitted zones across all nine administrative districts of the New Territories.
Based on data from the pilot scheme, the government began phased enforcement against illegal burials in burial zones from July 2021. Beyond the latest operation, authorities plan to post notices on other unauthorised graves or bone huts before next year's Ching Ming Festival, aiming to remove unclaimed remains quickly after the deadline expires.
A government spokesman stressed that under the Land (Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance (Chapter 28), anyone occupying government land without permission and failing to comply with a notice to vacate commits an offence. Property or structures on occupied land may be demolished and removed, and occupants may face prosecution. Under the Public Health and Municipal Services Ordinance (Chapter 132), burying human remains without written authority is illegal, and offenders may be criminally prosecuted while the remains are exhumed.

content:
香港政府加强对违反合同的外籍家庭佣工的审查中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 11 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港政府加强对违反合同的外籍家庭佣工的审查
香港入境处过去三年拒绝了455份涉嫌滥用提前终止合同更换雇主的外籍家庭佣工的工作签证申请。如果工人提前离开，政府没有计划要求职业介绍所分担费用，但是
香港入境事务处加强了对滥用提前终止合同更换雇主的外籍家庭佣工（FDW）的执法力度，这种做法在当地被称为“跳槽”。政府在11月11日发表的书面答复立法会质询时表示，2013年6月成立的专案小组在截至2026年10月的三年内，已调查了3,303宗怀疑个案。其中，有455宗签证申请被拒绝，另有259宗申请人被撤回或无法跟进。
政府表示，不会按工人国籍细分数据，也不会保留有多少工人在未通知雇主的情况下离开香港、总共有多少人提前终止合同、有多少人后来重新申请并获得批准的数据。
根据香港《雇佣条例》和标准两年雇佣合约，任何一方均可通过提前一个月书面通知或支付补偿金的方式终止合约。政府表示鼓励雇主和外籍家政工人保持和谐的工作关系。
在审查签证申请时，移民官员考虑的因素包括工人的行为、双方的记录以及提前终止合同的原因。官员可以直接联系前雇主和申请人以核实原因。对于那些涉嫌“跳槽”的人，该部门表示“坚决拒绝”签证申请，并要求该工人离开香港。
当被问及如果工人在前三到六个月内离开时，政府是否计划要求就业机构分担费用，政府表示没有这样的计划。它指出，雇主可以通过代理机构或直接雇用外籍家政工人，服务费和后续安排由代理机构和雇主协商确定。为保护消费者权益，劳工部于2024年5月修订了《就业机构业务守则》，要求各机构明确说明如果工人提前离开，是否提供退款、更换工人或其他安排，以及是否收取额外费用。违反该准则的机构可能会被吊销许可证或受到警告。

Hong Kong government tightens scrutiny of foreign domestic workers who break contracts | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 11 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong government tightens scrutiny of foreign domestic workers who break contracts
Hong Kong's Immigration Department has rejected 455 work visa applications from foreign domestic workers suspected of abusing early contract termination to switch employers in the past three years. The government has no plans to require employment agencies to share costs if workers leave early, but
Hong Kong's Immigration Department has stepped up enforcement against foreign domestic workers (FDWs) who abuse early contract termination to switch employers, a practice known locally as 'jumping jobs'. In a written reply to a Legislative Council question published on 11 November, the government said a special task force set up in June 2013 had investigated 3,303 suspected cases in the three years to October 2026. Of these, 455 visa applications were rejected, while 259 were withdrawn by the applicant or could not be followed up.
The government said it does not break down the figures by the worker's nationality, nor does it keep data on how many workers left Hong Kong without notifying their employer, how many terminated contracts early in total, or how many of those who left later reapplied and were approved.
Under Hong Kong's Employment Ordinance and the standard two-year employment contract, either party can end the contract by giving one month's written notice or paying compensation in lieu. The government said it encourages both employers and FDWs to maintain harmonious working relationships.
When reviewing visa applications, immigration officers consider factors including the worker's conduct, records from both sides, and the stated reason for early termination. Officers may contact former employers and the applicant directly to verify the reason. For those suspected of 'jumping jobs', the department said it 'resolutely refuses' the visa application and requires the worker to leave Hong Kong.
On the question of whether the government plans to require employment agencies to share costs if a worker leaves within the first three to six months, the government said it has no such plan. It noted that employers can hire FDWs through agencies or directly, and that service fees and follow-up arrangements are negotiated between agency and employer. To protect consumer rights, the Labour Department in May 2024 revised the Code of Practice for Employment Agencies to require agencies to clearly state whether they offer refunds, replacement workers or other arrangements if a worker leaves early, and whether extra fees apply. Agencies that breach the code can have their licence revoked or be issued a warning.

香港政府概述了管理和清除银合欢的策略 |中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 11 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港政府概述了管理和清除银合欢的策略
香港当局正在加大力度管理入侵物种银合欢（当地人称为银荆树）。政府计划使用人工智能技术进行识别，在发现后两到三周内强制清除，并加强公众教育，
在 2026 年 11 月 11 日向立法会提出质询后，香港政府详细介绍了管理和清除入侵物种银合欢 (银荆) 的策略。当局将这种植物描述为一种具有复原力的外来入侵物种，会阻碍本地物种的自然演替，并且由于其脆弱的树枝在强风中可能折断或倒塌，因此构成安全风险。
政府回应提问时确认，树木管理部门必须遵循发展局的技术指示。在每年的台风前检查和台风后检查时，部门会评估交通繁忙地区的树木，一旦发现银合欢，就会在两至三周内安排移除。对于需要临时交通改道的道路或高速公路沿线的工厂，拆除可能需要更长的时间，但应优先考虑。
植物的日常维护包括路政署每六个月定期检查斜坡和种植区，以及康乐及文化事务署在绿地进行类似的工作。外包合同要求承包商在维护期间清除不需要的物种，包括银合欢。技术指令规定，有关部门可以直接拆除这些树木，无需事先批准或补偿，也不需要移植。
政府承认，由于该物种的恢复能力强，仅靠大规模清除并不能根除该物种。相反，各部门不断清除树桩和幼苗以耗尽土壤种子库，并重新种植植被以建立稳定的覆盖范围。为了提高效率，政府正在探索利用人工智能（AI）技术，通过图像分析和智能识别系统来识别路边的银合欢，从而实现更快的绘图和清除。
在公众教育方面，发展局已透过不同渠道分享资讯。 2025年底，与香港电台合作推出一档名为《森动香港》的电视节目，内容涉及银荆树管理。该局将继续利用社交媒体、学校材料、公开研讨会、在线讲座、期刊文章和研讨会来提高认识。然而，政府表示，清除工作应由经过培训的专业人员或承包商进行，因为这些植物通常生长在道路、斜坡或荒地上。市民请不要参与清除活动，但可向有关部门或拨打1823热线举报。

Hong Kong government outlines strategy to manage and remove Leucaena leucocephala | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 11 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong government outlines strategy to manage and remove Leucaena leucocephala
Hong Kong authorities are stepping up efforts to manage the invasive species Leucaena leucocephala, known locally as silver wattle. The government plans to use artificial-intelligence technology for identification, enforce removal within two to three weeks of discovery, and enhance public education,
The Hong Kong government has detailed its strategy for managing and removing the invasive species Leucaena leucocephala, or silver wattle, following a legislative council question on 11 November 2026. Authorities described the plant as a resilient foreign invasive species that hinders local species' natural succession and poses safety risks due to its brittle branches, which can break or collapse during strong winds.
In response to the question, the government confirmed that tree-management departments must follow technical directives from the Development Bureau. During annual pre-typhoon inspections and post-typhoon checks, departments assess trees in high-traffic areas and, upon discovering Leucaena leucocephala, arrange removal within two to three weeks. For plants along roads or highways requiring temporary traffic diversions, removal may take longer but is prioritised.
Routine plant maintenance includes regular inspections every six months by the Highways Department of slopes and planting areas, and similar work by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department in green spaces. Outsourced contracts require contractors to remove undesirable species, including Leucaena leucocephala, during maintenance. The technical directives specify that departments may directly remove such trees without prior approval or compensation, and they are not required to transplant them.
The government acknowledged that large-scale removal alone cannot eradicate the species due to its resilience. Instead, departments continuously remove stumps and seedlings to deplete the soil seed bank, and replant vegetation to establish stable cover. To improve efficiency, the government is exploring the use of artificial-intelligence (AI) technology to identify Leucaena leucocephala along roadsides through image analysis and smart recognition systems, enabling faster mapping and removal.
On public education, the Development Bureau has shared information via various channels. In late 2025, it launched a television programme called 森動香港 (Forest Hong Kong) with Radio Television Hong Kong, which covered silver wattle management. The bureau will continue using social media, school materials, public seminars, online lectures, journal articles, and workshops to raise awareness. However, the government stated that removal should be conducted by trained professionals or contractors, as the plants often grow along roads, on slopes, or in wasteland. Members of the public are advised not to participate in removal but can report sightings to relevant departments or the 1823 hotline.

香港提出新法以促进房地产投资信托基金重组和市场监管中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 11 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港提出新法以促进房地产投资信托基金重组和市场监管
香港财经事务及库务局局长于11月11日动议二读《2026年证券及期货（修订）条例草案》。该法案引入了房地产投资信托基金重组和强制收购的法定机制，并将市场不当行为规则扩大到涵盖上市公司
香港财经事务及库务局局长[姓名]于11月11日向立法会动议二读《2026年证券及期货（修订）条例草案》。该法案旨在巩固香港作为领先的国际资产和财富管理中心的地位，这是国家“十五五”规划明确支持的。
据行业报告，香港已成为全球最大的跨境财富管理中心，并有望在未来几年继续保持领先地位。证券及期货事务监察委员会（证监会）调查显示，截至2025年底，香港管理的资产规模创历史新高，达42.2万亿港元，同比增长20%。
该法案修订《证券及期货条例》（第571章）及其附属法例，为房地产投资信托基金（REITs）引入重组或强制收购的法定机制。该机制主要仿照《公司条例》（第622章），提供更清晰的合并、重组和私有化程序，同时确保单位持有人获得与公司法类似的保护。已进行调整以反映房地产投资信托基金的性质和特征。
该法案还加强了适用于香港联交所上市集体投资计划的市场不当行为和披露制度。目前《证券及期货条例》的规定更侧重于上市公司。证监会提出修订，明确涵盖上市集体投资计划，与国际监管标准保持一致，旨在增强投资者保护和信心。
证监会就该建议进行了公众咨询，并获得广泛支持。政府亦于七月征求立法会财经事务委员会的意见。业界和立法者普遍支持这些措施。
如果获得通过，该法案将分两个阶段实施。有关房地产投资信托基金制度和市场不当行为的修订将于刊宪后生效。有关内幕信息和利益披露的修正案预计将于 2027 年 12 月 4 日生效，以便行业有足够的时间熟悉更新的电子披露表格和指南。

Hong Kong proposes new law to boost REIT restructuring and market oversight | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 11 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong proposes new law to boost REIT restructuring and market oversight
Hong Kong's Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury moved the second reading of the Securities and Futures (Amendment) Bill 2026 on 11 November. The bill introduces a statutory mechanism for REIT restructuring and compulsory acquisition, and expands market misconduct rules to cover listed
Hong Kong’s Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, Mr. [Name], moved the second reading of the Securities and Futures (Amendment) Bill 2026 in the Legislative Council on 11 November. The bill aims to strengthen Hong Kong’s position as a leading international asset and wealth management centre, which the national 15th Five-Year Plan explicitly supports.
According to industry reports, Hong Kong has become the world’s largest cross-border wealth management centre and is expected to remain in the lead for the coming years. A Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) survey showed that assets under management in Hong Kong reached a record high of HK$42.2 trillion by the end of 2025, a year-on-year increase of 20 per cent.
The bill amends the Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571) and its subsidiary legislation to introduce a statutory mechanism for real estate investment trusts (REITs) to undertake restructuring or compulsory acquisition. The mechanism is largely modelled on the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622), providing clearer merger, restructuring and privatisation procedures while ensuring unit holders receive protections similar to those under company law. Adjustments have been made to reflect the nature and characteristics of REITs.
The bill also enhances the market misconduct and disclosure regime applicable to listed collective investment schemes on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. Current provisions under the Securities and Futures Ordinance focus more on listed companies. The SFC proposed amendments to explicitly cover listed collective investment schemes, aligning with international regulatory standards and aiming to boost investor protection and confidence.
The SFC conducted a public consultation on the proposals, which received broad support. The government also sought views from the Legislative Council’s Financial Affairs Committee in July. Industry and lawmakers generally backed the measures.
If passed, the bill will be implemented in two phases. Amendments relating to the REIT regime and market misconduct will take effect upon gazettal. Amendments on disclosure of inside information and interests are expected to take effect on 4 December 2027, allowing the industry sufficient time to familiarise itself with updated electronic disclosure forms and guidance.

content:
香港拟对滥用注册SIM卡进行刑事处罚中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 11 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港拟对滥用注册SIM卡实施刑事处罚
香港政府计划将每个电信运营商每人可注册的预付费 SIM 卡数量从 10 张减少到 3 张，并将对某些注册卡的不当使用定为刑事犯罪。此举旨在遏制欺诈行为，截至 9 月底，运营商已屏蔽了 18,000 多个诈骗号码。
香港商务及经济发展局局长邱腾华于 11 月 11 日向立法会表示，政府将建议将个人在每家电信运营商注册的预付费 SIM 卡的最大数量从 10 张减少至 3 张。继 2023 年 2 月全面实施电话智能卡强制实名登记后，该措施旨在减少滥用注册电话卡进行诈骗的情况。
丘表示，根据警方记录，截至9月底，电信运营商已封锁了超过18,000个涉嫌用于诈骗的本地和非本地电话号码。政府的数据分析显示，约98%的个人用户已经为每个运营商注册了不超过三张预付卡，因此预计减少预付卡数量对绝大多数用户影响不大，同时也能遏制犯罪分子的滥用。
为了进一步打击不当使用注册电话智能卡的行为，政府将提议将某些行为定为刑事犯罪，例如在没有合法授权或合理理由的情况下提供个人信息用于注册他人的电话卡。邱腾华表示，政府正在积极起草相关法律细节，并计划在未来几个月咨询公众和业界。
民建联立法会议员朱丽华建议，应以每人而非每名接线员设定限额，认为每名接线员三张卡仍有滥用的空间。邱腾华回应，许多其他国家和经济体也设定每个运营商三张卡的限制，政府必须平衡运营环境和公民的实际需求，但会在咨询期间深入研究此事。

Hong Kong proposes criminal penalties for misuse of registered SIM cards | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 11 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong proposes criminal penalties for misuse of registered SIM cards
Hong Kong's government plans to cut the number of pre-paid SIM cards each person can register per telecoms provider from 10 to 3, and will criminalise certain improper uses of registered cards. The move aims to curb fraud, with carriers having blocked over 18,000 scam numbers by end of September.
Hong Kong's Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development, Edward Yau, told the Legislative Council on 11 November that the government will propose lowering the maximum number of pre-paid SIM cards an individual can register with each telecoms provider from 10 to 3. The measure is designed to reduce the misuse of registered phone cards for scams, following the full implementation of mandatory real-name registration for phone smart cards in February 2023.
Yau said that by the end of September, telecoms operators had blocked more than 18,000 local and non-local phone numbers suspected of being used for fraud, based on police records. The government's data analysis shows that about 98 per cent of individual users already register no more than three pre-paid cards per operator, so the reduction is expected to have little impact on the vast majority of users while curbing abuse by criminals.
To further combat improper use of registered phone smart cards, the government will propose criminalising certain behaviours, such as providing personal information for the registration of another person's phone card without lawful authority or a reasonable excuse. Yau said the government is actively drafting the relevant legal details and plans to consult the public and industry in the coming months.
Lawmaker Chu Li-wah of the Democratic Alliance for the Betterment and Progress of Hong Kong suggested that the limit should be set per person rather than per operator, arguing that three cards per operator still leaves room for abuse. Yau responded that many other countries and economies also set a limit of three cards per operator, and that the government must balance the operating environment and the actual needs of citizens, but will study the matter in depth during the consultation period.

据称，五家参展商被当局禁止参展，且没有给出任何解释，香港独立书展的组织者呼吁公开和透明。香港独立书展Duk6 Duk6的海报。照片：Duk6 Duk6。 Duk6 Duk6是一个推广自行出版作品的“独立叙事图书节”，第四届将于11月14日至15日在荃湾南丰纱厂举行。据本地创作者非营利团体 Yun Hyun 介绍，今年的展会将有约 125 家参展商展示漫画、小说、杂志、动画和游戏。但组织者周末表示，由于“不可抗力”，五家参展商被取消了参展资格。 “我们最近收到有关部门的通知，称由于许可过程中出现不可抗力问题，某些参展商无法参加，”尹炫在社交媒体上用中文发帖表示，但没有具体说明涉及的政府部门。不可抗力——涵盖双方无法控制的事件的合同条款——是场地和活动合同的主要内容。然而，近年来，对于许多香港人来说，这个词越来越成为隐秘政治压力和审查制度的代名词。尹贤没有透露哪些参展商必须退出，只表示受影响的参展商包括漫画、小说作家和插画家。
该组织补充说，他们的作品主题广泛，从香港本土文化到科幻小说。该组织还呼吁当局明确审查制度，以便活动组织者能够更好地合作。 “近年来，类似的活动经常遇到类似的情况。希望相关部门能够有一个更加公开透明的机制，让创作者和组织者更容易合作。”尹贤说。 “我们不知道界线在哪里” 一位因担心遭到报复而不愿透露姓名的艺博会策展人告诉《香港新闻社》，组织者一直在向食物环境卫生署（食环署）寻求临时公众娱乐场所许可证。馆长表示，申请必须经过多个部门的审核。 “有一个部门打电话告诉我们，要么这五家参展商必须被移除，要么整个活动将被取消，但没有给出任何解释，”策展人说。食环署发言人周二回复《香港新闻报》时表示，食环署已于十月初收到Duk6 Duk6的临时公众娱乐场所牌照申请，并正在就“公共秩序及安全、消防安全、楼宇安全、机电设备、人群控制及卫生”等事宜咨询相关政府部门。食环署没有证实其或其他政府部门是否禁止某些参展商参加活动。
策展人补充说，上一届书展于 2025 年初举办，也遭遇了场馆管理部门针对特定参展商的审查。2025 年的 Duk6 Duk6 书展。照片：Duk6 Duk6。 “鉴于这次经历，并看到最近每一个类似的活动都面临着同样的障碍，我们当然做好了准备，”策展人说。 “不过，我们没想到一下子就有五个参展商被 DQ [取消资格]。”策展人表示，所有 125 家参展商均经过精心挑选，以确保不出现人工智能生成或抄袭的材料，并补充说，此次活动的布局是为了让

【原文 English Original】
Organisers of an independent Hong Kong book fair have called for openness and transparency after five exhibitors were allegedly barred by authorities without explanation. The poster of Duk6 Duk6, an independent book fair in Hong Kong. Photo: Duk6 Duk6. Duk6 Duk6, an “indie narrative book fest” that promotes self-published works, is set to hold its fourth edition on November 14 and 15 at The Mills in Tsuen Wan. This year’s fair will feature about 125 exhibitors showcasing comics, novels, zines, animation and games, according to Yun Hyun, a non-profit collective of local creators. But organisers said over the weekend that five exhibitors had been disqualified from the event due to “force majeure.” “We recently received notifications from relevant authorities stating that, owing to force majeure issues arising during the licensing process, certain exhibitors cannot participate,” Yun Hyun said in a social media post written in Chinese, without specifying the government departments involved. Force majeure – a contract clause covering events beyond the parties’ control – is a staple of venue and event contracts. Yet for many in Hong Kong in recent years, the phrase has increasingly become shorthand for covert political pressure and censorship . Yun Hyun did not name the exhibitors that had to withdraw, only saying that the affected exhibitors included comic and novel writers and illustrators. The themes of their works range from local Hong Kong culture to science fiction, the group added. The group also called on the authorities to provide clarity regarding censorship, so that event organisers can better cooperate. “In recent years, similar events have frequently encountered similar situations. It is hoped that relevant departments will have a more open and transparent mechanism to make it easier for creators and organisers to cooperate,” Yun Hyun said. ‘We don’t know where the line is’ A curator of the fair, speaking on condition of anonymity citing fear of reprisals, told HKFP that organisers had been seeking a Temporary Places of Public Entertainment Licence from the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department (FEHD). The application had to go through multiple departments for vetting, the curator said. “One department called and told us that either these five exhibitors had to be removed, or the whole event would be cancelled, without giving any explanation,” the curator said. In an emailed reply to HKFP on Tuesday, an FEHD spokesperson said the department received Duk6 Duk6’s Temporary Places of Public Entertainment Licence application in early October and is consulting relevant government departments regarding “public order and safety, fire safety, building safety, mechanical and electrical equipment, crowd control, and hygiene.” The FEHD did not confirm whether it or other government departments had barred certain exhibitors from the event. The curator added that the last edition of the book fair, held in early 2025, also encountered censorship against specific exhibitors by venue management. The Duk6 Duk6 book fair in 2025. Photo: Duk6 Duk6. “Given that experience, and seeing how every similar event lately has faced the same roadblocks, we were of course braced for it,” the curator said. “Still, we never imagined five exhibitors would be DQ’d [disqualified] in one go.” The curator said all 125 exhibitors were hand-picked to ensure no AI-generated or plagiarised material was featured, adding that the event’s layout was drafted to bring like-minded artists together. Losing five exhibitors at this stage added significantly to the team’s workload in vetting replacements and threatened to disrupt the carefully planned layout, the curator said. The sudden exclusions also dealt a heavy blow to the vendors, who had spent months preparing to debut new work at the event, the curator said. “Actually everyone wants to continue, but we don’t know where the line is drawn,” the curator said. “And we are not even trying to cross any lines, but even harmless things could be DQ’d.” “The economic environment in recent years has been poor, and coupled with the impact of AI, the entire creative community is facing great challenges,” the curator added. “As organisers, we hope that every creator and their work can be seen. But there’s only so much we can do.”

content: 作者： 徒步的骑手   2026年11月9日   徒步的騎手播客 #244 黄仁勋间谍门 Preview   Listen now   #244 黄仁勋间谍门 黄仁勋触碰了美国哪根高压线？知情不报还是故意视而不见？商业利益与国家安全撞车，谁说了算？｜英伟达48亿美元芯片去了哪里？ 10月29日，《纽约时报》刊发重磅报道，说美国政府正在调查一个名叫黄乐的中国女人，她跟英伟达老板黄仁勋关系密切。黄乐曾经在英伟达的大客户Megaspeed公司担任高管。美国情报机构怀疑，她是中国间谍，涉嫌帮助中国规避美国的AI芯片出口禁令，非法获得英伟达先进芯片。 短短两年中，Megaspeed从英伟达购买了超过48亿美元的芯片。美国情报部门在调查黄乐和Megaspeed公司的时候，发现她跟黄仁勋的关系远远超出一般商业往来。根据《纽约时报》的后续报导，美国情报官员认为，黄乐被中国国家安全部招募，任务就是接近黄仁勋，获取有关英伟达和美国AI芯片政策的情报。 对《纽约时报》的报导，黄仁勋和英伟达先是否认。但美国国会开始采取行动。11月4日，众议院三个委员会的主席联名致函黄仁勋，要求他11月18日到国会接受闭门简报质询。 是哪三个委员会呢？第一，外交事务委员会；第二，美中战略竞争特别委员会；第三，常设情报特别委员会。这里简单提一句，三个委员会的现任主席全部是共和党人。他们要求黄仁勋说明他跟黄乐的关系，英伟达是如何防止外国情报机构渗透的，是不是泄漏过敏感信息。 众议院三个委员会的主席发出质询函以后，黄仁勋和英伟达改了口。11月8日，黄仁勋承认了《纽约时报》报导的绯闻部分。同一天，英伟达董事会宣布，由独立董事组成调查委员会，而且将聘请外部律师，调查黄仁勋是否受到外国情报活动的影响。 美国情报部门和国会要调查的真正问题，不是黄仁勋中了美人计，而是美国的国家安全。具体来说，有这么几点：一是，黄仁勋知不知道黄乐的身份？二是，黄仁勋有没有向她泄漏敏感信息，甚至泄漏机密？第三，他们之间的关系有没有影响英伟达的商业决策？第四，她有没有通过黄仁勋来影响美国政府的芯片出口政策？ 现在，根据美国情报部门的判断，黄仁勋是中国情报活动的目标，但是，除了黄乐，是不是还有其他中国情报人员，也在攻这个目标？他们是不是跟黄乐一样，成功攻下了这个目标？这些问题要看调查结果，现在下结论为时尚早。 不过，我对黄仁勋陷入这场风波，并不觉得特别意外。 几年前，黄仁勋公开叫板拜登政府的芯片出口禁令。当时，我隐隐约约有一种预感，这家伙在玩火。具体说，他在激化一场商业利益与国家安全的冲突。 这场冲突在当时， 就已经受到美国政府职能部门和国会的审视， 而且这种审视肯定会越来越严格。 这几年，英伟达如日中天，它的芯片是AI竞争的命门。中国的土皇帝上台以后，跟美国正面对抗，把美国当成假想敌，美国政府禁止英伟达向中国出口最先进的芯片。禁令一出，中国的各路人马八仙过海，通过第三国、空壳公司、层层转手，想方设法弄英伟达芯片。这些事，媒体一直有报道，美国司法部也起诉过好几起走私案。说黄仁勋对此一无所知，很难让人相信。 美国对中国的芯片管制，是从2022年10月开始的。拜登政府禁止向中国出口最先进的AI芯片。英伟达怎么应对呢？它把芯片性能降一格，刚好卡在管制线下面，造出专供中国市场的A800和H800。2023年10月，美国商务部收紧了标准，这两款也被禁了。英伟达再降一格，又造出H20。2023年12月，当时的商务部长雷蒙多，公开向英伟达喊话：你要是围着管制线兜圈子，设计出来一个，我第二天就禁一个。 英伟达跟美国政府玩这种猫捉老鼠的游戏，玩了好几年。不但如此，黄仁勋还公开向美国政府施压，要求放开对中国的芯片出口。川普上台后，他成功游说川普，放松了对中国的芯片出口管制。2025年4月，他在北京见中国官员，说英伟达会坚定不移服务中国市场。同年5月，他在台北的Computex展会上说：“All in all, the export control was a failure”——“总而言之，出口管制失败了。” 有他在那里上下其手，美国的芯片出口管制当然不会成功。 这里就有个问题。一个掌握美国关键技术的企业家，公开反对美国政府的技术出口限制；同时，他的重要客户涉嫌把芯片非法输送到中国，用各种手段规避出口管制。企业家的商业利益跟国家安全发生冲突的时候，究竟谁说了算？...

亚洲并未迎来人工智能热潮。它正在构建它。 bbert@hudson.org 星期二, 11/10/2026 - 11:36 SVG 评论 2026 年 11 月 10 日 GIS 报告亚洲并未迎来人工智能热潮。它正在构建它。人工智能的万亿美元激增贯穿亚洲工厂，其中台湾、日本和韩国拥有真正的影响力。 Riley Walters 高级研究员 Riley Walters 评论说明文字 2025 年 4 月 16 日，台湾新竹，一名骑自行车的人经过台积电 (TSMC) 的标志。 (Getty Images) 切换目录 目录 内容 分享到 Twitter Twitter 分享到 Facebook Facebook 分享到 LinkedIn LinkedIn 分享到电子邮件 电子邮件 打印 打印 对人工智能的需求正在激增，推动了经济增长，头条新闻主要集中在北美。但如果将亚洲包括在内，全球人工智能及相关行业的总支出预计将在 2026 年突破 1 万亿美元。现代基础设施的出口和投资增加正在推动日本、韩国和台湾等大型经济体的发展，同时也帮助菲律宾和越南等中等收入经济体迈向更高收入水平。美国对人工智能的高需求在一定程度上推动了中美之间在人工智能方面的竞争，这支撑了亚洲制造业的繁荣。到 2030 年，美国在人工智能方面的资本支出预计将超过 2 万亿美元。中国计划在同一时间内投资 3000 亿美元用于数据中心。不想落后于美国
或中国，其他亚洲国家的目标是建设自己的国内基础设施和制造业。人工智能生态系统通常可分为三个要素：模型、计算能力和供应链——美国和中国在前两个要素上竞争并领先。亚洲国家正在考虑如何在这场激烈的东西方竞争中脱颖而出，同时利用其在技术制造供应链方面的优势。这使得较小的经济体认识到自己的竞争优势，同时在制造业和机器人、代理用途和制药等各个行业投资人工智能的新颖应用。无论美国对人工智能的需求继续增长还是停滞，我们都可以预期亚洲国家将继续投资其人工智能生态系统。由于亚洲国家要达到美国或中国的投资水平还有很长的路要走，政府和行业不希望失去技术和经济繁荣的势头。亚洲人工智能战略：使用和制造亚洲是全球人工智能发展的核心。一个数据中心可容纳多达 4500 万个芯片，其中大部分半导体制造工艺、服务器主板和机架组装均在台湾、马来西亚、菲律宾、韩国和越南进行。
亚洲已完全融入人工智能组件链：虽然服务器和图形处理单元主要由美国公司设计，但如果没有韩国制造存储芯片和台湾公司将这些组件组装在一起，我们就不会看到全球数据中心投资热潮。自 2023 年美国科技公司开始将每年的数据中心建设量增加近一倍以来，亚洲服务器和服务器零部件出口呈指数级增长。亚洲的服务器和服务器零部件出口到 2024 年将增长 50%，到 2025 年将增长 110%。这些零部件的最大单一来源是台湾。人工智能现已成为亚洲各国政府的优先事项

Asia Is Not Riding the AI Boom. It Is Building It. bbert@hudson.org Tue, 11/10/2026 - 11:36 SVG Commentary Nov 10, 2026 GIS Reports Asia Is Not Riding the AI Boom. It Is Building It. AI’s trillion-dollar surge runs through Asian factories, where Taiwan, Japan, and South Korea hold real leverage.   Riley Walters Senior Fellow Riley Walters Commentary Caption A cyclist passes the logo of the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) in Hsinchu, Taiwan, on April 16, 2025. (Getty Images) Toggle Table of Contents Contents Contents Share to Twitter Twitter Share to Facebook Facebook Share to LinkedIn LinkedIn Share to E-mail E-mail Print Print Demand for artificial intelligence is surging and boosting economic growth, with the headlines focusing on North America. But when Asia is included, total worldwide spending on AI and related industries is expected to top $1 trillion in 2026. Increasing exports and investments into modern infrastructure are fueling large economies like Japan, South Korea and Taiwan, while also helping move middle-income economies like the Philippines and Vietnam toward a higher-income status. Competition between the United States and China on AI, fueled partly by the high demand for AI in the U.S., is supporting the Asian manufacturing boom. America’s capital expenditure in AI is forecast to surpass $2 trillion by 2030. China plans to invest $300 billion on data centers over the same timeline. Not wanting to fall behind either the U.S. or China, other Asian countries aim to build their own domestic infrastructure and manufacturing. The AI ecosystem can be generally separated between three elements: models, compute power and supply chains – with the U.S. and China competing and leading for the first two. Asian countries are looking at how they can stand out amid this intense East-West competition, while capitalizing on their strengths in technology manufacturing supply chains. This has led smaller economies to identify their competitive advantages while investing in novel applications for AI in various industries such as manufacturing and robotics, agentic uses and pharmaceuticals. Whether American demand for AI continues to grow or stagnates, we can expect Asian countries to continue to invest in their AI ecosystems. As countries across Asia have a long way to go before reaching the level of investments seen in either the U.S. or China, governments and industries do not want to lose the momentum of this technological and economic boom. Asian AI strategies: Use and manufacturing Asia is at the heart of the global buildout in AI. One data center can hold as many as 45 million chips – with much of the semiconductor manufacturing process, server boards and rack assembly happening across Taiwan, Malaysia, the Philippines, South Korea and Vietnam. Asia is fully integrated into the AI component chain: While servers and graphics processing units are largely designed by American firms, we would not see the global boom in investment in data centers without South Koreans building memory chips and Taiwanese companies putting these components together. The growth in Asian exports of servers and server parts has been exponential since American tech companies in 2023 began nearly doubling their annual build-out of data centers. Server and server parts exports from Asia increased 50 percent in 2024 and 110 percent in 2025. The largest single source for these components was Taiwan. AI is now a priority for all governments in Asia, with each taking a different approach. Government-to-government coordination is focusing on finding ways to collaborate in the regulatory space on issues like export controls and supply chain monitoring. Elected officials are looking to support their domestic industries in the hope that local companies increase their participation in global markets. The epicenter of AI technology is Taiwan Taiwan is at the center of the AI boom and benefitting economically. Its annual gross domestic product (GDP) growth has increased sharply, from just 1.5 percent in 2023 to 13 percent in 2026. But Taipei does not want to simply remain a manufacturer of AI components. In May of 2024, President Lai Ching-te, also known as William Lai, announced his administration’s “five trusted industry sectors”: semiconductors, AI, military, security and surveillance, and next-gen communication. His administration expanded this effort with its Ten AI Initiatives Promotion Plan (2025-2028) . This plan includes investing in smart living, promoting AI for small- and medium-sized companies, increasing Taiwan’s international competitiveness in software development, expanding silicon photonics production capabilities, moving into quantum and robotic technologies, boosting domestic compute capability and investing in domestic AI talent and literacy. In 2026 alone, Taipei allocated approximately $1 billion toward this plan. At the same time, the government is investing in AI capabilities in other areas of national interest, such as its integration into drone and defense technologies and allocating approximately $330 million toward AI start-ups. Japan’s industrial and financing edge Japanese firms have an even greater interest in facilitating AI development and production. The country’s companies are essential for providing the semiconductor manufacturing equipment, chemicals and gases that go into chip production. Investors in Japan are taking significant financial stakes in the growth of AI. The Nikkei 225, Japan’s most-watched stock market index, which tracks the top blue-chip companies, is up nearly 80 percent from just two years ago. Tech firms are capturing much of the gains. In July 2026, the government of Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi released Japan’s Growth Strategy , a document outlining a new economic plan for Japan and identifying 17 strategic fields to prioritize. AI and semiconductors together are the first priority on this list – with specific interest in physical AI (for robotics), increasing domestic semiconductor production and expanding vertical, or bespoke, AI. Tokyo has proposed a budget of over $3 billion for its AI transformation. These efforts build on the government working for years to expand Japan’s domestic production of semiconductors, including welcoming international companies like Taiwan’s TSMC investment in the Kumamoto prefecture for the production of advanced logic chips. U.S.-based Micron is investing $9.6 billion in Japanese production of AI memory chips. Tokyo-based Kioxia and America’s Sandisk have announced a $31 billion partnership, also in memory chips production. Meanwhile, the Takaichi administration continues to investment in its flagship program to indigenously create leading edge logic chips in the Rapidus program. South Korea aims for an AI-enabled society Over the last year, technology exports, much of which are AI related, have contributed at least a quarter of South Korea’s GDP growth. The nation’s stock market has made significant gains as well – at one point in 2026 doubling in value in the last 12 months before investors took profits. In early 2026, President Lee Jae Myung unveiled the AI Action Plan (2026-2028), which has the goal of positioning South Korea as one of the top three global leaders in the technology. The initiative has three policy pillars: Building an AI innovation ecosystem, fostering a nationwide AI transformation and contributing to a global AI-enabled society. To get there, the plan identifies 99 implementation tasks and makes over 300 policy recommendations. Progress will be monitored by a newly established National AI Strategy Committee. A national AI budget of more than $7 billion was allocated in 2026 toward the implementation of this action plan. Next year’s budget, which should lead to the “ world’s highest performance ” sovereign AI model, is expected to exceed 2026’s total. Like many of these government-led initiatives, Seoul’s plan is not just state-funded AI developments; it also encourages greater private sector investment, aiming for an additional $22 billion worth of private investment. Samsung and SK Hynix, the world’s leaders in high-bandwidth memory chip production, have agreed to invest $520 billion over the next five years for new chip production across the Korean Peninsula. American industry growing in Asia American industries understand that Asia is not only a hub for AI innovation and manufacturing, but that there is also strong demand for AI use in the region. Cloud service leaders plan major investments in Asia: Amazon Web Services plans to invest over $14 billion in Japan and $33 billion (by 2039) across Southeast Asia. Data companies like Google are breaking ground on billion-dollar data centers in Thailand and Malaysia. California-based Nvidia plans to open a new Asian headquarters in Taiwan, along with plans to spend $150 billion annually across the island’s AI supply chain. Its plans include building a 100-megawatt data center in southern Taiwan with domestic partner Foxconn.  Scenarios More likely: Heavy investment across Asia’s AI supply chain In the years ahead, expect governments and industry to continue to invest heavily across Asia’s AI supply chain, including in the energy sector. As the U.S. and China rapidly develop their AI ecosystems, Asian countries will find ways to integrate into the global ecosystem, developing their own capabilities. Growth in investments and exports will continue to support regional economic growth. Eventually, we will see greater mutual competition among Japan, Taiwan and South Korea – especially as each of them seeks to develop a leading edge in physical AI. Not only will Tokyo, Taipei and Seoul compete through the export of manufactured goods, but they will gradually challenge each other’s market position across South Asia, Southeast Asia and Latin America, through the export of their AI software. Less likely: Growth in Asian AI slowed by U.S.-China competition In the less likely scenario, Asian countries are deterred by U.S.-China competition in AI. This is unlikely because even if the U.S. moderates its development in AI amid slowing down data center construction or concerns about the risks posed by frontier AI models, there are still plenty of investment opportunities across the AI supply chain. Due to demographic realities, manufacturing and exports are essential to Asian economies. AI is expected to support transitions as each country manages declines in their populations and workforce while maintaining economic growth and prosperity. Read in GIS Reports. Enjoyed this analysis? title: 黄仁勋婚外情牵出间谍疑云：美中媒体如何讲述同一个故事？
summary: 资料照片：英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在北京中国国际供应链博览会开幕式后，被媒体包围。(2025年7月16日) 华盛顿 — 英伟达(Nvidia)首席执行官黄仁勋承认婚外情，引发美国和中国舆论关注。不过，与一般的企业高管私人生活丑闻不同，这起事件还牵涉有关中国情报活动的指控，以及美国超级智能(通常称人工智能或AI)芯片产业面临的国家安全问题。 美国主流媒体的报道主要围绕黄仁勋与一名被怀疑可能与中国情报机构有关的女性有婚外情，并探讨这段关系是否可能涉及商业机密泄露，甚至危及美国国家安
content: 资料照片：英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在北京中国国际供应链博览会开幕式后，被媒体包围。(2025年7月16日) 华盛顿 — 英伟达(Nvidia)首席执行官黄仁勋承认婚外情，引发美国和中国舆论关注。不过，与一般的企业高管私人生活丑闻不同，这起事件还牵涉有关中国情报活动的指控，以及美国超级智能(通常称人工智能或AI)芯片产业面临的国家安全问题。 美国主流媒体的报道主要围绕黄仁勋与一名被怀疑可能与中国情报机构有关的女性有婚外情，并探讨这段关系是否可能涉及商业机密泄露，甚至危及美国国家安全。 中国官方媒体则采取了明显不同的报道角度。它们提及黄仁勋的婚外情，但着重质疑有关中国间谍活动的说法，指责西方媒体借此炒作中国威胁论，甚至可能试图破坏美中关系。 美媒：从私人关系延伸到国家安全 美国《纽约时报》、《华尔街日报》以及其他西方媒体的报道，将这起事件置于美国与中国围绕超级智能技术展开竞争的大背景下。 相关报道指出，与黄仁勋有关系的女性黄乐(Alice Huang)据称与一家总部位于新加坡的数据中心企业超速国际(Megaspeed International)有关联。这家公司涉及英伟达先进超级智能芯片的商业活动，因此引起美国方面的关注。 《纽约时报》报道说，美国情报部门怀疑黄乐可能与中国情报机构存在联系，并向北京提供过信息。不过，这些指控目前尚未通过公开的司法程序得到证实。 《华尔街日报》星期一(11月9日)以时间线方式，详细报道从与黄乐有关的Megaspeed于2023年从一家中国公司分拆成立开始，回顾黄仁勋与黄乐在2024年、2025年同场出现，以及美国商务部随后调查Megaspeed是否将英伟达先进芯片转运至中国。 报道还梳理了特朗普政府对英伟达对华出口政策的讨论，以及美国情报部门在2026年春季向政府高层传阅机密备忘录的说法。到了11月8日，黄仁勋承认对妻子不忠，英伟达董事会随即启动独立调查。 黄仁勋事件之所以引人关注，与英伟达在美国科技产业和国家安全领域的重要地位密切相关。 作为全球领先的超级智能芯片制造商，英伟达不仅是美国科技产业的重要企业，也处于华盛顿对华高科技出口管制政策争论的中心。 黄仁勋过去多次公开反对过度限制美国企业向中国市场销售先进芯片，认为过于严厉的出口限制可能削弱美国企业的竞争力，同时推动中国加快发展自己的半导体产业。 目前没有公开证据证明黄仁勋明知对方从事情报活动，也没有确凿证据表明英伟达的商业机密已经因此泄露。 中国官方媒体：质疑间谍指控，强调政治动机 中国官方媒体对这起事件的报道呈现出明显不同的侧重点，主要通过否认和质疑间谍指控，批评美国媒体的报道方式及其背后的政治动机。 中国官媒《环球时报》将事件与当前美中关系联系起来，质疑有关指控出现的时机，认为有关报道可能意在制造美中之间的对立。 《环球时报》星期一发布题为《黄仁勋出轨，还能扯上中国？》的快评，称这一事件“让美国媒体为之疯狂”，并批评《纽约时报》有关黄仁勋婚外情对象可能是中国间谍的报道捕风捉影。 《环球时报》写道：“仅仅是几张有东方面孔的照片、英伟达此前推动放宽对华贸易限制的行动，在其中加入了所谓“知情人士”的话和媒体的“怀疑”，就足以将事情添油加醋为“中国女间谍渗透美国芯片公司”。向来自诩“客观”的美国媒体正是这样生产故事的。” 环球之后说，在美中关系趋于缓和之际，出现此类新闻，是有些人“在背后放冷枪”。 这篇评论随后被凤凰网、新浪、网易、腾讯等多家中国媒体转载，使其观点在中国网络媒体上得到进一步传播。 与美国媒体相比，这些报道较少深入讨论美国情报部门提出的具体疑点，也没有将相关情报指控作为报道的主要调查方向。报道的重点更多放在质疑美国媒体的消息来源、证据基础以及报道动机上。 中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆星期一在回应有关报道时，也否认中国从事相关间谍活动，称“所谓‘中国间谍’的论调纯属捕风捉影，污蔑抹黑。” 中国社交媒体：对婚外情的关注不亚于间谍疑云 中国社交媒体上的讨论则呈现出更加多元的面貌。 微博上，部分网民对黄仁勋的私人生活表示惊讶或失望。黄仁勋长期以来在中国科技界和商业界拥有较高知名度，不少中国公众将他视为华人科技企业家的代表人物。 在小红书上，除了讨论黄仁勋的婚外情及其可能涉及的间谍疑云，也有不少网友关注事件对英伟达股价的影响。 星期一早间，英伟达股价一度下跌超过8%，引发投资者讨论。有网友调侃说：“他犯的错，我买单。” 这些讨论显示，对不少中国网民来说，黄仁勋的私人生活、公众形象以及英伟达的市场表现，都是这起事件值得关注的方面。相比之下，间谍指控并非所有讨论的中心。

Nurnisa Kurban for Uyghur Academic Foundation
Nurnisa Kurban is organizing this fundraiser to benefit Uyghur Academic Foundation.
Nurnisa Kurban for Uyghur Academic Foundation
Uyghur Cultural Preservation and Survival Through Education
The Uyghur people have been persecuted and subjected to repressive Chinese government policies in their Indigenous homeland of East Turkestan for many years. It is estimated that up to three million Uyghurs have been interned, imprisoned, and enslaved in detention centers, prisons, and forced labor facilities throughout China since 2017.
In 2021, the Uyghur Tribunal found that China was committing genocide and other crimes against humanity against Uyghurs. In 2022, the United Nations also concluded that China was committing human rights violations against Uyghurs amounting to crimes against humanity. Countries including the United States, Canada, the Netherlands, Czech Republic, United Kingdom, Lithuania, Belgium, and France have all declared a genocide in East Turkestan. Despite these declarations of genocide and related reports by various human rights organizations, atrocities against Uyghurs continue today with very limited international recognition and accountability.
During this time of ongoing genocide and cultural erasure in their Indigenous homeland, Uyghurs of the diaspora are working to preserve their culture and identity as a matter of survival. Uyghur education has been eradicated by the Chinese State, Uyghur texts are forbidden and in danger of being eliminated, and the Uyghur language itself is prohibited.
Uyghur scholars, linguists, and other specialists in the diaspora worldwide serve on the Uyghur Language and Education Committee of the Uyghur Academy to preserve the work of Uyghur intellectuals who have been persecuted and forcibly disappeared. This work has been ongoing since 2009 and is continuing to expand.
The Committee has created standards-aligned K-5 textbooks, which include classic and contemperory Uyghur literature, poetry, historical texts, and biographies for Uyghur children to learn about their own culture and identity in their native language. The Committee is seeking funding to expand and revise the existing K-5 textbooks, create teacher’s edition textbooks for educators, and design supplemental resources. They also hope to develop Middle and High School textbooks and related supplemental resources. To effectively implement these educational materials, they would also like to provide training for teachers.
Please consider supporting this urgent work of the Uyghur Academic Foundation as a matter of cultural survival for future generations of the Uyghur people.

zh_title: 英伟达间谍案女子持香港护照入境台湾
summary: 英伟达间谍案女子持香港护照入境台湾中国劳工公告 星期三, 11 11 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 英伟达间谍案中的女子持香港护照进入台湾 台湾移民机构证实，被指控为中国从事间谍活动并与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋有染的黄爱丽 (Alice Huang) 使用香港护照进入台湾。当局表示，她的许可证已被吊销，他们正在审查程序。台湾移民署周三证实，这名被指控为中国从事间谍活动的女子
content:
英伟达间谍案女子持香港护照入境台湾中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 11 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
英伟达间谍案女子持香港护照入境台湾
台湾移民机构证实，被指控为中国从事间谍活动并与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋有染的黄爱丽 (Alice Huang) 使用香港护照进入台湾。当局表示，她的许可证已被吊销，他们正在审查程序。
台湾移民署周三证实，这名被指控在与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋有染期间为中国从事间谍活动的女子使用香港护照进入台湾。林洪恩局长告诉记者：“我国政府相关机构已充分了解相关记录和信息。”我们知道她所有相关的出入境记录。”
总部位于新加坡的 Megaspeed 的中国前高管爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 被美国官员指控为中国情报部门工作。黄仁勋承认了此事，但​​北京方面否认了间谍指控。英伟达董事会周日宣布，已对这位与爱丽丝·黄没有关系的首席执行官兼联合创始人展开调查。
一般来说，香港护照持有者比持有中国大陆护照的人更容易进入台湾，后者还必须申请特别许可才能前往台湾。额外的限制部分是由于中国与台湾之间的复杂关系，北京声称并誓言要将台湾置于其控制之下。
台湾内政部长刘世芳表示，黄丽娟“确实入境了，但目前在海外”。她告诉立法者：“如果我们知道她是间谍，我们肯定不会让她进入台湾。我们将审查我们的程序，特别是预筛选、临时抽查和访谈以及访问后措施。”刘补充道：“据我们了解，这位黄女士的许可证已被吊销，这意味着她不可能再次进入台湾。”刘周二表示，台湾“国家安全部门正在积极调查此事”。
2025 年 5 月，台湾顶级科技博览会台北国际电脑展期间，黄仁勋 (Alice Huang)，又名黄乐 (Huang Le)，出席了黄仁勋在台北一家中餐厅举办的晚宴。新闻直播显示，黄仁勋用手臂搂住黄爱丽，她亲吻了他的右脸颊。

Woman in Nvidia spying case entered Taiwan on Hong Kong passport | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 11 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Woman in Nvidia spying case entered Taiwan on Hong Kong passport
Taiwan's immigration agency confirmed that Alice Huang, accused of spying for China while having an affair with Nvidia chief Jensen Huang, used a Hong Kong passport to enter Taiwan. Authorities say her permit has been revoked and they are reviewing procedures.
Taiwan's National Immigration Agency confirmed on Wednesday that the woman accused of spying for China during an affair with Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang used a Hong Kong passport to enter the island. Director-General Lin Horng-en told reporters: 'Our government's relevant agencies are fully informed of the relevant records and information. We were aware of all her relevant entry and exit records.'
Alice Huang, a Chinese former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed, is alleged by US officials to have been working for Chinese intelligence. Jensen Huang has admitted to the affair, but Beijing has rejected the spying allegations. Nvidia's board announced on Sunday that it had opened a probe into the chief executive and co-founder, who is no relation to Alice Huang.
It is generally easier for Hong Kong passport holders to enter Taiwan than those with mainland Chinese passports, who must also apply for special permission to travel there. The additional restrictions are partly due to the complex relations between China and Taiwan, which Beijing claims and has vowed to bring under its control.
Taiwan's Interior Minister Liu Shyh-fang said Alice Huang 'did indeed enter the country, but she is currently overseas'. She told lawmakers: 'If we had known she was a spy, we certainly would not have let her enter Taiwan. We will review our procedures, specifically our pre-screening, interim spot checks and interviews, and post-visit measures.' Liu added: 'As far as we understand, this Ms Huang has had her permit revoked, meaning it is impossible for her to enter Taiwan again.' On Tuesday, Liu said Taiwan's 'national security units are actively investigating the matter'.
Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le, was seen at a dinner in May 2025 hosted by Jensen Huang at a Chinese restaurant in Taipei during Computex, the island's top tech expo. Press livestreams show Jensen Huang putting his arm around Alice Huang as she kisses him on the right cheek.

title: 川習會前 貝森特談美中AI合作：分歧難忽視
summary: 2026年9月9日，貝森特在2026年共和黨全國代表大會首日發表演說。（John Fredricks／英文大紀元） 【大紀元2026年11月11日訊】（大紀元記者陳霆綜合報導）川普與習近平預計下週在深圳會晤。週二（11月10日），美國財長貝森特表示，美中預計將交流先進人工智能（AI）模型發布前的評估與測試方法，並正建立嚴重事故通報管道。他強調，雙方雖尋求合作以降低風險，但在AI競爭與國家利益上的分歧不容忽視。 貝森特（Scott Bessent）是在紐約舉行的美中關係全國委員
content:
2026年9月9日，貝森特在2026年共和黨全國代表大會首日發表演說。（John Fredricks／英文大紀元）
【大紀元2026年11月11日訊】（大紀元記者陳霆綜合報導）川普與習近平預計下週在深圳會晤。週二（11月10日），美國財長貝森特表示，美中預計將交流先進人工智能（AI）模型發布前的評估與測試方法，並正建立嚴重事故通報管道。他強調，雙方雖尋求合作以降低風險，但在AI競爭與國家利益上的分歧不容忽視。
貝森特（Scott Bessent）是在紐約舉行的美中關係全國委員會（NCUSCR）成立60周年晚宴上發表這番談話。當前，美中正競逐AI技術領先地位，英偉達（Nvidia，輝達）執行長黃仁勳亦因涉及中共情報活動疑慮的私人關係而捲入調查，令高端芯片與國家安全問題再次受到關注。
貝森特說，在川普總統指示下，美國已開始與中方建立有關「超級智能」（superintelligence，簡稱SI）的對話，目的是防範共同風險，避免雙方產生誤解。
「我們也期望交流最佳做法，包括如何在先進模型發布前進行評估與測試，以及如何確保人類的判斷始終牢牢掌控這項技術。」貝森特說。
他表示，雙方正在建立直接溝通管道，以便任一國家的超級智能模型發生嚴重事件時，迅速向對方通報。
這些安排並非首次提出。美國今年稍早已提議設立AI國家安全事件通報機制，川普與習近平隨後於9月24日在白宮會晤，同意建立超級智能對話機制及相關事故通報管道。
貝森特表示，隨著超級智能持續發展，兩國將需要新的風險管理方式，並須在競爭與領導者的責任之間尋求平衡。
貝森特說：「在這個過程中，我們不應對美中之間的分歧抱有任何幻想。」
他並指出：「正如我先前所說，我們的利益不會總是一致。同樣地，我們應對每一項挑戰的方法，也不會總是趨同。」
他以已故美國前國務卿基辛格（Henry Kissinger）為例，指出基辛格晚年認為超級智能的出現可能帶來新型戰略危險。
在美中推進AI對話之際，黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）近日因私人關係捲入國安爭議。黃仁勳被指與一名中國女商人有婚外情，而美國情報機構懷疑該女子涉及中共情報活動。
黃仁勳已承認對妻子不忠，但未說明關係細節。英偉達董事會已啟動獨立調查，並表示目前沒有理由相信美國國家安全或公司機密受到損害。
除AI議題外，貝森特也在演說中重申，美中此前已設立「貿易委員會」（Board of Trade）與「投資委員會」（Board of Investment）。雙方已透過貿易委員會，就各300億美元非敏感商品尋求更優惠關稅待遇達成共識，並成立農業貿易壁壘工作小組。
他還表示，中方此前同意在未來兩年從美國進口至少2,500萬公噸大豆和1,000萬公噸煤炭；投資委員會則將討論美企在中國的市場准入，以及提高中國企業經營環境可預測性等議題。
貝森特說，美國對中國的貿易逆差長期引發摩擦，美方的目標是「降低風險，而不是脫鉤」，並主張美國應增加生產、中國應增加國內消費。
美中貿易休戰安排將於明年1月到期。上週五，美國貿易代表格里爾（Jamieson Greer）與財長貝森特同中共副總理何立峰舉行視訊會議。格里爾要求北京採取具體行動，全面履行農產品採購、稀土及其它關鍵礦產等既有承諾。
