title: China Lifts The Veil On Its GJ-11 Mysterious Dragon Stealth UCAV
zh_title: 中国揭开GJ-11神秘龙隐形无人机的面纱
summary: 中国为我们提供了迄今为止最清晰的 GJ-11 隐形无人战斗机 (UCAV) 展示，新的官方镜头揭示了这款飞翼无人机以前未见过的细节，包括其内部武器舱、起落架、安装在机头的传感器以及独特的排气装置。与此同时，中国人民解放军空军 (PLAAF) 还声称，GJ-11 已经完成了首次实弹打击任务，取得了成功。这有点令人费解，因为无人战斗机已经进行了多年的测试架次，包括在前方
content:
中国为我们提供了迄今为止最清晰的 GJ-11 隐形无人战斗机 (UCAV) 展示，新的官方镜头揭示了这款飞翼无人机以前未见过的细节，包括其内部武器舱、起落架、安装在机头的传感器以及独特的排气装置。与此同时，中国人民解放军空军 (PLAAF) 还声称，GJ-11 已经完成了首次实弹打击任务，取得了成功。这有点令人费解，因为无人作战飞机多年来已经进行了多次测试，包括在前沿作战地点，而且在此之前几乎无法想象是否进行过实弹武器投送。也许这是在转换过程中丢失某些东西的情况，例如使用新的内部传感器或新型武器发射。跑道上 GJ-11 的正面视图。 PLA screencap 这段视频昨天由中国国家电视台中央电视台播出，距离中国人民解放军空军成立 77 周年还有两天。随附的报告提供了有关该飞机预期任务集的更多详细信息，包括空袭和压制敌方防空系统（SEAD），以及它与有人战斗机的有人与无人编队（MUM-T）行动的整合。
新披露的信息让公众对 GJ-11 的配置有了最全面的了解，并进一步了解中国打算如何使用这款名为“玄龙”的隐形飞翼飞机。GJ-11 起飞。 PLA screencap 仔细观察 GJ-11 最暴露的视图之一显示了 GJ-11 的底面，清楚地暴露了其两个内部武器舱。腹侧舱位于飞机的混合翼体内，具有独立的门组，具有独特的锯齿状边缘——这是低可观察性飞机的常见特征。舱室的内部布局和尺寸仍不清楚，飞机可容纳的武器的精确范围也不清楚。然而，每个舱室似乎可以容纳至少 1,000 磅级武器，甚至可能容纳 2,000 磅级武器。 #GTMilitaryWatch 央视新闻军事频道周一发布了新镜头，以多角度特写镜头展示了中国人民解放军 (PLA) 空军的 GJ-11 隐形无人机。它还透露，空军首批自行训练的两架女无人机… pic.twitter.com/PPVmws9DJJ —《环球时报》（@globaltimesnews）2026年11月9日 据央视报道，这两个舱可携带多种空对地/水面弹药。
此前，中国航空工业集团公司 (AVIC) 在 2021 年中国航展上展示的 GJ-11 模型中曾透露过武器舱配置，但新的镜头可以更好地展示实际飞机。机库中 GJ-11 的正面视图，武器舱门部分打开。 PLA screencap 内部武器架是 GJ-11 隐蔽性设计的核心，使其能够携带弹药，而不会受到与外部挂架和挂具相关的雷达信号（和空气动力学）影响。此前于 2025 年 11 月发布的视频显示，GJ-11 正在飞行，起落架仍处于伸出状态。然而，其中一个新序列显示飞机起飞，随后的侧视图和后视图捕捉到了其起落架在升空后收回的情况。起落架本身非常坚固，包括一个重型起落架

【原文 English Original】
China has provided us with the clearest look yet at its GJ-11 stealth uncrewed combat aerial vehicle (UCAV), with new official footage revealing previously unseen details of the flying-wing drone, including its internal weapons bays, landing gear, nose-mounted sensor installation, and distinctive exhaust arrangement. The release also comes alongside a claim from the People’s Liberation Army Air Force (PLAAF) that the GJ-11 has completed its first live-fire strike mission, scoring a hit. This is somewhat puzzling, since the UCAV has racked up test sorties for years already, including at forward operating locations, and it seems almost inconceivable that a live weapons delivery would not have been conducted before now. Perhaps this is a case of something being lost in translation, such as the use of a new internal sensor or a new type of weapon delivery. Head-on view of a GJ-11 on the runway. PLA screencap The footage, broadcast by Chinese state television’s CCTV yesterday, comes two days ahead of the 77th anniversary of the founding of the PLAAF. Accompanying reporting provides additional details about the aircraft’s intended mission set, including airstrikes and suppression of enemy air defenses (SEAD), as well as its integration into manned-unmanned teaming (MUM-T) operations with crewed fighters. The new disclosures offer the most comprehensive public look yet at the GJ-11’s configuration and provide further insight into how China intends to employ the stealthy flying-wing aircraft, which is named Xuanlong — Chinese for Mystery Dragon. A GJ-11 takes off. PLA screencap A closer look at the GJ-11 One of the most revealing views shows the underside of the GJ-11, clearly exposing its two internal weapons bays. Located within the aircraft’s blended wing-body, the ventral bays have separate sets of doors with distinctive serrated edges — a common feature on low-observable aircraft. The internal arrangement and dimensions of the bays remain unclear, as does the precise range of weapons the aircraft can accommodate. However, it would appear likely that each bay can accommodate at least a 1,000-pound-class and likely a 2,000-pound-class weapon. #GTMilitaryWatch CCTV News military channel released new footage on Monday offering a close-up, multi-angle look at the Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) Air Force's GJ-11 stealth drone. It also revealed that two of the Air Force's first batch of self-trained female drone… pic.twitter.com/PPVmws9DJJ — Global Times (@globaltimesnews) November 9, 2026 According to CCTV , the two bays can carry a variety of air-to-ground/surface munitions. The weapons bay configuration had previously been revealed in a model of the GJ-11 displayed by the Aviation Industry Corporation of China (AVIC) at Airshow China in 2021, but the new footage provides a much better look at the actual aircraft. Head-on view of a GJ-11 in the hangar, with the weapons bay doors partially open. PLA screencap Internal weapons carriage is central to the GJ-11’s low-observable design, allowing it to carry munitions without the radar signature (and aerodynamic) penalties associated with external pylons and stores. Previous footage released in November 2025 showed the GJ-11 in flight with its landing gear remaining extended. However, one of the new sequences shows the aircraft taking off, with subsequent side and rear views capturing its landing gear retracting after liftoff. The landing gear itself is notably robust, including a heavy-duty twin-wheel nose unit. With that in mind, it may be the same landing gear as used in the GJ-21, a naval variant capable of operating from aircraft carriers and big-deck assault ships. A GJ-11 retracts its landing gear on takeoff. PLA screencap The new imagery also offers a closer look at a trapezoidal glazed fairing beneath the nose. This appears consistent with an electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) sensor installation. Its precise configuration and capabilities have not been disclosed, but it’s worth noting that similar-looking installations also appear on the crewed J-20 and J-35 fighters, with these systems apparently being analogous to the electro-optical targeting system, or EOTS, found on the F-35 . If the sensor on the GJ-11 works like an EOTS, it would provide the drone with precision targeting and identification, lasing, as well as a secondary infrared search-and-track emulation function. A view of a GJ-11 showing the undernose EO/IR sensor installation. PLA screencap Perhaps the most distinctive external feature remains the GJ-11’s exhaust arrangement, for what is reported to be a WS-13 turbofan engine. A close-up of the rear of the aircraft shows the flattened exhaust outlet, shielded and integrated into the upper rear portion of the flying-wing airframe. Combined with the dorsal air intake and the absence of conventional exposed engine nozzles, this configuration is intended to reduce the aircraft’s radar and infrared signatures, especially from the most critical view aspects. The GJ-11’s tailless, blended-wing configuration is by now a defining feature of low-observable UCAV designs. Close-up of the tail section of a GJ-11. PLA screencap At least some of the GJ-11s shown have an air data boom on the nose. While normally associated with early flight testing, the GJ-11 is now far beyond that. The booms could still be fitted for some envelope expansion and other flight test work, although it may also simply involve earlier footage. Airstrikes and suppression of enemy air defenses Beyond the new imagery, one of the more interesting aspects of the CCTV coverage is its description of the GJ-11’s intended operational role. The broadcaster identified airstrikes and SEAD among the aircraft’s mission sets. The latter is particularly significant, as penetrating or operating within heavily defended airspace to locate and suppress or destroy enemy air defense systems is the most dangerous mission for a crewed combat aircraft. A stealthy uncrewed aircraft could contribute to these operations by carrying precision-guided weapons into more contested areas, providing additional sensing and targeting capacity, or forcing an adversary to expend valuable air defense resources. The two internal weapons bays provide the means to carry air-to-surface munitions while retaining the aircraft’s low-observable configuration. However, we don’t know which specific weapons have been integrated, their quantities, or whether the GJ-11 can employ dedicated anti-radiation weapons for SEAD missions. Alternative SEAD/DEAD loads could include multiple Small Diameter Bomb (SDB) equivalents, including those that are networked, as we have seen in previous concept videos . Many other types of standoff weapons could also be carried, with the platform itself using onboard sensors for fixing the target or acquiring targeting information from other sources via a tactical data network. Overhead view of a GJ-11 outside the hangar. PLA screencap First live-fire strike claim According to CCTV , the GJ-11 has completed its first live-fire strike mission, with two members of the PLAAF’s initial batch of female drone operators participating in the operation. One of the operators, Shi Xiaoran, described encountering cloud cover that initially obscured the target. After circling once more, she located it and released the weapon, scoring a hit. A drone controller flies a GJ-11 from a command-and-control trailer. PLA screencap One aspect that remains unclear is the extent to which the aircraft can independently identify and engage targets. A successful strike would demonstrate weapons employment, but not necessarily autonomous targeting or engagement. A view of a GJ-11 showing its triangular engine intake and undernose sensor installation. PLA screencap Manned-unmanned teaming with J-16 and J-20 fighters Perhaps the most strategically important aspect of the new coverage is its emphasis on manned-unmanned teaming. The CCTV footage showed mission planning involving a GJ-11 operating alongside J-16 Flanker multirole fighters and, in a separate sequence, J-20 fifth-generation stealth fighters. This provides a more explicit indication of the role China envisions for the GJ-11 within its broader combat aviation ecosystem. The J-16 provides a powerful multirole platform for strike and electronic warfare-related missions , while the J-20 offers a stealthy crewed counterpart for operations in highly contested airspace. An uncrewed aircraft operating alongside either type could extend the formation’s sensor coverage, carry additional weapons, conduct reconnaissance, or undertake particularly hazardous missions. A J-16D electronic warfare aircraft. via Chinese internet As a loyal wingman, the GJ-11’s role would extend beyond simply carrying weapons, with the UCAV able to act as an additional airborne sensor and strike platform, allowing crewed aircraft to distribute tasks across a larger formation. At the same time, the footage does not establish how the UCAVs communicate with their crewed counterparts, how targeting information is shared, or the level of autonomy available to the GJ-11. The new footage shows the drone being flown under man-in-the-loop (MITL) direct control, but it likely features, or will feature, semi-autonomous control modes, especially for teaming applications, which will require a high degree of onboard autonomy. We do know that China expects the UCAV to be controlled by crewed aircraft, as part of its basic concept. The PLAAF has at least trialed crewed aircraft as drone controllers , and this is one mission set that has frequently been ascribed to the two-seat J-20S . A stock photo of the two-seat J-20S. via X From prototype to operational platform After years of development involving the experimental Sharp Sword design , the much more evolved GJ-11 platform was publicly unveiled during China’s National Day military parade in Beijing in October 2019. Its development is associated with Hongdu Aviation Industry Group, part of the broader AVIC aviation-industrial structure. Two views of an early Sharp Sword UCAV demonstrator. via X A model displayed by AVIC at Airshow China in 2021 provided an early indication of the aircraft’s internal weapons-carrying arrangement. In November 2025, as we reported at the time , the PLAAF released footage of the GJ-11 flying alongside a J-20 and a J-16D electronic warfare aircraft, suggesting that it may have entered service or was at least being integrated into the service’s broader air combat architecture. A screencap from an earlier video showing a GJ-11 flying alongside a J-16D and a J-20. PLA screencap Development and testing of the GJ-11 have been underway for years, with notable activity at China’s secretive Malan test facility in Xinjiang. Satellite imagery reviewed by TWZ has documented repeated, and at times near-daily, GJ-11 activity there, including multiple aircraft operating together. The deployment of three GJ-11s to Shigatse in Tibet between August and September 2025 provided an additional indication that the program was moving beyond test work toward operational evaluation. Two GJ-11s seen on the ramp at Malan on July 12, 2024. PHOTO © 2024 PLANET LABS INC. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED. REPRINTED BY PERMISSION Another image circulating on Chinese social media shows three additional GJ-11s parked alongside another example of the same type. Three GJ-11s in a hangar. PLA screencap Another hangar view with likely a fourth GJ-11 just visible on the right. PLA screencap According to Andreas Rupprecht, an expert on Chinese aviation and contributor to TWZ , numbers that can be seen on the drones themselves likely point to these aircraft being low-rate initial production (LRIP) examples. And what’s even more interesting is that, for the first time, numbers are clearly visible which – and I’m going to go out on a limb here – I believe are not serial numbers but rather design numbers. The numbers 0003, 0011 and 0012 are visible, so these are probably LRIP aircraft. pic.twitter.com/zH2D2Narr9 — @Rupprecht_A (@RupprechtDeino) November 10, 2026 The new releases come less than a month after China announced that the GJ-21 naval derivative had completed its first launch and recovery aboard the new Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan , which is equipped with an electromagnetic catapult and arresting gear. The milestone would pave the way for the PLA Navy to field a shipborne stealth UCAV for strike and reconnaissance missions. However, China has yet to release actual footage of the claimed operation, leaving it independently unverified. The Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan seen leaving Hudong-Zhonghua Shipyard for its first sea trials. Government of the People’s Republic of China The broader significance of the GJ-11 lies in the fact that it’s a genuine UCAV, not simply a loyal wingman designed to accompany a crewed fighter . Free of the endurance limitations imposed by a human crew, a platform of this class could likely offer at least twice the combat radius of a comparable crewed fighter. More importantly, it is intended to have the autonomy to conduct tactical missions independently, as well as operate alongside crewed aircraft. That opens up the possibility of extending China’s strike and reconnaissance reach considerably beyond what its existing low-observable crewed combat aircraft can achieve. The GJ-11’s flying-wing configuration, internal weapons bays, and emphasis on signature reduction suggest a platform approaching the very-low-observable (VLO) category. At the same time, China is now openly fielding a capability that the United States has conspicuously failed to bring into public operational service. In the late 2000s and early 2010s, the United States appeared to be leading the way in stealth UCAV development, with programs such as the Boeing Phantom Ray , X-45 , and X-47B demonstrating the potential of autonomous, long-range penetrating aircraft. Yet those ambitions effectively disappeared from the publicly acknowledged force-development agenda. The Pentagon has instead concentrated on lower-end and less capable Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA), generally designed to operate in conjunction with crewed fighters . Northrop Grumman’s X-47B UCAV demonstrator. U.S. Navy Northrop Grumman’s much larger X-47B that also featured a ‘cranked kite’ planform. USN As we argued in our earlier examinations of the American UCAV gap , the absence of a publicly acknowledged, sizeable force of independent, long-range stealth combat drones remains a significant weakness in U.S. airpower planning. Classified programs may exist, and the U.S. military certainly operates highly sophisticated stealthy uncrewed reconnaissance platforms , but even a small clandestine combat capability would be unlikely to make a decisive difference in a major, sustained conflict. China, meanwhile, is moving towards making this class of aircraft a central part of its military inventory. Important questions about the GJ-11 remain, particularly regarding its actual weapons load, various specifications, its degree of autonomy, and its ability to operate in coordination with crewed fighters. However, the latest official coverage provides the clearest indication yet of how China intends to employ its stealth UCAV in a future conflict, and sheds a little more light on the Mystery Dragon. Contact the author: thomas@thewarzone.com The post China Lifts The Veil On Its GJ-11 Mysterious Dragon Stealth UCAV appeared first on TWZ .

title: 《神爱世人》系列》 第三篇：神爱世人的显明（一）
summary: 《神爱世人》系列》 第三篇：神爱世人的显明（一） – 罗兰岗召会 Church In Rowland Heights 亲爱的弟兄姊妹，神的爱不是藏在天上、叫人猜想的爱，乃是显明出来的爱。这显明的第一步，就是降生：神差祂的独生子到世上来，成为一个人，住在人中间。神的爱若只停在心意里，人永远摸不着；祂必须来，必须成为人能看见、能听见、能摸着的一位。今天我们就来看这爱的第一步显明。 约翰一书四章九节说：“神差祂的独生子到世上来，使我们借着祂得着生命并活着，在此神的爱就向我们显明了。
content:
《神爱世人》系列》 第三篇：神爱世人的显明（一） – 罗兰岗召会 Church In Rowland Heights
亲爱的弟兄姊妹，神的爱不是藏在天上、叫人猜想的爱，乃是显明出来的爱。这显明的第一步，就是降生：神差祂的独生子到世上来，成为一个人，住在人中间。神的爱若只停在心意里，人永远摸不着；祂必须来，必须成为人能看见、能听见、能摸着的一位。今天我们就来看这爱的第一步显明。
约翰一书四章九节说：“神差祂的独生子到世上来，使我们借着祂得着生命并活着，在此神的爱就向我们显明了。”「显明」二字是钥匙。神对世人的爱，在永世里就有了，但在基督降生以前，这爱是隐藏的；当神差独生子到世上来，这爱就公开了、具体了、可以看见了。祂差来的不是天使，不是先知，乃是祂的「独生子」——祂最宝贝、最亲爱的那一位。而且祂来的目的明说：使我们借着祂得着生命并活着。爱的目的不是叫人感动一下，乃是叫人得着生命。
约翰福音三章十六节从神那一面宣告这件事：“神爱世人，甚至将祂的独生子赐给他们，叫一切信入祂的，不至灭亡，反得永远的生命。”「赐给他们」——这独生子不是借给世人，乃是赐给世人；不是暂时来访，乃是永远归给信的人。父把祂最宝贵的赐下来，这就是爱的显明达到的程度。
加拉太书四章四节说：“及至时候满足，神就差出祂的儿子，由女子所生，且生在律法以下，”「及至时候满足」——降生不是临时起意，乃是神在永世里定好、在时间满足时执行的。神等候了几千年，为世人预备这一位；到时候满足，祂就差出祂的儿子。这位儿子「由女子所生」——祂取了人的血肉之体，成为真正的人；「且生在律法以下」——祂站在人的地位上，与我们认同。神的爱降得这样低：低到进了一个婴孩的身体，低到生在律法之下，与罪人站在同一个地位上。
约翰福音一章十四节说：“话成了肉体，支搭帐幕在我们中间，丰丰满满的有恩典，有实际。我们也见过祂的荣耀，正是父独生子的荣耀。”那位太初与神同在的话，成了肉体——这是宇宙中最大的事。祂「支搭帐幕在我们中间」：旧约里神住在帐幕里，人只能在外面观看；如今神自己成了人，帐幕搭在人中间，人可以亲近、可以交谈、可以跟从。祂丰丰满满的有恩典，有实际——爱不再是远方的消息，爱成了人中间的一位。门徒见过祂的荣耀：这荣耀不在云柱火柱里，乃在一个卑微的人身上——从父而来独生子的荣耀。
路加福音一章七十八至七十九节说：“因我们神怜悯的心肠，叫清晨的日光从高天临到我们，要照亮坐在黑暗中死荫里的人，把我们的脚引到平安的路上。”撒迦利亚说出降生的源头：「我们神怜悯的心肠」。祂来，不是因为世人配，乃是因为神的心肠怜悯。祂是「清晨的日光」——给坐在黑暗中、死荫里的人带来光；祂把人的脚引到平安的路上。弟兄姊妹，世人坐在黑暗里多久了，神都看在眼里；祂的爱坐不住，祂亲自从高天临到，作我们的日光。
腓立比书二章七至八节说：“反而倒空自己，取了奴仆的形状，成为人的样式；既显为人的样子，就降卑自己，顺从至死，且死在十字架上。”
这位从父来的独生子，本有神的形状，却「倒空自己」——把尊荣放下，取了奴仆的形状，成为人的样式。爱最高的表达，就是降卑：祂不只成为人，还作了奴仆；不只作奴仆，还顺从至死，且死在十字架上。这一节把降生一路讲到十字架——降生是显明的第一步，十字架是显明的最高点，下一篇我们要专讲这一步。
• 看见真理：神的爱借着降生显明了——祂差独生子，由女子所生，话成了肉体，住在人中间，并倒空自己，取了奴仆的形状。
• 享受真理：这爱今天也临到我们——祂不嫌我们卑微、黑暗，祂愿意住在我们中间，也住进我们心里；清晨起来，迎接这位从高天临到的日光。
• 活出真理：我们得着了这样显明的爱，也当把基督介绍给人：不要只讲道理，要让人从我们身上看见一位「支搭帐幕在人中间」的主——亲近人、体贴人、服事人。
主耶稣，我们感谢父神怜悯的心肠。父阿，你的爱没有停在天上，你差你的独生子到世上来，由女子所生，话成了肉体，住在我们中间。主耶稣，你倒空自己，取了奴仆的形状，为我们降卑到这样的地步。我们敬拜你，也把我们自己向你敞开：求你今天也支搭帐幕在我们心里，照亮我们一切的黑暗，引我们的脚走平安的路。奉主耶稣的名祷告，阿们，哈利路亚！
我虽然行过死荫的幽谷，也不怕遭害，因为你与我同在；你的杖，你的竿，都安慰我。
在我敌人面前，你为我摆设筵席；你用油膏了我的头，使我的福杯满溢。
我一生一世必有恩惠慈爱随着我，我且要住在耶和华的殿中，直到永远。

summary: 韩国陆军榴弹炮坠毁造成1死1伤|海峡时报 韩国汽车与军用榴弹炮夜间相撞，造成 1 人死亡、1 人受伤 立即注册：了解亚洲快速发展的动态 一辆起亚狮跑和一辆保时捷在铁原青阳里附近的国道上从后面撞上 K55A1 榴弹炮。发表于 2026 年 11 月 11 日上午 10:50 更新于 2026 年 11 月 11 日上午 10:54 11 月 5 日，两辆汽车在铁原附近撞上韩国军队的 K55A1 自行榴弹炮，造成一名平民司机死亡，另一人受伤。
content:
韩国陆军榴弹炮坠毁造成1死1伤|海峡时报
韩国夜间汽车与陆军榴弹炮相撞致1死1伤
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
在铁原青阳里附近的国道上，一辆起亚狮跑和一辆保时捷从后面相继击中了 K55A1 榴弹炮。
发表于 2026 年 11 月 11 日上午 10:50
更新于 2026 年 11 月 11 日 10:54
11月5日，两辆汽车在铁原附近撞上韩国军队的K55A1自行榴弹炮，导致一名平民司机死亡，另一人受伤。
军方表示最深切的哀悼，并承诺将“全力配合”警方调查这起事故。
行车记录仪的镜头显示，道路非常黑暗，碰撞前几乎看不到榴弹炮的尾灯。
韩国江原—上周，江原道铁原市发生两辆汽车撞上一辆陆军自行榴弹炮的事故，造成一名平民司机死亡、一人受伤，韩国军队对此表示哀悼。
军方表示将全力配合正在进行的调查。
11月11日，军方在一份声明中表示：“我们向遇难者家属表示最深切的哀悼，并为死者祈祷。”
“警方目前正在调查事故的具体情况和原因，军方将全力配合调查。”
事故发生在11月5日晚上7点左右，一辆起亚狮跑和一辆保时捷在铁原青阳里附近的国道上从后面相继撞上了K55A1榴弹炮。
事故的行车记录仪录像首先在经验丰富的交通律师韩文哲 (Han Moon-chul) 主持的 YouTube 频道韩文哲电视台 (Han Moon-chul TV) 上分享，视频显示道路极其黑暗，很难看到榴弹炮。
当一辆汽车从后面高速驶来并撞上它时，它的尾灯也几乎看不见。
第一辆撞上榴弹炮的汽车被严重损坏，几乎无法辨认。其司机在事故中丧生。
第二辆车的司机受伤，被送往附近的医院。
据报道，这辆榴弹炮上的七名士兵在训练结束后返回基地，其中一些人受到了轻微擦伤。韩国先驱报/亚洲新闻网

Night-time collision between cars and army howitzer leaves 1 dead, 1 injured in South Korea

A Kia Sportage and a Porsche struck the K55A1 howitzer from behind one after the other on a national route near Cheongyang-ri in Cheorwon.
Published Nov 11, 2026, 10:50 AM
Updated Nov 11, 2026, 10:54 AM
A civilian driver died and another was injured after two cars hit a South Korean army K55A1 self-propelled howitzer near Cheorwon on Nov 5.
The army extended its deepest condolences and promised to "fully cooperate" with the police investigating the crash.
Dashcam footage showed the road was very dark, and the howitzer's rear lights were barely visible before the collisions.
GANGWON, South Korea – The South Korean army expressed condolences after a civilian driver was killed and another injured when two cars crashed into an army self-propelled howitzer in Cheorwon in Gangwon province last week.
The army said it would fully cooperate with an ongoing investigation.
“We extend our deepest condolences to the bereaved family and pray for the deceased,” the army said in a statement on Nov 11.
“Police are currently investigating the exact circumstances and cause of the accident, and the military will fully cooperate with the investigation.”
The accident occurred at around 7pm on Nov 5, when a Kia Sportage and a Porsche struck the K55A1 howitzer from behind one after the other on a national route near Cheongyang-ri in Cheorwon.
Dashcam footage of the accident, first shared on Han Moon-chul TV, a YouTube channel hosted by veteran traffic lawyer Han Moon-chul, shows that the road was extremely dark, making the howitzer difficult to see.
Its rear lights were also barely visible as a car approached from behind at high speed and crashed into it.
The first car to hit the howitzer was severely damaged, leaving it almost unrecognisable. Its driver was killed in the crash.
The driver of the second vehicle was injured and taken to a nearby hospital.
Of the seven soldiers aboard the howitzer, which was returning to base after a training exercise, some reportedly sustained minor abrasions. THE KOREA HERALD/ASIA NEWS NETWORK

content:
美FDA指“瘦瘦针”恐致失明 出现“这状况”立刻就医(图) GLP-1 | NAION | 減重針 | 視神經病變 | 台灣 | 疗养保健 |卢乙欣| 看中国网
“瘦瘦针”的GLP-1受体促效剂近年在全球广受关注。（图片来源：Daria/stock.adobe.com） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
【看中国2026年11月11日讯】（看中国记者卢乙欣综合报导）近年俗称“瘦瘦针”的GLP-1受体促效剂在全球掀起减重潮，但惊传施打后恐致失明！美国食品药物管理局发表声明指出，“瘦瘦针”类药品可能引发视力急遽下降，甚至永久失明。台湾医师苏一峰则表示，遇到一案例在施打4个月的瘦瘦针后，“一觉醒来就看不见了”。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
在美国食品药物管理局（FDA）于美东时间9日发布紧急声明，指“瘦瘦针”恐酿永久失明后，台北市联合医院阳明院区胸腔内科主治医师苏一峰于10日晚间透过脸书发文透露，自己病人在施打4个月的瘦瘦针后，“一觉醒来，一眼就眼中风，失明了”。这是本土第一例，而他也紧急通报给政府。
消息一出，引发关注。有网友询问，“是打胰妥赞吗？”苏一峰回复，“是胰妥赞”。
美国食品药物管理局在紧急声明中指出，GLP-1受体促效剂药物可能增加罕见的“非动脉炎性前部缺血性视神经病变”（NAION）之风险，引发单眼突发性、无痛性视力下降、视野缺损、色彩辨识异常等，甚至面临永久失明。
FDA分析了126项随机对照临床试验，受试者多达13万4253名。发现在使用GLP-1类药物者中，每10万人年约有6.4例发生NAION，至于对照组则有3.8例，发生率约为1.7倍。50岁以上一般的民众，每年每10万人中，约有2.3至10.2人罹患此病。
FDA表示，这次警告涵盖全部的GLP-1类药物，因为相关病例已经出现在不同药品使用者身上，因此主管机关要求药厂在仿单的“警语及注意事项”字段上，增列潜在视神经病变风险。
FDA还强调，目前尚未完全厘清药物跟NAION之间的关联机制，且此病非常罕见。若患者出现单眼视力突然模糊、视野缺损等症状，应该立刻就医，由眼科医师评估，并跟原处方医师讨论是否需要停药，切勿自行中断治疗。
根据中时新闻网报导，振兴医院一般眼科主任许粹刚表示，NAION类似“视中风”，这是一种视神经血管阻塞，典型的症状是上半部或者下半部的视野缺损，且是突然发生；因视神经血管非常细小，一旦发生阻塞，神经细胞坏死后往往很难恢复，多数的患者在视力预后会比较差，若严重恶化，恐有失明风险。
许粹刚表示，国外已有少数案例明确指出，在用“瘦瘦针”类药品后，出现视力下降，目前尚不清楚关联，但因发生率很低，不必过度恐慌或者因噎废食。不过，使用瘦瘦针的患者务必定期追踪视力状况，一旦视力在短时间内变差、眼前突然变黑，一定要尽快就医。
另有报导指出，目前台湾并未发现施打瘦瘦针后出现视力缺损的案例。据食药署统计，今年一共接获63件疑似用“瘦瘦针”类药品的不良反应通报案件，其中包括39件用于减重，通报症状如肠胃疾病（包括腹痛、肠阻塞、胰脏炎）、低血糖、恶心、呕吐及注射部位不适等。

title: Schneider Electric explores technology convergence in mining
zh_title: 施耐德电气探索采矿业技术融合
summary: 施耐德电气表示，它正在将电气化、自动化和数字智能结合在一起，帮助矿山作为人工智能驱动的软件定义平台运行，连接能源和工业智能。跨越三个互联层的人工智能 该公司描述了帮助矿业公司应用人工智能的三个层面： 互联设备：智能设备感知操作条件并提供数据和控制功能；边缘控制和计算：仿真和自动化使用AI来支持灵活、高效和有弹性的系统性能；以及应用程序、分析和服务：
content:
施耐德电气表示，它正在将电气化、自动化和数字智能结合在一起，帮助矿山作为人工智能驱动的软件定义平台运行，连接能源和工业智能。跨越三个互联层的人工智能 该公司描述了帮助矿业公司应用人工智能的三个层面： 互联设备：智能设备感知操作条件并提供数据和控制功能；边缘控制和计算：仿真和自动化使用AI来支持灵活、高效和有弹性的系统性能；应用程序、分析和服务：人工智能驱动的见解支持协作、明智的行动和企业价值。施耐德电气利用其技术组合将来自设备、边缘和分析层的过程和能源数据与采矿专业知识和生态系统集成相结合。这支持整个采矿作业生命周期（从设计和施工到运营和维护）的数字孪生。 Torngat Metals：综合稀土合作伙伴 Torngat Metals 在开发加拿大 Strange Lake 稀土项目时，正在利用这些专业知识和集成能力。两家公司签署了一份不具约束力的谅解备忘录（MoU），以探索战略工业合作伙伴关系，支持弹性和负责任的稀土价值链。
拟议的合作伙伴关系以努纳维克的奇异湖、拉布拉多的相关基础设施以及计划中的九岛分离设施为中心。它将通过端到端的合作，将上游资源开发、技术集成和未来工业需求联系起来。该谅解备忘录概述了潜在的 360° 合作伙伴关系，有两个目标： 支持项目开发：将施耐德电气在电气化、自动化、数字系统和可持续工业设计方面的专业知识应用于下一代采矿和加工项目；增强供应链弹性：改善施耐德电气长期获得安全、负责任和合规的稀土和磁体生态系统的战略应用。奇湖预计将生产可再生能源、数字基础设施和先进制造中使用的永磁体所必需的重稀土元素和轻稀土元素。施耐德电气表示，拟议的合作超出了项目支持的范围：它代表着迈向值得信赖的端到端关键矿产价值链的一步。
Torngat 计划在 Strange Lake 整合一座矿山、季节性通道和港口，以及一座年产 15,000 吨稀土的分离和加工厂（照片来源：Torngat Metals） 调整项目交付和未来需求 施耐德电气全球采矿、矿物和金属主管 Vivek Kapoor 表示，此类安排在战略意图上与早期承购关系类似。施耐德的同行通常会承担责任，同时激励两家公司实现项目 KPI。 “通过在如此早期阶段参与并探索未来工业需求如何支持该项目，我们对其长期成功进行了投资，”他上个月在伦敦举行的《金融时报》金属与矿业峰会间隙告诉 IM。 Torngat 计划将一座矿山、季节性通道和港口以及一座年产 15,000 吨稀土的分离和加工厂整合在一起。施耐德电气表示，它在支持这一国际化所需的四个领域拥有经验。

【原文 English Original】
Schneider Electric says it is bringing together electrification, automation and digital intelligence to help mines operate as AI-powered, software-defined platforms that connect energy and industrial intelligence. AI across three connected layers The company describes three layers through which it helps mining companies apply AI: Connected devices: Intelligent devices sense operating conditions and provide data and control capabilities; Edge control and computing: Simulation and automation use AI to support flexible, efficient and resilient system performance; and Apps, analytics and services: AI-driven insights support collaboration, informed action and enterprise value. Schneider Electric uses its portfolio of technologies to combine process and energy data from the device, edge and analytics layers with mining expertise and ecosystem integration. This supports digital twins throughout the mining operations lifecycle, from design and construction to operation and maintenance. Torngat Metals: an integrated rare earth partnership Torngat Metals is drawing on these expertise and integration capabilities as it develops the Strange Lake rare earth project in Canada. The companies have signed a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to explore a strategic industrial partnership supporting a resilient and responsible rare earth value chain. The proposed partnership centres on Strange Lake in Nunavik, associated infrastructure in Labrador and a planned separation facility in Sept-Îles. It would connect upstream resource development, technology integration and future industrial demand through an end-to-end collaboration. The MoU outlines a potential 360° partnership with two objectives: Support project development: Apply Schneider Electric’s expertise in electrification, automation, digital systems and sustainable industrial design to a next-generation mining and processing project; and Strengthen supply chain resilience: Improve Schneider Electric’s long-term access to a secure, responsible and compliant rare earth and magnet ecosystem for strategic applications. Strange Lake is expected to produce heavy and light rare earth elements essential to permanent magnets used in renewable energy, digital infrastructure and advanced manufacturing. Schneider Electric says the proposed collaboration goes beyond project support: it represents a step towards a trusted, end-to-end critical minerals value chain.   Torngat plans to bring together a mine, seasonal access road and port, and a separation and processing plant capable of producing 15,000 t/y of rare earths at Strange Lake (photo credit: Torngat Metals) Aligning project delivery and future demand Vivek Kapoor, Schneider Electric’s Global Lead for Mining, Minerals & Metals, said arrangements of this kind are similar in strategic intent to an early-stage offtake relationship. He described them as going beyond what Schneider’s peers typically undertake, while giving both companies an incentive to deliver on project KPIs. “By engaging at such an early stage and exploring how future industrial demand could support the project, we are invested in its long-term success,” he told IM on the sidelines of the FT Metals & Mining Summit in London last month. Torngat plans to bring together a mine, seasonal access road and port, and a separation and processing plant capable of producing 15,000 t/y of rare earths. Schneider Electric says it has experience across the four areas needed to support that integrated approach: electrification, automation, digital systems and sustainable industrial design. Engineering and operational applications Connecting engineering and operations Through AVEVA engineering solutions, the CONNECT data services platform, AVEVA PI System and its advanced analytics ecosystem, Schneider Electric says it helps organisations unify operational technology, information technology and engineering technology data. This enables these organisations to apply AI-driven insights and put those insights into practice in near real time. AVEVA’s agentic AI capabilities, built into its unified engineering software solution, are already helping mining companies and engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) firms improve detailed engineering productivity, the company says. These capabilities automate repetitive tasks and comparisons, helping teams develop and optimise 3D models more efficiently. SQM: process optimisation At SQM’s operations, Kapoor says AI-powered predictive and optimisation models delivered: A 10-15% reduction in process variability; An increase in nitrate yield of up to 1%; and A 1-3% improvement in raw material efficiency. These improvements translate into higher productivity, less waste and improved sustainability. Roy Hill: a remotely connected pit-to-port operation Kapoor also highlighted Schneider Electric’s earlier work at the 55 Mt/y Roy Hill iron ore project in Western Australia. The company delivered remote operations and demand chain planning capabilities, integrating mine, plant, rail and port operations into a single remotely controlled ecosystem. These capabilities supported one of the industry’s most advanced greenfield deployments and helped optimise the journey from resource to market. “This really was a pit-to-port project for Roy HIll,” he said. For lead EPC provider Samsung C&T, Schneider Electric delivered the port facility’s complete power infrastructure, including 14 switch rooms, transformers, drives, backup power, cooling and power management systems. Image from the Roy Hill owner-operated mine and processing operations (credit: Roy Hill) Vale: centralised monitoring Schneider Electric and AVEVA, which Schneider Electric owns, have also worked with Vale in Brazil to integrate, centralise and remotely monitor operations across its Mariana and Itabira complexes. Schneider Electric says it is also applying hybrid advanced process control and AI to improve milling-circuit performance. In other industrial applications, these solutions have reduced furnace NOx emissions. Removing data silos and putting insights to work A shared data backbone Schneider Electric sees its ability to unify siloed operational data within a scalable, enterprise-ready architecture as a key market differentiator. That capability is also important to Torngat Metals’ integrated project approach. In traditional mining and processing environments, data from sensors, control systems and laboratories often sits in disconnected systems, limiting its usefulness, the company says. Schneider Electric says CONNECT provides a centralised data backbone on top of AVEVA PI System, enabling secure, near-real-time sharing between on-premises systems and cloud analytics platforms. At SQM, for example, operational data is made accessible in Databricks through Delta Sharing. This supports advanced AI, machine-learning and simulation workflows with near-real-time refresh cycles, according to Schneider Electric. “This architecture eliminates data silos and provides an open, developer-friendly environment for building and scaling AI solutions – an essential foundation for industrial transformation,” the company says. From recommendations to operational action Schneider Electric describes a “closed-loop approach” in which model outputs are fed back into operational systems, rather than remaining separate analytical insights. At SQM, predictive and optimisation models generate real-time recommendations for feed ratios, temperatures and flows. Schneider Electric says these outputs are written back into CONNECT and displayed in operator tools such as AVEVA PI Vision. Operators can then compare actual performance with AI-driven optimal conditions and act on the recommendations. Prescriptive setpoint optimisation similarly allows AI models to recommend and guide operational adjustments. In some cases, these adjustments can run automatically to support continuous performance improvement. “This integration transforms AI from a decision-support tool into an active driver of operational performance,” it says. Adapting AI models and scaling deployment Continuous model development Schneider Electric says its architecture supports rapid development and deployment of machine-learning models, hybrid simulation models and dynamic optimisation algorithms. In practice, this includes: Training and retraining machine-learning models using the large volumes of data held in AVEVA PI System, which is widely adopted at mining sites; Developing hybrid models that combine physics-based simulations with data-driven AI; and Running real-time scenario simulations to optimise production conditions. At SQM, Schneider Electric says predictive models achieved approximately 90% accuracy, increasing operator confidence and improving decision quality. Model retraining cycles were also significantly reduced, enabling faster adaptation to changing process conditions and continuous performance improvement. From individual use cases to enterprise-wide deployment Scalability is another key differentiator, according to Schneider Electric. The company says its architecture supports deployment across multiple plants, processes and business units, rather than being limited to individual use cases. At SQM, the success of nitrate optimisation has led to plans to expand into additional plants and incorporate richer datasets, including maintenance and laboratory analytics, the company claims. Schneider Electric presents this as an example of the progression from pilot projects to broader digital transformation. Looking ahead: an integrated mine-to-metal benchmark The MoU between Schneider Electric and Torngat Metals points towards a similarly integrated approach. Schneider Electric hopes the proposed mine-to-metal collaboration will establish a benchmark for digital transformation across Torngat’s operations. “By embedding sustainability, efficiency and digital performance across the project lifecycle, from design through operations, the partnership aims to set new standards for responsible resource development,” it says. Lead image from the Roy Hill owner-operated mine and processing operations (credit: Roy Hill) The post Schneider Electric explores technology convergence in mining appeared first on International Mining .

title: 特朗普称下周或与习近平、普京在中国举行三方会谈
summary: 特朗普向记者表示，他将前往中国，并预计与习近平及普京会面。他说：“我将前往中国，而我认为其中一场会议将会是与普京总统及习近平主席举行，这将会很有意思。”他又表示，会谈将涉及多项议题，包括核裁军及结束伊朗战争。 中国外交部发言人毛宁表示，中方正与有关方面就三国元首会晤保持沟通。俄罗斯克里姆林宫发言人佩斯科夫（Dmitry Peskov）证实，相关协调工作正在进行，希望未来数日内敲定安排。他说：“我们希望能在未来几天内敲定这件事。” 克里姆林宫早于10月21日已表示，三方会谈正在
content: 特朗普向记者表示，他将前往中国，并预计与习近平及普京会面。他说：“我将前往中国，而我认为其中一场会议将会是与普京总统及习近平主席举行，这将会很有意思。”他又表示，会谈将涉及多项议题，包括核裁军及结束伊朗战争。 中国外交部发言人毛宁表示，中方正与有关方面就三国元首会晤保持沟通。俄罗斯克里姆林宫发言人佩斯科夫（Dmitry Peskov）证实，相关协调工作正在进行，希望未来数日内敲定安排。他说：“我们希望能在未来几天内敲定这件事。” 克里姆林宫早于10月21日已表示，三方会谈正在筹备。美国《华尔街日报》此前报道，普京希望透过会谈促成乌克兰和平协议，争取对莫斯科有利的安排。俄罗斯自2022年全面入侵乌克兰后，一直面对西方国家的外交孤立及制裁。 分析人士指出，普京可能是这场会谈的最大受益者。即使三方未能达成协议，只要普京能与特朗普及习近平同场亮相，已可向外界展示俄罗斯仍是国际重大外交事务的重要参与者，削弱西方孤立莫斯科的效果。 美国前总统奥巴马（Barack Obama）政府时期的国务院高级官员丹尼·罗素（Danny Russel）向Euronews表示，普京是最有可能从三方会谈中获益的领袖，即使三方未能达成协议，只要普京能与特朗普及习近平同场亮相，已可向外界展示俄罗斯仍是国际重大外交事务的重要参与者，削弱西方孤立莫斯科的效果。 俄罗斯方面也明显积极推动会面。他形容，这将是普京的一次“外交上的重大胜利”。 莫斯科政治分析人士亚历山大·布拉特斯基（Alexander Bratersky）接受半岛电视台访问时指出，三方会谈本身已足以让俄罗斯取得政治宣传成果。俄罗斯官员曾将这类会谈比作1945年的雅尔塔会议，暗示大国领袖可共同塑造战后国际秩序。布拉特斯基认为，普京与特朗普及习近平同坐谈判桌，有助塑造俄罗斯参与决定欧洲未来安全架构的形象。他说：“单是举行这场会议，本身就是一项成功。普京将能够在国内将此事作为成果宣传。” 特朗普方面则希望借会谈展示其处理国际重大问题的能力。伦敦城市圣乔治大学国际政治学教授因德吉特·帕马尔（Inderjeet Parmar）认为，特朗普希望透过与另外两个大国领袖直接接触，塑造自己是不可或缺的协议促成者，并展示美国仍掌握国际主导权，即使会谈实际内容有限。 中国的考量则有所不同。美国智库史汀生中心（Stimson Center）中国项目主任孙韵指出，北京希望取得会谈带来的外交形象效益，却不愿承担额外成本。她说：“中国想要的是形象，而不是成本。” 特朗普预计这次访华将是他今年第三次与习近平会面。美中两国目前维持脆弱的贸易休战安排，协议预计于明年1月届满。中国今年主办APEC领导人非正式会议，成员包括美国及俄罗斯。 分析人士也关注，三方会谈可能令美国的欧洲及亚洲盟友被边缘化。帕马尔指出，二战后美国通常会先与盟友协调，再与俄罗斯或中国处理重大外交议题，若三国领袖绕过盟友直接讨论国际安全及经济安排，将反映美国外交模式出现转变。他说：“一场独立进行的三方会谈，可能将这些盟友视为次要角色，仿佛他们的利益可以在事后才处理。” 美国智库民主防卫基金会（Foundation for Defense of Democracies）中国项目高级主任克雷格·辛格尔顿（Craig Singleton）则认为，会谈可能最终只是一场让普京与美中领袖同框的拍照活动。他指出：“场面可能具有历史意义，却未必能产生任何特别重大的实际成果。”

title: Presidential Message on the Birthday of the United States Marine Corps
zh_title: 美国海军陆战队生日总统致辞
summary: 总统关于美国海军陆战队生日的致辞 搜索 选择类别 所有新闻简报和声明 所有总统行动 行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 所有简报和声明 总统行动 所有行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 两个半世纪以来，美国海军陆战队一直是美国精神的生动体现。带着荣誉、勇气和坚定不移
content:
总统关于美国海军陆战队生日的致辞 搜索 选择类别 所有新闻简报和声明 所有总统行动 行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 所有简报和声明 总统行动 所有行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 两个半世纪以来，美国海军陆战队一直是美国精神的生动体现。凭借荣誉、勇气和对维护和推进美国利益的坚定承诺，海军陆战队一再证明，无论困难如何，他们都会响应每一个召唤并完成任何任务。在海军陆战队庆祝保护美国并击败敌人 251 周年之际，我向每一位为我们的国家战斗和牺牲的海军陆战队员致以最深切的谢意，并向他们无与伦比的英勇遗产致敬。从我们共和国诞生之日起，海军陆战队就一直捍卫美国赖以建立的自由和自由的支柱。独立战争期间，海军陆战队出海夺取拿骚港，为大陆军提供大量军需物资增援。在整个第二次世界大战期间，海军陆战队在整个太平洋战区发挥了关键作用，对于美国在关岛、瓜达尔卡纳尔岛、冲绳岛和硫磺岛的胜利至关重要。
这些令人难以置信的“魔鬼犬”在美国历史上无数次冲突的前线服役，从未失败过保护我们国内外的公民，并在我们的对手面前无所畏惧地展示了美国的威力和力量。今天，通过我们勇敢的海军陆战队的英勇无私的服务，美国变得更加安全。美国海军陆战队的爱国男女不断提醒人们美国伟大和荣耀的真正源泉。作为总统，我是我国历史上最强有力的海军陆战队倡导者。通过超级情报的进步以及对导弹防御、下一代能力和造船的投资，我们正在为我们的海军陆战队提供击败美国敌人所需的一切资源，无论他们身在何处。在我的领导下，我们的海军陆战队员也回到家乡，得到他们应得的关怀和支持。我的政府恢复了退伍军人事务部的常识，使退伍军人能够寻求自己选择的医疗保健提供者，降低退伍军人及其家人的费用，并减少有害的积压。作为总司令，我将永远不会停止为我们的海军陆战队挺身而出，维护他们作为世界上最致命的战斗力量的声誉。在座右铭“Semper Fidelis”（意为“永远忠诚”）的指引下，美国海军陆战队在我们国家和全人类的历史上留下了自己的印记。
我们海军陆战队的坚定力量证明了美国精神的力量和美国武装部队的力量。一代又一代，海军陆战队忠实地充当了美国的捍卫者，他们将在未来的几个世纪里继续作为自由的忠实捍卫者。永远Fi！关于美国海军陆战队生日的总统致辞首先出现在白宫。

Presidential Message on the Birthday of the United States Marine Corps Search Select Category All News Briefings & Statements All Presidential Actions Executive Orders Nominations & Appointments Presidential Memoranda Proclamations Fact Sheets Releases Remarks Research All Briefings & Statements Presidential Actions All Executive Orders Nominations & Appointments Presidential Memoranda Proclamations Fact Sheets Releases Remarks Research For over two and a half centuries, the United States Marine Corps has stood as a living embodiment of the American Spirit.  With honor, courage, and unwavering commitment to preserving and advancing the interests of the United States, Marines have proven time and again that they will answer every call and complete any mission no matter the odds.  As the Marine Corps celebrates 251 years of protecting America and defeating her enemies, I extend my deepest gratitude to every Marine who has fought and sacrificed for our Nation and pay tribute to their unmatched legacy of valor. From the dawn of our Republic, Marines have defended the pillars of freedom and liberty that America was founded upon.  During the Revolutionary War, Marines took to the sea to seize the port of Nassau and reinforce the Continental Army with large quantities of military supplies.  Throughout World War II, Marines played a critical role across the Pacific Theater and were essential to American victories at Guam, Guadalcanal, Okinawa, and Iwo Jima.  These incredible Devil Dogs have served on the front lines of countless conflicts throughout American history, never failed to protect our citizens at home and abroad, and fearlessly demonstrated American might and power in the face of our adversaries.  Today, America is made safer through the heroic and selfless service of our brave Marines. The patriotic men and women of the United States Marine Corps are enduring reminders of the true source of American greatness and glory.  As President, I have been the strongest advocate for our Marines in the history of our country.  Through advancements in Super Intelligence and investments in missile defense, next-generation capabilities, and shipbuilding, we are providing our Marines with every resource they need to defeat America’s enemies wherever they may be. Under my leadership, our Marines also return home to the care and support they have so rightly earned.  My Administration has restored common sense at the Department of Veterans Affairs, empowering veterans to seek the healthcare providers of their choice, lowering costs for veterans and their families, and slashing harmful backlogs.  As Commander in Chief, I will never stop standing up for our Marines and upholding their reputation as the most lethal fighting force the world has ever seen. Guided by their motto, Semper Fidelis, meaning “Always Faithful,” the United States Marines have left their mark on the history of our Nation and all of mankind.  The steadfast strength of our Marines is a testament to the power of the American Spirit and the might of the United States Armed Forces.  Generation after generation, Marines have faithfully served as champions of America, and they will carry on as faithful defenders of liberty for centuries to come.  Semper Fi! The post Presidential Message on the Birthday of the United States Marine Corps appeared first on The White House .

title: Alice Huang reportedly instrumental in securing over $7.5 billion of Nvidia AI GPU imports during three-year relationship with Jensen Huang
zh_title: 据报道，Alice Huang 在与 Jensen Huang 的三年合作关系中帮助确保了超过 75 亿美元的 Nvidia AI GPU 进口
summary: Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋承认与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 有染，后者也被怀疑是为中国国家安全部 (MSS) 工作的间谍。现在，The Information 的一项调查揭示了一个以上海世纪利通为中心、与新加坡公司 Megaspeed 有联系的公司“迷宫”，该公司此前被指控走私价值 20 亿美元的 Nvidia 芯片。该报告称，Alice Huang 帮助将 240,000 个被禁芯片运入该国，其中大部分是 H100 和 H200 系统，并在确保 AI GPU 进口到该国方面发挥了重要作用。
content:
Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋承认与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 有染，后者也被怀疑是为中国国家安全部 (MSS) 工作的间谍。现在，The Information 的一项调查揭示了一个以上海世纪利通为中心、与新加坡公司 Megaspeed 有联系的公司“迷宫”，该公司此前被指控走私价值 20 亿美元的 Nvidia 芯片。该报告称，Alice Huang 帮助将 24 万块被禁芯片运入该国，其中大部分是 H100 和 H200 系统，并在确保 AI GPU 进口方面发挥了重要作用，价值高达 75 亿美元。深入了解 TH Premium：台湾、贸易和关税（图片来源：tsmc） 虽然美国在芯片制裁上反复无常，但中国正在建立自己的芯片供应市场 中国长达十年的半导体发展状况 华为 Ascend NPU 路线图审查了中国长鑫存储的目标，到 2030 年，第六座大型晶圆厂将占据 30% 的 DRAM 内存市场份额 中国最新一轮稀土出口管制的解释 报告中的消息来源将这两家公司与 Alice Huang 联系起来他们的个人知识和公司注册记录，同时也有报道称Megaspeed购买的部分Nvidia AI芯片进入了上海世纪利通在中国的数据中心。但除了这些企业关系之外，还有大量关于她的报道。
黄女士与英伟达首席执行官的个人关系，以及这种关系如何使她能够采购其他地方很难获得的芯片。据称，黄仁勋公开吹嘘她与英伟达首席执行官的接触。熟悉她的人说，她经常将与詹森的照片上传到她的微信账户，甚至与顾客分享其他照片，以建立自己的可信度。她甚至声称，黄仁勋经常用晚餐和礼物来庆祝她的生日，而英伟达中国的一名销售员工则表示，她是该公司为中国当地合作伙伴举办的年度活动中的一张熟悉的面孔。据称，当人工智能的发货出现延误或遇到一些麻烦时，黄女士会介入，让它们重新通过供应链。另一位认识她的人士表示，她经常将自己与英伟达及其供应商的密切关系作为她总能获得英伟达人工智能芯片的原因。据估计，从 2023 年到 2025 年，价值 46 亿美元的人工智能芯片通过 Megaspeed 进口，另外 20 亿美元通过 Speedmatrix 进口。另据报道，上海世纪力通从其他渠道购买GPU，如果订单出现问题，则由Alice Huang协助，采购的GPU总价值估计约为75亿美元。报道称，黄女士帮助将约 24 万块违禁芯片转移到中国。 Alice Huang 出现在黄仁勋圈子里的时间可能比之前认为的要早得多。
一位消息人士告诉该刊物，爱丽丝·黄的丈夫康伟在 2010 年代认识了黄仁勋，当时英伟达主要是一家 PC 游戏 GPU 制造商。据报道，康伟当时是一位专注于视频游戏公司的私募股权投资者。相比之下，据报道黄女士在中国的两家媒体公司工作，尽管有人说没有她这样做的记录。她最终跳入银行和金融领域，先后在汇丰银行和中信证券工作，最终于 2023 年随着 Megaspeed 的转型和上海世纪利通的成立而进入数据中心行业。上海世纪利通数据中心

【原文 English Original】
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to having an affair with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang , who is also suspected of being a spy working for the Chinese Ministry of State Security (MSS). Now, an investigation by The Information has revealed a 'labyrinth' of companies centered around Shanghai Century Litong and connected to Singaporean firm Megaspeed, which has previously been accused of smuggling $2 billion worth of Nvidia chips. The report claims Alice Huang helped move 240,000 banned chips into the country, mostly H100 and H200 systems, and was instrumental in securing AI GPU imports to the tune of $7.5 billion. Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc) While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply market The state of China's decade-long semiconductor push Huawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fab China's latest round of rare-earth export controls explained Sources in the report link the two companies to Alice Huang via their personal knowledge and corporate registration records, while there have also been reports that some of the Nvidia AI chips Megaspeed bought went to Shanghai Century Litong’s data centers in China. But aside from these corporate ties, there were also numerous reports about Ms. Huang’s personal relationship with the Nvidia chief, and how it gave her the ability to procure chips that were otherwise hard to get elsewhere. Ms. Huang allegedly boasted about her access to the Nvidia CEO publicly. People familiar with her said that she regularly uploaded photos with Jensen to her WeChat account and even shared other images with customers to establish her credibility. She even claimed that Jensen Huang would often celebrate her birthday with dinner and gifts, while an Nvidia China sales employee said that she was a familiar face at the company’s annual event for local Chinese partners. When AI shipments hit delays or faced some trouble, Ms. Huang allegedly would step in to get them moving through the supply chain again. One other person who knows her said that she would often cite her close relationship with Nvidia and its suppliers as the reason why she could always get Nvidia AI chips. It’s estimated that $4.6 billion worth of AI chips have been imported through Megaspeed from 2023 to 2025, with another $2 billion routed through Speedmatrix. It was also reported that Shanghai Century Litong bought GPUs from other sources, with the assistance of Alice Huang if the orders faced an issue, with the total value of the GPUs acquired estimated to be around $7.5 billion. The report claims Ms. Huang helped move some 240,000 banned chips into China. Alice Huang may have appeared in Jensen Huang’s circle much earlier than previously believed. One source told the publication that Kang Wei, Alice Huang’s husband, met Jensen Huang during the 2010s, when Nvidia was primarily a PC gaming GPU manufacturer. According to the report , Kang Wei was a private equity investor focusing on videogame companies back then. In contrast, Ms. Huang reportedly worked for two media companies in China, although some say that there were no records of her doing so. She eventually jumped into banking and finance, working at HSBC and then CITIC Securities, before finally entering the data center industry in 2023 with Megaspeed’s pivot and the founding of Shanghai Century Litong. Shanghai Century Litong is a data center operator founded in June 2023 by a shareholder that was ultimately under the control of Huang Yu, the sister of Alice Huang, whose Chinese name is Huang Le. The company then provided compute capacity to AI tech giants in China, including Alibaba, Tencent, and other smaller labs. A few months after its founding, it received coveted Nvidia Preferred Cloud Partner status in October 2023, which is an important milestone as Nvidia requires anyone with this status to have demonstrated sufficient capability in handling and running Nvidia hardware as well as generating revenue at a certain level, although that threshold varies by region and partner type. In exchange for this, partners get better access to Nvidia’s limited number of chips, which became crucial for Shanghai Century Litong as the China-specific A800 and H800 chips were banned for sale to China around the same period. Although the move immediately banned the sales of these GPUs from Nvidia, it did not affect the chip stocks that were already in the hands of distributors. This meant that Shanghai Century Litong had priority access to the limited supply of these AI GPUs as Nvidia’s preferred partner. Megaspeed, on the other hand, was reportedly owned by a company called Huang Le Limited and led by Ms. Huang when it pivoted in 2023 and was subsequently sold to Singaporean entity Swiftdata soon after this. Megaspeed then set up a subsidiary called Speedmatrix, which has two offices in Johor, Malaysia, a couple of months after that. The Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS), the U.S. agency in charge of monitoring export control compliance, noted that the Nvidia hardware found in Speedmatrix data centers was still in its boxes when they inspected the sites, triggering a deeper investigation into the company . Still, it’s been alleged that Nvidia intervened in the BIS probe , with the company retaining its Nvidia partner status to this day. Despite her public closeness with the Nvidia chief, she’s rather elusive when it comes to her personal information. Two other people said that she has always been vague about what she does at her companies, and that she’s careful when it comes to signing documents and leaving a paper trail that could easily be followed. Still, the Chinese embassy denies any links to Alice Huang, even as the FBI looks into the situation .

title: Ye olde server consolidation has made Cisco push top-of-rack switching to 100G
zh_title: 过去的服务器整合使思科将架顶式交换推向了 100G

content:
服务器整合促使思科将架顶式交换机的速度提高到 100G。这家网络巨头上周发布了名为 N9348C8D-H2 的引人注目的产品，这是一款 1U 设备，包含 48 个 100G SFP-DD 端口和 8 个 400G QSFP-DD 上行链路。本周在澳大利亚墨尔本举行的 Cisco Live 活动上，思科数据中心和互联网基础设施高级副总裁 Kevin Wollenweber 表示，该公司创建该设备的一个原因是现代服务器通常配备一对快速网络接口卡。之所以需要双卡，是因为英特尔和 AMD 的第六代服务器处理器提供数十甚至数百个物理处理器核心，因此会产生大量流量。这些处理器提供的计算能力密度促使芯片制造商和服务器制造商建议用运行更高效的第六代芯片的机器替换运行较旧、耗电的 Xeon 和 Epyc 的少量机器。据 The Register 报道，从第三代或第四代 Xeon 或 Epycs 迁移到当前型号时，实现 6:1 的服务器整合率并不罕见。采取这一行动的用户可以将更多的服务器核心装入同一个机架中。电费下降了，但离开机架的数据量却增加了。 Wollenweber 表示，思科意识到它拥有“大量”提供 25G 端口的交换机，但认为它在非人工智能场景（例如产生更多数据流的服务器整合）方面存在差距。
这位高管承认，对于少量的新服务器来说，100G 端口可能有些过大，但他认为，用户认识到，用不了多久，它们就会出现容量过剩的情况——也许是因为他们使用了更多代理人工智能应用程序。思科认为，来自人工智能代理的流量强调了将组织与云连接起来的南北向连接，同时也推动了内部网络中更多的东西向流量。在 Cisco Live 上，该公司的高管表示，网络升级是不可避免的。这并不完全是自私的，因为与人类使用生成人工智能或聊天机器人时发生的一系列网络活动相比，代理的数量将远远超过人类并不断创造流量。思科认为，因此只有在高度自动化的网络上才能大规模部署代理。 “人类无法再理解网络中实际拥有的数据量，”Wollenweber 告诉 The Register。思科的 Canvas 代理运营平台旨在通过检测问题并提供维修服务，至少让人们意识到何时需要他们的关注。思科高级副总裁兼网络平台和保障部总经理 Joe Vaccaro 告诉 The Register，他相信，当网络管理员关注 IT 专业人员确信代理能够处理的熟悉、常规、低风险任务时，网络管理员不会因为人工智能代理的建议而感到威胁。
他说，随着时间的推移，网络专业人士将学会信任从事更复杂工作的代理。®

【原文 English Original】
Server consolidation has led Cisco to boost the speed of top-of-rack switches to 100G. The networking giant last week announced the catchily named N9348C8D-H2, a 1U device packing 48 100G SFP-DD ports and eight 400G QSFP-DD uplinks. At the Cisco Live event in Melbourne, Australia, this week, Cisco’s senior veep for datacenter and internet infrastructure, Kevin Wollenweber, said one reason the company created the device is that modern servers often feature a pair of fast network interface cards. The twin cards are needed because sixth-gen server processors from Intel and AMD offer dozens, or even hundreds, of physical processor cores and therefore generate a lot of traffic. The density of computing power those processors provide has led chipmakers and server manufacturers to suggest replacing handfuls of machines running older, power-guzzling Xeons and Epycs with boxes running more efficient sixth-gen chips. The Register hears it’s not uncommon to achieve 6:1 server consolidation ratios when moving from third- or fourth-generation Xeons or Epycs to current models. Users who make that move can pack many more server cores into the same rack. Power bills go down, but the quantity of data leaving a rack goes up. Wollenweber said Cisco realized it had “tons” of switches that offer 25G ports but felt it had a gap in its range for non-AI scenarios like server consolidation that produced increased data flows. The exec admitted that the 100G ports may be overkill for a modest collection of new servers, but argued users recognize it won’t be long before they grow into the excess capacity – perhaps as they use more agentic AI applications. Cisco sees traffic from AI agents stressing the north-south connections that link organizations to the cloud and also driving much more east-west traffic across internal networks. At Cisco Live, the company’s execs suggested that network upgrades are therefore an inevitable necessity. That’s not entirely self-serving, because agents will vastly outnumber humans and constantly create traffic, compared to the flurries of network activity that happen when humans use generative AI or chatbots. Cisco argues that deploying agents at scale will therefore only be possible on highly automated networks. “Humans can no longer comprehend the amount of data that we actually have in a network,” Wollenweber told The Register . Cisco’s Canvas agentic operations platform aims to at least make humans aware when their attention is needed, by detecting problems and offering to make repairs. Joe Vaccaro, Cisco’s senior vice president and general manager for Network Platform and Assurance, told The Register he believes network administrators don’t feel threatened by suggestions from AI agents when they concern familiar, routine, low-risk tasks that IT pros are confident the agents can handle. Over time, he said, networking pros will learn to trust agents with more complex work. ®
